comments:
Amazing place!

Location: short walk to all the bars and shops in Palermo soho and hollywood, plus also the subway

Apartment: v modern and with all you could want. Living room was perfect for relaxing in with a large sofa, massive TV and amazing view through the floor to ceiling windows. Bedroom hits the spot with a big windows, wardrobe and comfy bed. Bathroom also of the same standard

Building: has an amazing gym set-up on the 31 floor - always seemed to be empty and a real pleasure to use.
Really enjoyed Candela's recommendations and quick communication! Had a wonderful time in BsAs, enjoy this apartment!

Candela and her colleague were very attentive and quick to respond, absolutely wonderful. The apartment is beautiful, well equipped and conveniently located close to the historic part of Palermo, bars and excellent restaurants. I highly recommend this place.

The apartment was in a beautiful, modern building, was wonderfully decorated and equip with all of the modern amenities. We not only loved the apartment, but the location was ideal. We were walking distance to the Subte and to my job in Palermo Soho. We were surrounded by lots of restaurants and boutiques. The only issue with this apartment is the noise. The neighbors on our floor had a dog that barked constantly and often times woke us up at night. We spoke with Candela who tried to help us solve the issue and it seems as though many neighbors have complained about dogs in the building and that they might be more selective in the future. We hope that's the case because it's a beautiful place to live otherwise.

My stay at Candela's apartment was very enjoyable. The apartment looks exactly like the photos.  Candela is very hospitable and does everything to make the stay enjoyable. I would recommend this place to anyone wishing to visit Buenos Aires. The location is also an added bonus, very close to the D line Subte and bus connections from Plaza Italia. The parks are very close by as are many great restaurants and coffee shops.
Very nice place, just as shown in the pictures.  Close to everything - stores, Palermo Viejo, botanical garden, and the subte station.  Candela made everything easy.  Thanks!

Thank you for everything, Candela. Die Wohnung und die Anlage ist genauso wie versprochen. Meine Sonderwünsche konnten alle berücksichtigt werden. Beim Check-in und Check-out war Candela sehr flexibel!

We had admired the Palermo Uno building on previous visits to Buenos Aires and it did not disappoint.  The location is prime, and the apartment, furnishings, building amenities and security are all first-rate.  Candela is a friendly, gracious host, and her onsite manager could not have been more helpful.  The view from the gym on the 31st floor is the visual definition of awesome.  Thanks for a great experience!

Candela did a great job accommodating us. While she was not there personally, she had a friend meet us at the unit and let us in and get us situated. Any issues we had were quickly fixed.
The unit itself is in an excellent location. Close to the parks and attractions in and around the park (zoo, planetarium, Japanese gardens, MALBA) as well as all of the great restaurants in Palermo SOHO. We could not have asked for a better location.
The unit was also clean and had some good books on BA to review. The bed was very comfortable!The unit had a decent gym and good security.
The only negative was noise. The sounds of dogs and babies was so loud they sounded like they were in the unit. There is also a water pipe in the wall that is poorly insulated so you constant hear water flushing through the pipes. If you're a light sleeper, this apartment isn't for you. Otherwise it is fantastic and in a great location.

Candela was a very good host. Although I did not meet her in person she was quick to respond to any questions or concerns. The apartment itself is just as described.  I was very comfortable for the two months that I lived there, the bed was wonderful, and everything worked perfectly in the apartment. In terms of the location, it was also very convenient, near the metro (Plaza Italia) and Santa Fe, which has all the bus connections you could ever need. My one caveat would be that the neighbors have a very annoying dog that barks all the time. It didn't really bother me much because I sleep very deep and I was out of the house most of the day, but if you are a light sleeper this might be an issue. Sadly this is out of Candela's control, but it would only be fair to mention it. Beyond that, I would recommend this apartment and great building.

Candela's apartment listing description was accurate. She was very responsive. It is a lovely space, great location and wonderful amenities. An amazing view from the gym on the 31st floor. Lovely sauna and jacuzzi on the 32nd floor, and great pool and sunbathing area. All the staff in the building was very friendly and responsive to any needs. They made me feel very welcome.

The building is two books away from the Subte (public transportation - subway), walking distance to great coffee shops, retail stores, ice-cream parlours and restaurants. The building is located in Palermo Soho and walking distance to Palermo Hollywood and Recoleta. It is couple of books away from "Bosques de Palermo", the planetarium, the Botanical Garden and the Japanese Garden. All fantastic outdoor green areas for safe walks or to practice outdoor sports.

I have been visiting Argentina for over 20 years now. I have been coming at least twice a year for work during the last 3 years, and this was the best accom...

El apartamento es muy cómodo, tiene mucha luz y está muy bien distribuido. El edificio es bastante nuevo y los amenities como gimnasio y piscina están muy bien. El apartamento incluye equipamiento suficiente como platos, vasos, toallas. He estado muy a gusto en mi estancia de 2 meses. Repetiría sin dudar. El contacto con Candela ha sido fluido tanto a la entrada como en la salida.

Great, indeed.

Santiago welcomed us warmly at the most uncomfortable of morning hours, even after our changing the arrival time several time due to delays of our incoming flight.

The apartment itself was as described: a great retreat amidst the bustling Palermo neighborhood.

Will definitively be back when in Buenos Aires again

El departamento de Santiago está en una excelente ubicación, rodeado de heladerías, restaurants, tiendas. A pesar de estar en una avenida muy transitada es super silencioso, por ser contrafrente. Aunque a la cocina le faltaban inicialmente algunos elementos (cubiertos, ollas, sartenes, cafetera) Santiago prontamente se ocupó de resolverlo todo. Nos sentimos muy a gusto y seguramente sería nuestra opción en futuros viajes a Bs Aires.

El departamento de Santiago esta muy bien equipado, muy comodo y bien situado, las respuestas de Santiago a nuestras consultas y necesidades fueron siempre rapidas y eficientes. Recomiendo su departamento, no tendran problemas y la pasaran muy bien.
ubicacion muy bueno y comodo

Increíble todo. El departamento es hermoso, muy cómodo, súper luminoso y cálido y se encuentra en una ubicación inmejorable. Santiago y Paula son excelentes huéspedes, súper amables, atentos y resolutivos. Tuvimos que cambiar el ingreso a un día después y no tuvieron problemas, acomodaron sus horarios para hacer el check in apenas llegamos a Buenos Aires, también tuvimos que cancelar de emergencia y su respuesta fue excelente. Enormemente agradecidos, sin duda volveríamos

El apartamento es espacioso, con terraza, muy bien ubicado. La comunicación con el propietario es muy fácil y rápida. Se encuentra ubicado en una zona tranquila y céntrica. Muy bien equipado. Lo recomendaría sin duda, Santiago ha sido un gran anfitrión.
Gracias por todo! Son anfritiones de confianza, el departamento impecable y siempre a disposicion. Gracias por todo y felicitaciones!

Lo mejor del apartamento es la ubicación en pleno barro de Palermo que era nuestro objetivo. El apartamento tiene aire acondicionado en las dos habitaciones y el salon. Los electrodomésticos son antiguos pero funcionan bien todos. Santiago está atento a cualquier problema que pueda surgir. Se tiene todo para largas temporadas. El encargado del edificio está disponible para cualquier duda que haya.

This is a marvelous apartment---filled with light, a one bedroom, very nicely decorated, and well appointed, in a great neighborhood, Palermo Soho. In a very attractive brand new building, guests have access to a sauna, a gym and a pool!  The kitchen is well equipt, there are 2 flat screen TVs; the bed is very comfy.  And upstairs, there is a lovely sunny private roof terrace, with a sitting area under a canopy, a dining table and parilla! The price is right as well--a very decent price for very fine accommodation. I was made to feel most welcome and comfortable by the apartment manager, Luciana, as well as by the owner, Maria, who answered my emails promptly and graciously.  Truly this apartment feels like a ¨home away from home¨. I enjoyed my stay here immensely.
The place was fantastic! Very comfortable, great terrace, lot's of natural light, excellent location. I would absolutely recommend it.

MI experiencia en el departamento de María y Gustavo fue muy buena, el departamento esta muy bien ubicado y cuidado y ante cualquier inconveniente (mínimo) siempre estuvieron (en contacto telefónico y via mail o mandando algún asistente) dispuestos a solucionarlo.

En mi caso usé el departamento siendo de Buenos Aires por un tema laboral con lo que gran parte del día estaba allí dentro.

Por último decirles que siendo usuario de departamentos de alquiler en el exterior ya sea, via home away, vrbo o esta página, puedo decirles que el departamento tiene nivel internacional y una muy buena relación costo y beneficio para quien venga a conocer Buenos Aires.

Saludos

Marcelo

A very nice apartment, clean and complete. A neighborhood with several nice bars and restaurants, a few blocks from the metro and Santa Fe Avenue, the starting point for all corners of the city. The predio, doormen sao very good people. We like a lot, ideal for a couple or a couple with one child. Mary and an excellent hostess. Already know to stay the next time, without thinking twice.
The host canceled my reservation 96 days before arrival.

Staying at Maria's apartment made my travel in Buenos Aires one of the highlights. Not only was it conveniently located near the trendy area of Palermo and easily accesible to the subway and buses, but the apartment it self was really comfortable with excellent facilities including gym, pool and terrace.
Lucianna, was extremely accomodating in providing me with the keys at a time that suited me.
Many thanks!

This is the best location in Buenos Aires. Palermo is where you want to be and this apartment is right between the most happening parts of Palermo: Plaza Armenia and Plaza Serrano, and still only a short walk to the Metro stop at Plaza Italia.

This is a great 1-bedroom, everything worked, was modern and comfortable. The terrace upstairs is nice. The building's gym was serviceable enough for some workouts. The building manager was helpful in finding local stores.

We stayed in Maria's apartment for 10 days in mid-October.  The apartment was exactly as pictured within the listing.  The location was perfect... very close to the subway line and within walking distance to innumerable restaurants and retailers.  Special shout out to Lucianna (the property manager) and Fernando (on-site caretaker), both of whom were very professional and attentive to our requirements!

We had a great time staying at this well equipped apartment in Buenos Aires. The apartment was clean, sunny, and quite. The location was great. Subway stops are just a short walk. There are plenty of restaurants in the area, and the grocery store is close by. Furthermore, Luciana who checked us in was a pleasure to deal with - prompt, friendly, easy-going, and helpful. I highly recommend this property!

Probably one of the nicest apartment I have ever stayed in, we begged to stay longer but it was booked out. It looks exactly like the photos, great pool area, comfortable living area and the roof top terrace is spectacular. I would recommend this apartment to anyone. Maria and Daniel were also great to deal with, they recommended places to go. The neighborhood is one of the best in BA safe and close to everything, lots of shops, cafes, bars, restaurant, buses and subways.

You wont find a nicer place in BA........10/10
Well located, secure and well appointed.  Exactly as advertised.

Our stay may not have begun brilliantly, a server error meant the administrator was unaware of my arrival (and so the place was delightfully dirty) and it took some time to gain access to the property. However, Fernando (security), Maria (owner) and Luciana (manager) worked seriously hard to make the rest of our stay as comfortable as possible. The cleaner did an amazing job in the morning and Maria very kindly refunded a day and a halves fees by way of apology, which was much appreciated. The place is fantastic! Looks just like the pictures, lots of space and light, great gym and pool facilities and right in the centre of all the shops, restaurants etc. Plus the rooftop space is incredible! Great for lounging in the sun and making asados on the huge BBQ. on our last day Fernando even let us store our luggage safely for the day until we got our transfer. We would definitely come back.
The Maria's apartment is super cool. It's very clean, organized and conveniently located in a lovely neighborhood. I recommend this apartment in a heartbeat.

We enjoyed our stay at Marias penthouse flat and the efficient communication with the administrator. The flat was clean, quiet, with nice furniture, good wifi and TV channels. We liked the nice pool and the big upstairs terrace with a good barbeque, which we used every evening to grill the excellent beef we bought. The area is the best in BA, in our opinion, and we would like to stay here again next time.

We were very happy and satisfied with staying in this great flat and appartment building, that is brand new and very clean and safe.
The roof terrasse was of course fantastic, but I like to point out what we was far most happy for in this flat, and witch is hard to come by in Palermo, was the fact that the bedroom was compleatly quiet and no noice from the road to be heard, and the wonderful blind curtains that made the room dark! I wold definetly stay there again!

It's a modern and bright apartment with everything you need. Absolutely gorgeous is the huge terrace on the roof of the apartment.
Luciana, the responsible on behalf of the owners, was very friendly and helpful.

We really enjoyed our stay in Buenos Aires. The apartment was perfect and the location was perfect. We were met by Luciana who gave us an excellent introduction to the apartment - she also assisted us with getting a taxi when we left for home. We would highly recommend this apartment.

Thanks,
Diane

What a magnificent apartment!! We thoroughly enjoyed our stay from start to finish. Every detail of the flat was exceptional and we can not speak highly enough of this accomodation. The terrace is stunning and flat is really spacious. Luciana and Maria were very, very helpful and friendly.
Wonderful place. In the middle of beautiful Palermo Soho. I felt like home from the very beginning. Everything is modern, clean and comfortable. And the roof terrace is a paradise.

An amazing apartment in a great location in Palermo Soho. Close to everything you could need and the rooftop terrace is perfect place to relax and look out over the city! Host responded quickly and building management was very helpful! Perfect stay. Thanks Maria

This was a really lovely place and the communication with Maria throughout was top notch. The real selling point was the rooftop terrace which does not disappoint. The location is also fantastic and felt very safe.

We had a great time there and hope to come back soon! Para os brasileiros, o apartamento é excelente, com ótima localização e tem de tudo o que se precisa! Luciana que nos recepcionou foi muito atenciosa com todos os detalhes e com toda ajuda que precisamos no decorrer de nossa estadia. Recomendamos!
Thanks Luciana for everything!
Hermoso departamento en la mejor zona de buenos aires, Fernando esta en recepción 24horas y resuelve cualquier cosita! María y Luciana también toda la disponibilidad, seguro regresaremos ahí!

This is a lovely place. Great location. Very safe. Has access to a small gym, swimming pool and has its own roof top terrace. The weather was cold-ish when I was there, but apartment was warm, with air conditioner / heater in main room and bedroom. The place is clean and comfortable, with wi-fi. I'd stay there again.

This apartment was very clean, spacious, and conveniently located - we were greeted when we arrived and given a tour of the apartment and gym/laundry facilities. The terrace is beautiful - we only wish it was warmer outside so we could have spent more time there! Everything was well organized and Maria emailed us throughout the duration of our stay to check in and see if we needed anything.

The apartment is more or less as depicted in the pictures. You will be dealing with Luciana, the apartment manager, and not Maria, the owner. Luciana is responsive, but does not respond as quickly as other airbnb people I have dealt with.

The apartment is very nice, and the upstairs balcony with BBQ and cabana is a plus. The location is also nice: 7-8 minutes to the subway and a few blocks walk to the heart of Palermo Soho. It is also pretty quiet.

The experience was great. I only had an issue with the stove not working, but Luciana called the electrician to fix it.

It is definitely a nice apartment. I wouldn't hesitate to boo it!

Maria was very helpful in answering my messages before the reservation. The apartment was great, clean, ready to use. Just a little problem with the delivery of the keys. But it was a very good a experience!

Great location in the heart of Palermo. 4 blocks away from Plaza Italia station.  Always felt safe in the neighborhood. Checking and checkout went smoothly. First experience with airbnb was wonderful. For approximately $500 for a week, I felt like I had a vacation home in Buenos Aires.
Muito bom!!! Ótimo apartamento, excelente recepção da anfitriã, muito bem localizado em Palermo Soho! Super indicado, limpo amplo, excelente terraço! Com certeza retornarei!

Sehr geehrtes airbnb-Team,
Wir haben 2 1/2 Wochen in diesem Appartement verbracht und es keinen Tag bereut. Palermo ist ein wunderbar ruhiger Stadtteil und die Wohnung war eine regelrechte Oase der Erholung, auch wenn man die Kinder der nahe gelegenen Schule an den Wochentagen durchaus hören konnte. Für unser tägliches Sporttrainung - unabdingbar für die abendlichen Tangomilongas - gibt es einen Fitnessraum, wenngleich mit verbesserungsfähigen Geräten, dafür ist der vom Hausmeister Fernando bestens gepflegte Pool optimal. Alles in allem eine sehr schöne Wohnung.
Angela u. K.H.becker
It was wonderful! A perfect location, beautiful and clean place, and overall a great time.

La ubicación es perfecta, a pocas cuadras del metro y de la Plaza Serrano, en un barrio bien entretenido con muchos bares, restaurantes, tiendas, almacenes, etc.  El departamento es cómodo y  acogedor, todo impecable!

Amazing location for good food and wine around. Good building security everything was fine and as described.
Palermo is not cheap: stores, restaurants, bars and night-clubs - don't go there if you are not used to stay in this kind of neighbourhood. If you like this stuff... super!
Cheers
The Palermo neighborhood is great for guests with easy access to the subway and many restaurants! Candela is very responsive and helpful. It was very easy and convenient to stay here.

Candela was a wonderful host and gave us lots of information about the neighborhood and checked in several times to make sure everything was satisfactory. Although we did not meet in person, the check in process was easy and everyone in the building was very nice.  I am very happy we spent our month in Buenos Aires here and would highly recommend it to other guests!

Como lo exprese en una reseña de mi estadía en este apartamento en el 2015, el apartamento es moderno, con lindos acabados y muy bien mantenido, en un edificio como n excelente gimnasio y piscina, en una zona linda de la ciudad y de fácil acceso por transporte público. Candela ha siempre sido muy amable. La comunicación siempre fue fácil y efectiva. Es mi segundo semestre como huésped en este apartamento, lo recomiendo y de estar disponible, espero sea nuevamente mi casa en BsAs.
Excelente departamento tanto en ubicacion (2 cuadras del metrobus y subte) como confort (amenities del edificio).  Candela y Gaston siempre muy atentos en todo! Sin duda volveria a hospedarme!
Excelente departamento. Estuve casi 2 meses. Lo recomiendo 100%. Candela y Gaston estuvieron siempre predispuestos. Gracias por todo!
perfect location, looks exactly like the pictures, very safe and secure, best views in the city from rooftop gym.

I love this place.
The internet works well, which is extremely important for me because I work from the apartment where I run my business.
The apartment is spacious, in a nice part of Palermo. I LOVE the exterior wall windows so I always have a view of outside. And the view from the gym on the top floor is spectacular.
The apartment is as shown in the pictures, and Candela is always helpful whenever I need anything.

Repeat business is the best compliment you can give. I stayed in Candela's apartment, and then promptly booked it again for a longer stay.
And I wholeheartedly look forward to booking it a 3rd time for an extended stay.
The apartment is wonderful. The building g is great. And Candela is a fabulous host.
It was a wonderful experience all around.

Another amazing semester at this fantastic apartment. Great location, easy/close to public transportation and outdoor green spaces. Great amenities and Candela has always been the best hostess, prompt to respond and always helpful. Highly recommended!

I loved my time at this apartment. This was my secret and stay and i loved it so much the last time, i was delighted to come back.
It felt like home. The apartment, the building, the staff - everyone was wonderful and I was thankful to be in this space for almost a full year on this trip.
Candela is a fantastic host, she communicated well with me, and went above and beyond to make sure I had everything I needed for an enjoyable stay.
I can't recommend this space enough.
The location and views are tough to beat!
Great place and hospitality!
Had a great stay at Candela's place. Candela and Marcelo were very accommodating during my stay - would recommend!
El lugar muy bien ubicado, el edificio seguro, el gimnasio tiene una vista impresionante! Candela y Marcelo muy atentos. Pase excelente. Muy recomendado.
Fantastic apartment, perfect location, pool and gym are a huge bonus too!

I LOVED this apartment. It has so much natural light with really modern features and nice furniture. The building is really nice with an amazing gym and a nice pool. The location is absolutely perfect, right by Plaza Italia and not too far from the park. The shops, restaurants and bars in Soho are within 10 minutes walking, and Hollywood is not too far either. This place felt like a home 100%. Can't recommend it enough!

Gostaria de agradecer muito a atenção e o cuidado que Candela e Marcelo tiveram conosco, sempre muito prestativos e atenciosos. O local é ótimo, muito bem localizado, o apartamento também é excelente, com ar condicionado e calefação em nenhum momento passamos frio ou calor, a banheira é uma delícia. A única coisa não perfeita são as cortinas da sala translúcidas que não bloqueiam todo sol, tirando esse detalhe todo resto foi perfeito! Obrigada, Candela e Marcelo! Foi inesquecível!
Increíble departamento e increíble atención de Candela.
Candela es muy amable y la comunicación y atención fue excelente. El departamento es bello y está ubicado en una excelente zona.

We loved Candela’s apartment! It was perfect for a 2 week stay in Buenos Aires. Awesome location, and nice to have a gym and pool access. The host was very proactive in checking us in and helping us get settled for our stay. The building is nice and close to many restaurants and parks. Would stay again!
Candela y Marcelo fueron muy amables, atentos, flexibles y cumplidores en absolutamente todo. Sin duda intentaremos repetir cuando volvamos a alojarnos en Buenos Aires!

Candela and her staff were are great and nice they were responsive and flexible. The apartment was clean and just like the photos. Great building with a pool and really good location. I would definitely come back. Thanks for a great stay.

Great stay- the apartment itself is clean, modern and secure. There is 24/7 security and it's in a great neighborhood.
Also, located near everything you need- grocery stores, a gym, and restaurants. A quick walk to the area that is full of bars and restaurants but two of my favorite restaurants in BA are within two blocks (La Carniceria and Las Pizarras)
What really made the stay great were the apartment managers. Whatever you needed they were so helpful.
I would definitely stay here again.
Gorgeous apartment and amazing location! Staff was super friendly and the weekly cleaning service was great! Would definitely stay again!

Just finished a great 2.5 month stay at Candela's apartment in Palermo Soho. So happy we stayed here, as others have mentioned it feels like home as soon as you walk in. Candela was always very responsive along with the management team in the building. The apartment itself is very comfortable, plus having 24 hour security, an outdoor pool and a gym on the 31st floor with views over the city was amazing. The area is perfect being only a short walk to restaurants, bars, shops and parks. Look forward to staying again on the next trip to Buenos Aires!

Candela’s place was great for a short term stay! Her communication was top notch. The location is good, about 10-15 minutes walk away from the cafes, restaurant and bars. Good Wi-Fi. Would have preferred that the couch faced the tv but at the end of the day not a big deal! Nice host and staff.
Best place in Palermo SoHo!
This was a great place in a great location! Carmela was super helpful with a small wifi issue I had which was solved within minutes. Great building, would stay here again!

I stayed for 80 nights. I would highlight these benefits/amenities... Great Location - safe and walkable to whatever you need. Great host - Candela or the building staff are available when you need them. Clean apartment - No clutter and housekeeping comes to clean and change the linens/towels weekly. Nice modern building on guarded property - Great gym, nice pool, laundry facilities available.
I would absolutely be happy to stay at Candela's apartment again in the future. If I get back to Buenos Aires then I will certainly check the availability of Candela's apartment. For me it was a wonderful stay.

I had a great time at Candela's apartment. The hosts are very responsive and accommodating. The place has everything you need for an extended stay. There is a gym on one of the top floors with a fantastic view of the city and a reasonably large pool downstairs. The apartment is very safe, and the location is hard to beat.
There are plenty of shops, restaurants, and bars within walking distance. You are only 2-3 blocks from the Santa Fe Subte station, plus plenty of buses, taxis, and Ubers are available in the area. If I return to Buenos Aires, I will certainly stay here again.

El lugar de Candela es hermoso. Caminamos siempre a restaurantes, parques y bares ya que está muy bien ubicado. El internet funcionó de maravilla para tomar nuestras juntas y trabajar en línea. Sin duda me volvería a quedar aquí si regreso a Buenos Aires. Candela siempre estuvo muy al pendiente de nuestra estadía y nos ayudó mucho que fuera flexible con el check out! Muchas gracias por todo! Un viaje increíble
Excellent stay, great host and very accommodating.

We had a wonderful stay at Candela's place. The apartment and amenities were just as described, and everyone we interacted with was excellent. Although we encountered a few issues, there was always someone available just a text away to help us resolve them. The addition of the weekly cleaning service was a bonus, and the amenities made it great value overall. Thank you very much!

Happy House was an amazing experience ! The apartment is well located in Palermo, super cosy and nice !
And Manuel is the nicest person that you can meet in Buenos Aires for sure, he was always ready to help us, give us some advice !

Happy House is THE place to stay for sure!

We stayed in Maria's apartment for 5 nights which is well located in the lovely area of Palermo. The apartment was a good size, the kitchen was useful and well equipped, the shower was great, as was the wifi. Luciana was there to greet us - she was really nice, showed us around and was very helpful. The apartment is close to restaurants, bars, cafes and only a few blocks from the nearest metro station. There are also lots of nice parks nearby for running and cycling. Would highly recommend to anyone going to BA.

The neighborhood was great in the middle of Palermo. The apartment was in decent condition. You need to buy dish detergent, toilet paper and toiletries. Please double check how many towels are given and if they have any stains. Maria emailed me after ckeckout saying she would charge me $40USD for the small towel that wasn't even given to me. I checked one of the most upscale department stores, Gallarias. Small towels were priced between $8 to $12 US. I asked why she wanted to charge me $40 and she said it is the price for the whole set. I said I wasn't even given the small towel and she later said it was the big towel that had stains. I said to her that I could buy a brand new towel then she didn't need to charge $40 and she lowered the price to $25. As I knew it was still overpriced, I asked her what was wrong with replacing the towel. She replied I could do that after I left Buenos Aires.

I wouldn't stay there again. If I ever do, I would count numbers of spoons, forks, pillows, etc. That...

Luciana was awesome! Our flight was cancelled so we checked in much later than our agreed upon time by Luciana was very flexible. The building is very modern and safe. The neighborhood is very trendy lots of great restaurants, boutiques and wineries. It's also within a short walking distance to the subway and other amenities. The apartment was very clean and felt very homey. The terrace is a great place to sip some malbec, even in winter!
Excellent experience, the apartment is in a top location. Also it is in top conditions and very well equipped . Thanks to our host.

Very nice apartment in the absolute perfect location to explore the amazing food and drinks of Buenos Aires. I fully recommend this place, with the only negative being that the building management goes a little nuts with very strong "floral" air freshener in the hallways every morning.

The location is ideal to go out in Palermo Soho and not too far away from the subway. The welcome was made by Luciana who was very clear in showing us the flat and making sure we will be at our ease.
There is a laundry room however you need 4x$2 coins (to wash) and another $8 for drying. Believe me, we really struggled to find the $2 coins as there are quite rare so save them when you get them! This was the only downside of the flat!
Internet connection was very good as well as all the other amenities in the flat.
Overall it was a great flat to do our tour of BA, definitely would recommend it!

The apartment is accurately described and is in a fantastic location in Palermo, easy walking distance to a great selection of bars and restaurants. It's ideal for the convention center and around 6 blocks from a subway. The apartment is very secure, safe and very well equipped.

There are black out blinds in the bedroom, which is faced away from a main street so therefore relatively protected from street noise.

I would recommend to anyone wanting a stay in this area of Palermo.

Nice quiet neighbourhood, close to main activities. Lovely place with an accurate description as to what it was.
Comfortable bed and all facilities that were required.
Luciana was really helpful in booking a car form the aiport for us and Manuela organised one on the way back.
Modern comfortable stay

This is a fantastic location in the heart of Palermo and close to Plaza Italia with buses and subway access.  We are a couple in our 60's and walked many places.  We really enjoyed the neighborhood with coffee shops (LatteNte on Thames) and the restaurants all within the area.  The apt has good light and it was always fun arriving home.  We stayed for 2 months in Nov and Dec, enjoyed the pool, the weight room and outside roof deck.  The roof deck was lovely in the late afternoon to sit out reading.  The house manager, Luciana, was so helpful.
Great apartment, with super terrace.  Maria/Luciana were very accommodating on check-in and check-out times.  Excellent area, very buzzy.  Would highly recommend.

On behalf of Maria, Luciana made us very welcome and gave us a comprehensive explanation of the setup. The apartment block itself is ultra-safe, good sized swimming pool and an easy walk to the metro. Many good restaurants dotted all around, supermarket only 5 mins.

Apartment is excellent, everything you need, with the bonus of a large roof terrace, perfect after a swim! Highly recommended.

This is a great apartment in what we consider is the best area in BA.
This is our 5th - 5 week trip to BA in the past 6 years. The apartment is as pictured, very clean and well equipped. Appreciated the expresso maker, juicer and blender not usually found but so nice when staying for 5 weeks. Check in and out was very simple and on time. The area is simply the best as there is lots to do within walking distance and the D-Line offers easy access to many other nice areas for exploration.
For those considering a trip but concerned about safety we have now spent 25 weeks in BA. We have walked many miles exploring and taking pictures and have never had a concern even returning from restaurents at night. Have used the subway over 100 times and as we are 76 and 68 are offered seats almost as soon as we get on. This sure does not happen in Vancouver, Canada!!

Great apartment in a pleasant area with plenty of restaurants nearby, a five block walk down to the Metro, but there were also plenty of buses that go from Plaza Italia to anywhere you want.  Very secure. The terrace upstairs was great for breakfasts and relaxing.  We were there more than three weeks and would stay there again.  The only thing we found difficulty with was getting enough coins for the washing machine, but we could take our washing to the launderette down the road and have it washed dried and ironed for about $3 a load.

My husband and I had a wonderful stay here on our honeymoon! Fantastic location, everything as described, very secure and well equipped. Loved the terrace! Very friendly neighbors even accepted our lost luggage from our airline and brought it to our apartment.

We had a great time in this apartment for 5 nights.  Maria and Luciana were fantastic with communication. Luciana gave a great rundown of the apartment when we checked in. The apartment is clean, modern and has all the amenities for a week long stay. Wifi is strong and the security on the building is very good. The apartment is in a convenient location for exploring the palermo soho area.  Supermarket and restaurants are close by. We would have stayed for the 2 nights when we came back to BA but they only do 3 nights stay. Thanks for having us!

Excellent location convenient to good shopping and dining options as well as a few minutes walk to the subway. Perfect romantic getaway for two people with a large private terrace upstairs. Set back off an already quiet street overlooking a calm courtyard in a secure building. The grocery store, hardware store, and pharmacy we used were located within a few blocks. Communication with Maria was prompt and Luciana was very helpful and spoke good English. We also had no problem finding taxis, even when we had an early morning flight out.
Great city apartment in a very vibrant part of town. Perfect for a couple and the host was excellent. Would highly recommend

Excellent easy check in. Beautiful location in wonderful area of Palermo with many shops, restaurants, cafes close by and easy walk to subway and beautiful parks. The apartment was clean, modern, spacious, safe, quiet, with beautiful rooftop terrace exactly as described.would highly recommend and definitely would stay here again.easy communication with host, easy check out, and no problems.

La comunicación con Maria fue muy fluida y contesto a todas mis preguntas. El Check-in funciono perfectamente. El apartamento es exactamente como en el anuncio. El barrio es claramente muy lindo y el apartamento esta en el centro de todo (bares, restos, cerca del metro, parque....). La experiencia fue excelente.
Great apartment and great location.  Everyone was accommodating to my plans, great stay.

Wonderful apartment!  The location was perfect, the private terrace sensational, the building very nice, and the apartment itself comfortable (and quite quiet).   Arrival and departure were handled very professionally.  I want to stay there again as soon as possible!

I just got back from Argentina and staying here. I can tell you we enjoyed our experience immensely wish we had more time.... Next time I will come back longer
The host was very accommodating as we arrived very late to Argentina and the host was able to accommodate such a late entry thanks Maria
Also the accommodation was really nice and everything worked as expected and the location was very central to all Palermo bars.
I have nothing but praises for this place and host and we had no issues all troubles at all all our needs were quickly resolved by the host. If you come here make sure you learn how to cook a nice asado (bbq) as they have a parilla which we didn't get a chance to use ...
Thank you host Maria

We enjoyed our time in Maria's apartment and found it very comfortable and well located in the Palermo Soho neighbourhood, close to restaurants, grocery stores and other amenities. The rooftop patio was great, with the couch area under cover so we were able to enjoy it even when it was not so nice outside.

Viajamos con cierta frecuencia a Buenos Aires. Nos hemos hospedado en distintos apartamentos, pero este es uno de los mejores, sino el mejor. Está muy bien situado dentro de Palermo; el edificio es moderno y tiene facilidades como terraza para asados, piscina y gimnasio. Estábamos en invierno, pero en verano debe ser aún mejor. Muy recomendado.
Great Experience!
This location in the middle of Palermo Soho is fantastic, and Maria made sure we had a great experience!

La experiencia estuvo perfecta!
El departamento como tal, la limpieza, la atención prestada y todos los servicios descritos, se recibieron a satisfacción.
La zona, muy céntrica, amigable.
El encargado del edificio, Fernando, un tipo muy amable y servicial.
Recomendado 100%.
Muchas gracias!!
Hermoso y acojedor depto.... ideal para descanso y reuniones

Tanto María como Luciana son unas excelentes anfitrionas, en constante comunicación y muy predispuestas para lo que se necesite. El departamento es muy lindo, luminoso, limpio y cómodo. Posee una terraza muy linda que por falta de tiempo no llegue a aprovechar al máximo. Está ubicado en la mejor zona de Palermo, cerca de la zona de los restaurantes a los cuales se puede acceder caminando, también está a muy pocas cuadras de la parada de subte?

The apartment was sparkling clean, comfortable and is located in a great area. Pick up of the keys was quick and easy, and communication was open and welcoming to any questions or help that we needed. Highly recommended!
good location, very friendly landlady, great area. we recommend it and would love to be back one day.

Our stay at Maria's was fantastic. Both Maria and Luciana were easy to work with. Communication was quick and both went above and beyond in various circumstances. The apartment is relatively new and is located in a convenient place between Palermo Soho and Palermo Hollywood, and just around the corner from Don Julio and lots of small Kiosks where you can buy fruit and snacks. The area is also frequented by taxis early and late in the day. Thanks Maria and Luciana!

This place was perfect! It was located in a great neighborhood. You can walk to some amazing coffee shops and restaurants. There was a safe located inside the apartment for your valuables but the building is super secure and safe. The host has several power adapters if you forget yours. We had brought one but having another one was very helpful. We did an early check in, after a very long flight, that was super helpful as well. The deck is very private for relaxing. We didn't get a chance to use the sauna or pool but can't wait to come back!

This apartment is nice and is located in a lovely area with very good access to lots of great bars and restaurants. Because of its central location it is also within walking distance of some of the beautiful parks in Buenos Aires. Unfortunately there is a 'but'. The biggest issue for my wife and I was the security side of things. None of the windows or sliding doors were lockable. We did have access to a safe in the bedroom and there were security cameras in the building however I feel that if you are renting out your property to guests they should at the very least be able to lock up the property. Also we were very disappointed with the rooftop area (which was actually the reason we booked this place). It was dirty, the deck chairs broken (which we were told would be replaced after our stay- unfortunately not much use to us!), and the cushions for the dining chairs were found on the ground, covered in mould. This apartment has potential but definitely needs some TLC to bring it up to the standard that we ...

This apartment is great, we chose it because of the location and roof terrace and they don't disappoint! It's a perfect size for a couple or single person and everything was clean and tidy. It was a little less personal than some places we have stayed, but the host was really helpful and easy to contact.

El departamento de Maria es super cómodo. Esta muy bien ubicado en un gran barrio de Buenos Aires y completamente accesible con transporte publico. No conocimos a Maria pero estuvimos en contacto sin problemas y hay gente a cargo en Buenos Aires.
La terraza es sin dudas lo mejor, perfecta para hacer asados con amigos. Hay detalles menores de mantenimiento pero Maria respondió rápidamente y se solucionaron. Muy recomendable!
O apartamento, bem localizado em Palermo, a duas quadras do metrô Bulnes, é uma ótima opção de estadia em Buenos Aires. Manuel foi muito atencioso e acolhedor com minha família e eu.

Fiquei 6 noites no apartamento e foi uma experiência excelente!! Ele é muito bem localizado, perto de tudo, numa região maravilhosa. A mobilia do apartamento é linda e tem tudo na cozinha para funcionar muito bem. Sugiro apenas uma revisão nas toalhas de banho que estão muito gastas. Mas valeu a pena a hospedagem e o Manuel é muito educado e simpático !

El apto Happy Hose en Palermo estuvo excelente, tal cual como lo vimos en esta pagina, esta super bien ubicado con todo bien  accesible, supermercado, restaurantes, cafes etc, a una cuadra de la v Sta Fe que es bien conveniente y a una cuadra del Shopping Alto Palermo, pero el plus del apto es Manuel, quien es un chico super amable y educado, nos dio unos tips bien buenos, no  encanto compartir con el .

This was the first time we rented a apartment through Airbnb, but its not going to be the last!

Manuel has been the most amazing host, he is allways there to help you with whatever you need. Here you really feel at home and welcome! He has taken us with him to meet his friends and to barbecues, wich has really been great! He had prepared everything so nice when we got here..he even has a tin of joy ( La lata de la alegria)..that we actually manage to empty!

The Happy House is better than you can imagine, and if we could choose, we'll stay here forever! Mercedes has done a incredible job with the decorating, colors and style. Its beautiful, has lots of space and everything works as it should. The apartment is light and clean.

The location is amazing, close to everything and really easy to get around. There are super markets, cafes, parks, subways and buses, shopping and a cinema just around the corner. Its also a reasonably quiet street, so trafic and noise wont bother yo...

juste parfait.
just perfect

nice and sweet people, very helpful.
l'attention mise à l'accueil, à tout ce qui peut aider l'installation dans l'appartement : des choses simples comme du savon dans la salle de bains et de l'huile dans la cuisine, Mercedes et Manuel nous avaient mis de l'eau au frais, acheté une bière... bref. assez rare, comme accueil.
Great location, very clean house, Mercedes is a great host, absolutely recommended for any duration.

Manuel and Mercedes were perfect hosts: quick to respond to any inquiry before and during my stay, flexible, friendly and very welcoming, and offering plenty of advice. The apartment is well located, very comfortable, and fitted with all conveniences. For a hassle-free stay in BA, I couldn't recommend Happy House more highly. Thanks Mercedes!

Spent two weeks at Happy House. The house was well appointed and well situated next to a subway, several grocery stores and a variety of restaurants, bars and cafes. It is also quite central and close to Palermo Soho and Hollywood. Check in and check out was easy. The owner really took care in making my stay a pleasant one.  Since she knew I was going to be working from the apartment, she even took the time to rearrange the living room ahead of my arrival - without me having to ask - so that my work desk would be well positioned next to a window. My flight out of Buenos Aires was at night, and there was absolutely no problems when I asked to check out at 6pm. The Internet is a bit slow, but still works well for sending emails and surfing the Web.  I'd have no problems recommending the apartment to anyone going to Buenos Aires.

I was at the Mercedes home 4 days and I felt at home.
The apartment is very comfortable, the location is great for exploring the city and Mercedes is available for any information.
I would recommend staying in the apartment of Mercedes at all.

I had a lovely week at Happy House! Manuel and Mercedes were perfect hosts: attentive, quick to respond to any inquiry before and during my stay, flexible, friendly, honest, very welcoming, and offering plenty of advice. The apartment is beautifully, great location (near shops, Sta Fe, Alto Palermo shopping and tube station), very comfortable, and fitted with all conveniences. I warmly and highly recommend Happy House and I Iook forward to my next stay. Thanks Manuel and Mercedes!

Nuestra estadía en la “Happy House” fue estupenda. Nos atendieron de maravilla y se mostraron muy flexibles ante nuestro repentino cambio de planes. Tanto Mercedes como Manuel estuvieron siempre atentos y dispuestos a ayudarnos. La casa es muy cómoda y posee todo lo necesario para ser acogedora y a la vez práctica. Muy recomendable.

Both Mercedes and Manuel were very welcoming guests.

The happy house is a peaceful place in the middle of BA - Palermo and a great base for exploring the city.

Thanks a lot,
Stijn & Katrien

I really have to say that this acccomodation in Buenos Aires made my trip. Location is great, so many restaurants around and bars and clubs to live the amazing nightlife in BA but the real pearl about this apt wa the quiet, the silence around, the spacious and luminous apartment, the private terrace upstairs, the new and well
Refined space, the amazing pool which most of the time was empty so it felt like I had a private pool and wellness center all by myself. Last but not least the amazing Manuela who took care of us even if our flight hab 4 hours delay!! She waited for us to check in till 2,30 am and she was understanding, kind, smiling and super super accommodating. I think I would go back to Buenos Aires only if this same apartment will be again available. Thanks for everything.
Ps: the pictures really don't give justice of the place and the pool. They are much better in real life. Enjoy Buenos Aires and remember that just 2 streets from this apt you have one of the best restaurant of Bueno...

Excellent quartier près de tout.
La piscine est très bien
Le métro est 700 mètres
Tous les restaurants et bars sont à proximités.

El departamento esta ubicado en una zona muy buena, tiene restaurantes cerca, librerias,  tiendas lindas ...etc, el edificio es inmejorable, la zona de ginmasio es muy buena, los vecinos y el conserje realmente  gente muy querida y educada , el apartamento es lindo, cuenta con todo lo que uno necesita y la terraza es un espacio que uno puede realmente aprovechar, el precio corresponde a lo que ofrece. Totalmente recomendado.
Maria's apartment was perfect! It's in a great neighborhood with lots of restaurants and shops and has a wonderful roof deck! Maria was extremely responsive and helpful!
This a great place, a little loft with a rooftop terrace and one can cook and work--- great days here!
Todo impecable . Muy recomendable .

This apartment was in a good position and good location close to many shops and restaurants. it is a safe place to stay, well secured, my partner and I loved staying there and we would stay there and again. Thanks María and Luciana for your hospitality. Keep up the great work !
Mark & Denesse

Maria's apartment was perfect for our short stay in Buenos Aires. We have only stayed in Palermo Hollywood on our previous visits, so it was nice to try a different neighborhood this time. Soho has lots of restaurants and bars plus fabulous shopping. The upstairs terrace is a great bonus to have along with the swimming pool, especially if you are there in the summer time. The streets of Buenos Aires can be noisy, but Maria's apartment is in the back of the building so it is nice and quiet. I would highly recommend staying at Maria's apartment if you are traveling to Buenos Aires.

El depto es muy lindo y muy amplio, ademas de estar muy bien equipado. Tiene todo para pasar unos días agradables. En cuanto a la ubicación, el barrio es muy lindo, rodeado de restaurantes y esta cerca de los transportes publicos. Muy recomendable!!

We loved this apartment! It's in the best area near so many good coffee shops, bars and restaurants. It's very secure and the hosts answer your questions really quickly. It was clean, spacious and had everything we needed. Would highly recommend.
Great location, clean. Small and sweet with an amazing terrace, perfect for asados and relaxing.

Maria's place was the perfect home away from home. The location, close to everything you would need when visiting Buenos Aires. The rooftop patio was amazing and such a relaxing space. We had questions and arranged taxis for us. It truly made our trip to Argentina. Thank you.

ALTAMENTE RECOMENDABLE.
Amplio, cómodo y con una terraza GENIAL.

Palermo Soho es fascinante.
Luciana ha sido encantadora y pendiente de todo.
Muchas gracias

Everything was great! Exactly as described. The apartment is really nice. Loved the terrace, the parrilla and pool. Also the neighborhood is very convenient and safe. No issues at all. Would definitely recommend it.

We thoroughly enjoyed staying in Maria’s app. It is very comfortable and close to great places to eat and enjoy. The terrace and swimming pool were such a bonus. Luciana was very professional, attentive and thorough to show us around. We will definitely come back!

Wir haben eine tolle Zeit dort verbracht. Wir wurden freundlich empfangen! Die Lage ist TOP und sehr zentral.
Vor allem die große private Terrasse hat uns sehr gefallen. Ein Sonnenschirm und ein Gartenschlauch wäre noch toll gewesen. Das Internetmodem sollte ausgetauscht werden, es stürzt häufig ab. Die Unterkunft ist sehr zu empfehlen.
Wir kommen gerne wieder!

We were met on arrival at the apartment and given a thorough check in and overview of the building.
The location is great with plenty of shops, bars and restaurants in walking distance.
The apartment itself was clean, tidy and plenty of space for 2 people. The terrace area is great to relax at any time of the day.
Overall a positive and enjoyable experience. Would recommend!

Maria's place is exactly as pictured, the rooftop terrace is awesome for afternoon sunbathing or evening lounging (we were there in January). It is sparsely furnished but functional, and a perfect size for one or two people. Maria and Luciana are excellent with communication over WhatsApp and were extremely flexible with our check-in, ensuring we could get into the apartment well after midnight when we first arrived!
Maria's place has a unique location and terrace.

Fueron días increíbles! El departamento es tal cuál se ve en fotos e incluso mejor! Es un espacio para disfrutar al máximo sobre todo la terraza privada con el asador! La atención es excelente, Luciana es una chica muy atenta y amable. La ubicación es INMEJORABLE! Cerca de restaurantes, locales y vida nocturna pero a la vez la calle del departamento es silenciosa y tranquila. Tiene supermercados, farmacias y kiosco en la esquina! Deseando volver pronto! Gracias por todo.
Muy confortable el depto de María veracidad en todo lo que ofrece

We had a great time at Maria's apartment.
The area is really cool, with supermarkets, bars, shops and restaurants at walk distance.
Really recommended!

Apartamento lindo, acima das minhas expectativas, acho que é o melhor apartamento do airn'b que já fiquei! Espaço excelente, um terraço ótimo,, além de dentro ter tudo, super bem cuidado, decorado e novo. Localização excelente tb, portaria, tudo, indicaria pra quem fosse a Buenos Aires! Cama e travesseiros mt bom e limpos tb! Aquecimento, tudo ótimo e em ótimo estado!
Ótimo apartamento, melhor localização para vida noturna em Buenos Aires.
Impecable en todo sentido, con terraza propia y parrilla. Todo funciona perfectamente. La zona excelente. No lo duden.
Lovely terrace!! 100% recommended!

The apartment is just exactly as the picture shows -or even better¡-. Everything was clean and perfect. Location is a plus, just 2 blocks from bars, restaurants and trendy stores of Palermo.
Maria and Luciana were super hosts, always available to solve any problem or assist with recommendations. The building has also gym and sauna, the terrace is an amazing place to enjoy with friends and grill an Argentinean Asado¡
I will definitely stay again in this beautiful apartment¡

Excelente apartamento! Confortável, com tudo o necessário e com uma ótima localização, bem próximo a bares, restaurantes, metrô, mercado, etc. Voltaria com certeza.
Excelente apartamento! Confortable, con todo lo necesario y con una gran ubicación, muy cerca de bares, restaurantes, metro, mercado, etc. Volvería con seguridad.
Excellent apartment! Comfortable, with everything we needed and a great location, right next to bars, restaurants, subway, market, etc. I would go back for sure.

Maria’s apartment is just like the photos represent. The location could not be better as it is right in the heart of the trendy Palermo area. Maria was in touch throughout although I didn’t meet her. Luciana was there to let me in and she took me through the whole procedure.
Many great tv channels in English which was a nice surprise. Great coffee shop (Padre) on the corner. Lots of bars and good restaurants within a few minutes walk and Plaza Serrano is close as well. Fernando, the doorman, is helpful as well but he speaks zero English so brush up on Spanish if you want to converse with him!
Bed is comfortable as is the shower. And having the private terrace is a really nice touch if you want to chill out up there.
For the money, it’s a great place to stay. I would absolutely stay here again if visiting Buenos Aires.
Espaço ótimo , confortável, ensolarado, silencioso , e numa localização fantástica , próximo de cafés e restaurantes de excelente qualidade. Espero retornar um dia.

Apartamento con una ubicación excelente. Cuenta con todos los servicios y oportunidades de ocio. Es tal cual se muestra en las fotografías. La anfitriona fue muy atenta y estuvo pendiente en todo momento. Lo recomiendo sin duda.
Maria’ place is a great gem in Palermo. The apartment has its own terrace with BBQ gril and full of amenities. Luciana was there to help with everything! I' definitely stay again.
Mi departamento en Palermo, y no se extraña la parrilla, porque tiene terraza con parrilla propia, la mejor elección !!

We found the apartment an absolutely ideal base for our five day stay in Buenos Aires. The neighbourhood is perfect - lots going on and a huge variety of restaurants, shops and bars, but more chilled out than the city centre. The apartment had everything we needed and the roof terrace was a serious bonus after a busy day's sightseeing. Would highly recommend.
Maria’s place was in a great location in Palermo. There were some issues with check in but she helped resolve them within a few hours. The space is large and clean.
big recommandation. everything you need is there. we will come back!!!
Great location.  Very comfortable, bright and sunny spartment. And a beautiful private terrace.

It was my 13th time with airbnb in BA an Maria’s Flat was really the best location of all.
The flat is perfect!
Near Plaza Serrano, supermarkets, bars restaurant and shops.
The house is very secure and also lovely designed.
Maria’s Flat on the 4th Floor with its own Roof Terrace is modern sunny an clean
I enjoyed my time very much and can highly recommend Marias place.... it is really wonderful... thanks Maria and Sara

This appartement is very well situated.  It is comfortable and cozy.  The pots and pans could be replaced with something less worn out.  The coffee machine is great.  The bed is a standard double.  Not a queen but, nonetheless very comfortable.  The hostess is very accommodating and always responds quickly.  I would go back.
Great apartment located right in heart of Palermo Soho - balcony was a great perk.
Great location and value in the heart of Palermo. Easy access to many cafes, shops, bookstores in the area. Very safe and accessible. Great amenities, like a home away from home!
Amazing apartment with a huge private terrace! Great location! Pool was a bonus in the summer heat! Definitely recommend.

one of the places which even turn out better than expected - and i do choose my air bnb places. great appartment in the best zone of palermo, nice pool and social area, great terrace and everything there you might need. great attention by the girls helping you to check in/out. nothing to improve...
Sehr schönes Appartment in bester Umgebung

Maria’s place was exactly what I had hoped for. Clean, private, well equipped for short or long stays. Great communication. The location is perfect for tourists. It’s close to nightlife however you will never hear noise even on the weekends. Great value!

This is our 2nd month long stay in Maria’s place. As usual checking and out were perfect. The roof top terrace is great.
The elderly espresso maker quit, let María know, and in a day a brand new one was delivered.
The area is simply the best place to be. All services very close and a short walk to the subway to explore more of the city.
For those concerned about safety this is our 6th month long trip to BA. We have never had even a single incident that was of concern.

O apartamento de Maria é muito bem localizado,  em uma rua tranquila, porém perto de vários restaurantes, cafés e lojas. Tem todos os utensílios e aparelhos necessários para uma ótima estada. Voltaria a me hospedar em outra visita a cidade.
Fantastic location. Great upstairs terrace. Lots of restaurants cafes shops close by. Great communication from owner. Good value for money. Will go back.
Great,  safe location near to all local bars and restaurants. Highly recommend exploring the local area.

Very nice apartment. Super clean and I thought it had everything I needed. The private terrace is awesome. The pool is freezing right now, but if you want to swim some laps, they’ll clean it for you first, which is great. Get the sauna going first, so you can head in to warm back up!
Love this neighborhood. Amazing food, great nightlife. Not noisy at all at night so you’ll sleep well (w an eye mask). There’s a school nearby, so you can hear kids during the day which I found charming.
The private terrace is ridiculously cool. Took some great naps up there even w the cold weather.
To consider:
It advertises a gym. If that’s important to you, check w the host on the status of any equipment you might want to use. None of the cardio was usable...treadmill, bike, or elliptical. I just used it for stretching and light weights.
I’m not sure if it was just me, but it seemed the sliding doors didn’t all lock well. I don’t travel w much, so crossed my fingers. You might inquire about that as well....

Acabamos de voltar de uma viagem de 5 dias a Buenos Aires e durante ela estivemos hospedados no apartamento da Maria.
Ele é realmente um local muito bem cuidado e pensado no bem estar do hóspede.
O apartamento conta com todos utensílios e itens para uma boa estadia.
Com ambiente espaçoso e moderno o apartamento ainda tem como um plus, um terraço gigante e uma incrível parrilla.
A localização e ideal para quem curte uma boa vida noturna e boa gastronomia!!
Gostaria de ressaltar a cordialidade de Luciana, que nos atendeu super bem e esteve sempre atenta aos detalhes e se estava tudo correndo bem.
A nota para este apartamento é 10!

O apartamento é simplesmente perfeito apar um casal. A Localização é perfeita, próximo a infinitos restaurantes e toda a movida de palermo. Se o hospede quiser fazer um churrasco, a churrasqueira do terraço é maravilhosa. O check in e check out são feitos pela Luciana, que é maravilhosa, muito profissional e atenta a tudo, além da simpatia contagiante! nos ajudou dando dicas de lugares, supermercados, etc.
Enfim, a hospedagem perfeita!

Хорошая квартира, удобное расположение! Зона барбекю личная в квартире с выходом на крышу превосходна, все есть для приготовления мяса. Отличный район и отличная квартира.

Departamento ideal para una pareja. Moderno, luminoso y con una localización excelente. La atención de Lu fue muy buena. No tuvimos ningún problema durante la estadia. El espacio es excelente, muy bien ubicado y tambien muy limpio.
Beautiful apartment and terrace in a great location, near to Palermo's restaurants and bars, lots of large parks and Plaza Italia's multiple public transport options. A great find
Great place all around....

Location is excellent, right in the heart of Palermo Soho, where all good restaurants, bars and coffee shops are! The apartment is quite convenient, and the terrace is very nice. Would def come back :)
Very good location, great outdoor space, safe building, good host.

The apartment had everything we needed and we loved the roof terrace. We were able to host a BBQ for our friends and family using the grill and the kitchen had enough plates, utensils, etc. Communication was great and we appreciated the flexibility with check in/out.
Nice apartment in great location near restaurants and bars of Palermo Soho. Easy check in and good communication. Enjoyed the roof terrace. Highly recommended.
Really nice apartment in the middle of Palermo! Great location and beautiful apartment. Enjoyed the rooftop every day! The communication was perfect. We absolutely recommend this apartment!
The apartment was great! The location is unbeatable and the amenities are as described. Maria and her team were very easy to work with. Gracias chicas!
Great place in an awesome location incl. pool area and private bbq. Definitely to recommend!
The apartment is lovely and exactly as described
Great location, stylish apartment and a lovely pool. Excellent communication and their flexibility with my check in was a bonus.
The roof terrace was excellent.
Really nice Appartement in the lovely Palermo. We enjoyed our stay and the communication was very good! Would recommend this place.
Apartamento como nas fotos, bem localizado e anfitriã atenciosa

I highly recommend Marias apartment in the bohemian district of Palermo Soho. It is exactly as shown on the photos. The bed is really comfortable and the air conditioning works perfectly. Check in and Check out was easy.
A fresh start in the pool in the morning and a sparkling cool drink in the evening on the roof top terrace - what else to ask for?
The roof top terrace is private, which is a huge advantage if you just want to hang around or take a sun bath. The pool is for all residents of the house, but as I am more the early bird and went swimming around 7 am, nobody was there and I had the pool all for myself.
Also the area of Palermo Soho is amazing: perfect for shopping and eating out. I highly recommend Don Julio for lunch or dinner, Rapa Nui for Chocolate (they have a super nice garden) and Bar Sheldon for a cocktail.
Thanks Maria & Luciana for the nice stay in Buenos Aires!
A great apartment in a great area. Can’t wait to return.
Second time in this apartment, great location in town, quiet and comfortable
Excelente apartamento. Muy bien ubicado. Volveré sin duda.

Maria made share we were feeling as good as possible during these Corona times. Her efforts were amazing, we never experienced such a great hospitality... also the appartment is perfect for a couple, it is spacy, and the best for us is of course the terrace. It gives us the space to breath, move and do Argentinian parrillas! Would recommend this place to everyone, also in more normal times as the location cannot be better to experience the virbrant Buenos Aires / Palermo lifestyle.

La llegada muy buena, agradezco que María nos haya recibido en estas épocas de coronavirus. El problema fue la cama, estaba súper hundida y no podíamos dormir, decidimos irnos del depto pero todo lo demás muy bien.

Muy buena estadia Maria y Luciana estuvieron atentas a cada detalle de la estadia, el departamento estaba impecable. Es la segunda vez que paro en el departamento de Maria y continuaria regresando a disfrutar de Buenos Aires.

Muy recomendable. Muy buena atención por parte de quienes te atienden, se preocupan en que pases una buena estadía. El departamento es divino, tiene todos los elementos necesarios de cocina, living comedor, baño y cama. La terraza privada es lo mejor, cuenta con parrilla, mesa con sillas, living y reposeras. Le da el sol hasta tarde. La pileta se encuentra en planta baja junto con el gimnasio, se puede acceder a ambos sin problemas. Es un edificio muy tranquilo y esta muy bien ubicado. Volveremos!
Muy bueno todo

Very nice apartment with a great terrace in a perfect location.
I would definitely stay again.
Muy buena ubicación, limpieza y condiciones. Terraza amplia para aprovechar de día. Muy buena predisposición de la anfitriona. 🙌🏼

Maria's place was great as always! Beautiful
view and neighborhood. Luciana's place has everything you need when visiting Buenos Aires. Amazing place and service.

El check-in no fue sencillo. Al momento de reservar, la publicación decía: self check-in, check-in de 16 a 00, y que me iban a recibir. Nada de eso ocurrió. Planeé llegar a las 18, pero resultó ser muy tarde, e incluso tuve que conseguir a alguien que pudiera ir a buscar la llave entre las 10 y las 13.
El departamento estaba muy limpio y ordenado. Las fotos lo muestran tal cual es. Hay aire acondicionado en el living y en la habitación. La cama es muy cómoda. La terreza privada con parrilla es espectacular para pasar la tardecita con un asado. La pileta genial también. Internet rápido y con buena señal en todo el departamento.
La ubicación es muy buena, con muchas opciones gastronómicas y de transporte alrededor. Hay un colegio enfrente que puede ser un poco ruidoso.
El check-out era hasta las 12, y planeé irme cerca de esa hora, pero a mitad de estadía me dijeron que me tenía que ir para las 10 porque iban a limpiar.
Hubiese sido bueno que no me delegaran sus cuestiones de logística, o que...

El departamento esta muy bien ubicado. Lo mejor que tiene es la terraza para hacer asados. Si bien es una propuesta funcional creemos que hay detalles que podrían mejorar.
La comunicación fue fluida y siempre intentaron darnos soluciones.
Excelente departamento con aire acondicionado en el dormitorio y living/cocina. Espectacular terraza privada con parrilla y reposteras.
La Ubicación es inmejorable, la terraza linda para una Reunión de amigos

I loved this place! It was bright, quiet, spacious and had everything I needed. I was very comfortable. The private terrace in particular, was priceless. Location: perfect - close enough to bars and restaurants as well as public transportation, but not in the middle of a noisy area. The host responded immediately whenever I texted and was very helpful. I would definitely go back and highly recommend this place.

O apartamento é excelente, cama confortável e com todos os equipamentos necessários para uma estada agradável em Buenos Aires. A localização é ótima, muito perto da Plaza Serrano e da Plaza Armenia, onde há muitos restaurantes e vida noturna agitada na medida certa. Recomendo muito o apartamento!
Buena ubicación y relación precio calidad

Mi estadía fue de tres semanas y fue todo perfecto. Realmente la locación es perfecta y el departamento es muy lindo. Seguro que volveré a este departamento. Gracias María y Luciana por toda la ayuda, muchas  gracias.
Boa cama, ótima localização, TV a cabo com Netflix. Recomendo!
Comfortable lodging, great host, and perfect location!

If staying for a few days, the location can't be beat. And the apartment has a private, spacious terrace.
I stayed for a long stay (30+ days) and would not do so again. I work from home and though the WiFi is good, there is no outlet near where you would work and the furniture is uncomfortable. Cleanliness was a continual issue. There is a weekly maid service which is good but at least two of the blankets have stains on them, several towels upon arrival had stains on them and when the maid came to change the towels and sheets, more than once I got at least 1 or 2 'new' towels with stains on them. I communicated the towels issue when it first happened and after that just used the clean towels I was given. Regarding the blankets, I left a stained blanket on the bed with the dirty towels when the maid first arrived (as I was instructed to do for items I wanted cleaned) and she just folded the dirty blanket and put it on the dresser. And though the person who the host put me in touch with for day-to-day ma...

Perfect location in Palermo Soho. Great communication from Maria. the apartment was immaculately clean and everything was perfect. There was plenty of HOT water, which is great because I stayed in a lot of places that had very little. I'd definitely stay here again.

Apartamento excelente, localizado em uma rua muito calma, mas vem próximo dos bares onde a vida noturna acontece.
O apartamento tem tudo o que é informado no anúncio, com chuveiro e camas super confortáveis.
Lavanderia também disponível no prédio, só é necessário a compra de algumas fichas para utilizar.
Maria foi muito receptiva, permitiu a nossa entrada após as 00:00, onde o Mathias nos recepcionou muito bem. Além de ter toda a comunicação com a Luciana por mensagem. Todo mundo muito solícito.
Tivemos problemas com a internet nos dias em que ficamos, mas Maria trouxe que era um problema com o provedor.
Com relação a localização, muito próximo da estação plaza Itália.
Muito obrigada pela recepção e até logo.

The apartment has a very nice private!!! terrace to make your own barbecue or just spend some time with family and friends.
The neighbourhood is amazing, full of bars and stores and flea markets but because of this it gets nosy at night, during the weekends.
Muy lindo el departamento , la ubicación excelente . Muy buena la comunicación con la dueña. Súper recomendable :
Excelente apartamento, cómodo y en un punto clave para conocer Buenos Aires
Excelente estadia!

THE location to stay in Palermo which consists of so many different areas. In Marias' apartment you have everything and in the area even more. If I lived in Palermo, it would be in this area. Add to that the wonderful welcome, the attentiveness during your stay, and all the apartment offers.
Out of two different apartments in Palermo, this one was our favourite!

This flat is well located in a BA area (PALERMO) very friendly and very fun with many restaurants and bars. The appropriated subway stations are ORDIZ or Plaza Italia
This flat is well furnished and perfect for a short stay as a long stay . A laundry is available in the first floor and a super terrace belonging to the appartment is appreciated .
Maria 's contact in BA were perfect for support .
Dont hesitate to rent it.
Apartamento com excelente localização, há 10min da linha D do metrô. Apartamento que tem tudo o que precisa pra uma excelente estadia, e ainda tem uma excelente parrilla!

Manuel was truly an awesome guest.
The apartment is super cute and very nicely located of off Santa Fe Avenue. Eventhough the internet connection was spotty at times Manuel was very responsive in promising to take care of it soon for future guests. Still, the overall experience was magnificent. I actually forgot my wallet and camera at the appartment and after I notified him, Manuel found it and Fedexed it to me the next day.
Highly reccomended!

Mercedes is the perfect host ! We were very happy in the Happy House ! The appartement is very nice, quiet (well, as quiet as possible in this huge Buenos Aires querido), clean, warmful, cheerful, decorated with a lot of delicate attention, the floor (parquet) in the living was perfect for practice and private tango classes. A lot of milongas in the neighbourhood, Palermo is a tango barrio ... Gracias por todo !  Keep in touch for next time, un abrazo enorme to Mercedes and Manuel ! Laura y Bruno

Ha sido un verdadero placer estar en este departamento. Unos anfitriones maravillosos y la casa cuidada al detalle para que la estadia sea una experiencia maravillosa.
Yo ya tengo piso preferido para estar en Buenos Aires.
Muy recomendable.

Happy House was clean, cozy, and cute with all the amenities we needed. It was also well situated and a great base from which to explore the city. The hosts were very friendly and made themselves readily available to address questions. Overall, a great place to stay!

We had a lovely stay at this apartment in Buenos Aires. It had everything we needed and was conveniently located. As two women traveling alone, it was a safe neighborhood. Mercedes and Manuel were extremely accommodating. When our outgoing flight was cancelled, they quickly responded to my email and enabled us to stay another night. We so appreciated their kindness after a terrible day at the airport!  Muchas gracias, amigos!  I can recommend this apartment without hesitation.

The happy house was the perfect place to spend my visit in Buenos Aires. The decor really did make me feel happy and comfortable. Manuel was an excellent host. He was flexible when it came to checking me in and out and was always available and helpful with any other requests. I will always remember my stay in the happy house and strongly recommend it to anyone who is interested!

Happy House is a fabulous place to stay:  perfectly located in Palermo near parks and public transport lines, a cozy and beautifully decorated apartment, and a wonderfully helpful host in Manuel.  We had a marvelous time in Buenos Aires and Happy House made our stay all the better.
Very nice small apartment in a very good location and a very nice and helpful host.

A Happy House é muito aconchegante e limpa. O prédio quieto e reservado -  mesmo com um restaurante embaixo não chega a ser barulhento. Hospedes viciados em wi fi podem ficar impacientes, mas existem 2 conecções disponíveis. Manuel foi um excelente host, estando sempre pronto para nos ajudar no que fosse preciso. A casa é super bem localizada, com fácil acesso à metro, parques, supermercados,shoppings e restaurantes. Mercedes tem super bom gosto e um astral incrível no seu charmoso apartamento. Mimos como a A lata da Alegria nos faz sentir super benvindos. Happy house tem uma energia maravilhosa, e Manuel foi um excelente amigo. Recomendo muitíssimo! Habla-se Portunhol e Inglês! ;P

I had a great experience at Happy House! The location is awesome. It was easy to get to the subte and taxis drive past the apartment regularly. There is a grocery store at the corner. Manuel provided me with lots of helpful information about places to visit and recommended great restaurants! I'll go back to happy house the next time I travel to BA!

We had a wonderful week at Happy House and in Buenos Aires. The apartment is very cosy, bright, comfortable and spacious. Located in a fantastic area close to everything and very safe. Manuel was a great host and very helpful and responsive to any of our questions. Highly recommend :)

We had a great stay at the Happy House. The apartment itself is spacious, charmingly decorated and well situated (close to a number of tourist attractions, the subway, buses and supermarkets). The hosts were very friendly and responsive - and flexible with check-in and check-out.

We loved our stay at Happy House. Manuel and Mercedes were very responsive to any questions and flexible with check-in and check-out. We had to leave at 6am in the morning, and this was no problem. The apartment is well-furnished and has all that you need. The location is excellent - minutes to a supermarket and the subte station and the Palermo parks. Plenty of taxis in the street. A lovely local neighbourhood and felt safe for two women travellers. Highly recommend.

A really cosy appartment in the cool neighbourhood of cool Palermo. The appartment provides everything you need for some Buenos Aires days and the host, Mercedes, was absolutely great, helpful and made us feel at home from the very first minute of our stay. We would highly recommend this place!

A nice cosy apartment in a great area!!!
Everything, from supermarkets to metro station is so close, and if you are into shopping just a minute away there is one of the nicest BA's shopping mall.
The apartment was clean and equipped with everything you might need (even all kind of international power plugs). The wifi connection was a bit unstable (still working though) but that same week (beginning of november '13) the telco company was going to install the new line, so should be all solved now.

Mercedes&Manuel were of great help, from simple information about the city to arranging a taxi and helping out with the Spanish.

Overall feedback is very positive, I would choose the same place.
perfect stay! you feel like at home in buenos aires!
