Great experience!! Manuel and Mercedes were super helpful, awesome hosts. Easy to get in contact with before and during our stay, and as locals, had great recommendations on restaurants and activities nearby.
The apartment is beautiful, lots of natural light, comfy bed and living room furniture, functional, well-stocked kitchen, and modern, clean bathroom. We really felt at home during our stay.
Good location, grocery store less than a block away, a Subte (metro) stop 2 blocks away, in a nice quiet neighborhood, but close to lots of restaurants.
Really, so glad we stayed at Happy House. =)

We loved this apartment because it is in a great area, lots of restaurants, bars, groceries stores, cafes and pretty much you don't need to leave the neighborhood.  We loved that it was cleaned every week!  Every room in the apartment is very bright and very cozy.  We absolutely loved the outdoor swimming pool and used it a lot.  The roof terrace is huge and we used the parrilla several times.  The building feels very safe.  Communication with the host was very quick.  This is our fifth trip to Bs As and the best place we've stayed at, we would love to stay in this apartment, if available, the next time we travel there.  Thank you so much!

Maria's apartment is simply perfect for couples looking to stay in amazing Palermo Soho.
The apartment is super comfy with great amenities.
The terrace (and the BBQ) are just an spectacular addition.
The location cannot be beat, you're just surrounded by spectacular restaurants and shops .. like Autre Monde, the wine store around the corner (on JL Borges, across the street). Best in town.
Super recommendable apartment.
Brilliant stay! Location was perfect, apartment was clean, tidy and well equipped, terrace was brilliant and communal swimming pool area was great. Would definitely stay here again.

This is our second stay in Maria's apartment. She has upgraded the furniture and TV since our last visit and continues to improve by ordering new covers for the furniture.
We had new towels and bedding as well as pool towels which were very useful.
We would return again as this apartment is right in the centre of where we want to be. It is very safe and in a well cared for building. The swimming pool makes it ideal for a summer stay which is when we visit.
Maria is a responsive host and always responds quickly to queries. We would return to this apartment again.
It was a great spot to be in! Close to everything, was nice to easily walk around to little trendy shops. The terrace is amazing - host was very friendly and took good care of all details.

The apartment itself is quite comfortable and clean in an attractive building in interesting Palermo Soho. The outdoor swimming pool needed some cleaning but was a decent size with an attractive deck area around it behind the building. Very convenient location for restaurants, supermarkets, walking around (it felt quite safe), with good access to public transport and taxis. The huge private rooftop terrace is very attractive---particularly a nice space to enjoy in summer when the schools are shut for the holidays. This would have been a perfect stay except that there is a primary school very close by where the dear children go out to play and scream for hours from Monday to Friday during their recess, lunch time or physical education lessons along with sometimes their teachers shouting into megaphones---not the host's fault, of course, but it makes the lovely rooftop terrace unusable at times due to the noise. The windows also need sound-proofing which the responsive host acknowledged.

O primeiro ponto positivo a se destacar foi a atenção e gentileza que a Luciana nos deu; desde a nossa chegada na cidade até o nosso check-in. O Matias, responsável por nos receber no apartamento, foi igualmente amável e bastante prestativo!  Sobre o apartamento, as imagens falam por si só: é um apartamento aconhegante e amplo. Vale ressaltar ainda que o recebemos limpo e organizado. O ponto alto vai para o terraço exclusivo do apartamento! Há uma ótima churrasqueira e a poucas quadras a açougue do Don Julio e mercados, possibilitando, assim, uma ótima alternativa ao restaurante! A localização é perfeita, pois está situado como se fosse em uma linha meridional entre o coração de Palermo Soho e a estação de metrô Plaza Itália; isso faz com que seja possível estar a poucas quadras dos melhores bares e restaurantes da cidade e também a poucas quadras da linha D do metrô; ou seja, um local tranquilo e de fácil acesso a vários pontos turísticos de Buenos Aires. Recomendo e anseio em voltar.

Great place to stay in Palermo. The terrace is really nice and the apartment is cozy. The wifi did completely black-out halfway through my stay but luckily the host gave me an alternative connection to a nearby unit that worked fine and tried to get a technician in as soon as possible. The Selina co-working space is also very close if you need somewhere else to go and work.
Excelente

GREAT OPTION FOR A COUPLE
THIS WAS OUR SECOND STAY AT MARIA'S PLACE.
WE WILL CONTINUE TO BOOK IT EVERY TIME WE'D RETURN TO THIS AMAZING CITY.
IT HAS EVERYTHING YOU'D NEED FOR A PERFECT STAY IN PALERMO HOLLYWOOD, THE HOTTEST SPOT IN BUENOS AIRES.
YOU EVEN HAVE (AROUND THE CORNER) THE BEST WINE STORE IN TOWN (AUTRE MONDE)
DON'T THINK IT TWICE, STAY HERE.
Die Wohnung und Lage sind einfach super - jederzeit wieder!
Tudo ótimo, banheiro com o piso aquecido foi uma surpresa gostosa pra gente que visitou no inverno. Quarto escuro, tv com Netflix, varanda… tudo ótimo!

El barrio es perfecto, la comunicacion con maria y luciana tambien.
marcela venia todas las semanas y dejaba el dto impecable .
El edificio y los lugares comunes siempre limpios y con buen aroma ,Fernando el portero un fenomeno , siempre a disposicion .
En resumen un dto comodo y luminoso muy recomendable.

La estadia fue buena, exceptuando que no se pudo solucionar un problema con la electricidad que me tuvo un dia sin heladera y wifi y el resto de mi estadia sin un aire acondicionado y tv.
El lugar es manejado por muchas personas y tuve contacto con 4 personas diferentes sin contar a Maria.
Todos fueron muy atentos y trataron de solucionar los inconvenientes de la mejor manera, pero lamentablemente no lo pudieron arreglar.
Sin estos inconvenientes la estadia es un 10, excelente ubicacion, contacto, limpieza y comodidad.

O apartamento é extremamente bem localizado, no coração de Palermo Soho. Muito bem decorado e agradável. Fomos prontamente recebidas pelos administradores do apartamento, Luis e Amado, que muito prestativos e atenciosos nos sugeriram passeios, restaurantes e nos deram várias dicas valiosas. Certamente ficarei no apartamento
apartamento de Maria quando voltar à querida Buenos Aires!
de Maria quando voltar a Buenos Aires. Tudo ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️!

L’internet fonctionnait très bien,je donnais des cours à l’université avec Zoom 6h par semaine et c’était parfait.
Nous avons passé 9 semaines dans l’appartement et María a finalement déniché de très bon gestionnaire sur place qui répondait rapidement pour tout problème ou questionnement.
C’était notre deuxième location pour l l’appartement depuis 2026
El Apartamento super lujoso y cómodo, está localizado en una buena área lleno de restaurantes y cosas para hacer. Amado y Luis unos capos, siempre atentos! Muy recomendable quedarse en este lugar!

This is our second stay at Maria's place and we loved it, it's in great location, lots of great restaurants and walkable.  we loved the terrace and use the parrilla lots of times and used the swimming pool quite often, which is very enjoyable during hot days.  We would love to stay here again when we return to Buenos Aires.
Excelente departamento. Cómodo, limpio y muy completo. La atención fue excelente!

The place has a good location, and is walking distances of restaurants, cafes, shops, bars. The space is comfortable for 2 peoples, and it have a beautiful terrace where you can stay at the afternoons of any summer day.
We would definitely choose the place if we returned to BA.

Apartment was fine.  Everything stated was provided and host was very accommodating.  Minor problems:  bed could have used couple of extra pillows to be comfortable, and car wash was right below (but this is the city, so I doubt the noise level would be much lesser if car wash weren't there).

The apartment was perfect for us, it was clean and comfortable and had all that you might need for a week's stay. The area was safe and conveniently close to local transport. Egle was super helpful and gave us maps and lots of information about the local area and beyond.
Highly recommended.

The apartament was lovely: its located in a great neighborhood, near to the subway, with a lot of sun light. Romina, the woman responsable for the cleaning, was very trustful and efficient. The internet is pretty fast (we worked from there with two computers using the internet at the same time and it work out great). Egle was very kind and helped us with any problem.

I stayed for one month in the apartment and it was perfect. It has all the basic necessities and it very clean. The bed is comfortable. The apartment is very connected to anywhere you want to go by public transportation.

Egle and her husband were very accommodating. I asked for more pillows and they were quick to respond. They also sent many recommendations for the neighborhood and public transportation which was very helpful. They helped me arrange a way to check out at 4am to catch my flight.

If I return to buenos aires I'll be sure to stay again!
Thanks for everything!

After 3 weeks in this apartment we agree: this is indeed a sunny place. We have enjoyed it very much and will ask for this apartment again, if we return to Buenos Aires.
It´s clean and it´s close to the center. It´s only a few blocks from the subway and you can easily get around by bus.
Most of all it has been a pleasure to communicate with Egle. She has been so kind and helpful and she has reacted immediately when we have sent her an e-mail.
We can easily recommend Egles apartment.
Pia and Brian
Denmark

Egle is a great person , very helpful and understanding!!
The place is really nice and clean. it has all you need. The neightborhood is safe and beautiful.
My only complane is the pillows I think they can be a little more confortable!!
but overol I had a great stay!!
Will go back anytime!1

We really enjoyed our stay in Egle's apartament. It's clean, spacious,  in the middle of Boedo with restaurants, markets, banks just a few steps away. Try Pan y Arte and MArgot both two block away. Egle was very helpfull and attentive host. Recommended!

Egle y Oscar, unas personas muy amables, la pasamos muy bien durante nuestra estancia, el depto es muy bonito, acogedor y muy bien adaptado a las necesidades diarias. Esperamos regresar pronto, un fuerte abrazo Sophia y David.

Estoy sumamente muy agradecida por las recomendaciones y la atención facilitada por Egle, estuvo súper acertada la decisión de hospedarnos en su propiedad. Espectacular lugar, ideal para pareja. En fin, justo lo que queríamos. Recomendado 100%

O bairro é ótimo para quem deseja ficar relativamente próximo do centro e ao mesmo tempo numa região menos agitada. Boedo é um bairro familiar e bem servido de supermercado, cafeterias, farmácias, bancos e comércio em geral. Uma padaria e cafeteria muito boa fica a poucos metros do prédio, o que facilita muito para o café da manhã.
A estação Boedo do metrô fica a poucas quadras do prédio e rapidamente se pode chegar ao centro da cidade ou a qualquer parte servida pelo metrô, pela combinação de linhas. O apartamento estava muito limpo, é confortável, perfeito para uma pessoa ou para um casal e é exatamente como nas fotos. Ventilação e iluminação natural excelentes. Tudo limpo, roupas de cama e banho limpinhos, cozinha com tudo que é necessário, banheiro e chuveiro muito bons. Tudo funcionando e na medida certa. Minha estadia foi perfeita e com todo o conforto. Recomendo 100%!
Estuve muy comodo tanto con el lugar como con la forma em que fue administrado. Lo recomiendo.

Egle's apartment is modern, sunny, and clean. I stayed there for a month and enjoyed both the apartment and the location, which is a few steps away from the heart of Boedo, where you can find restaurants and cafes with outdoor seating filled with locals. (My favorites are Cafe Pugliese for lunch and Cafe Floresta for dessert and coffee). The location is close to key bus lines that will take you to other barrios in Buenos Aires. Make sure you have a SUBE card (I obtained mine at the local post office) to use the buses. Otherwise you need to bring lots of coins and the fare almost doubles. There are also subway (subte) stops within five blocks of the apartment, but I did not use them at all during my stay, as the buses are more direct.

I did not have the chance to meet Egle in person, as she was out of the country when I was there. But I did meet Oscar who manages the entry and departure of guests, and lives in the same building. I had no problem checking in and out. Egle also sent a long...

A Egle foi atenciosa desde o início. Nos enviou um roteiro da cidade, os locais próximos para almoçar, bares. Nos listou os ônibus que passam pela região e levam aos pontos turísticos da cidade.
O apartamento é exatamente como descrito no anúncio.
O bairro é ótimo, proporciona uma experiência paralela a de se hospedar no centro. A rotina do bairro é muito própria e você acaba vivendo como um morador local.
Boedo tem muita história, as ruas possuem esculturas. O restaurante Trianon foi o nosso preferido. Há uma Farmacity, uma estação de subte. Em poucas palavras, um bairro completo.

We (me and my boyfriend) stayed for a week in the apartement. The place is great, new, clean and exactly as on photos. It is also very calm. The Boedo neighbourhood is also very nice with lots of comercials and restaurants. The genitor was also very kind and helpful. If we would need to say something negative it wouldn't be about Egle's place itself but some neighbour in the bilding who smoked in his bathroom and by the ventilation system it made sometimes our bathroom smelly. But as I said, that was the neighbour's fault, the Egle's place itself is a great place to stay and if we come again we will repeat it.

Staying in the Happy House was our first experience with airbnb and we could not be happier. The house was comfortable and had everything we needed for our 5 days in Buenos Aires. It is so much better than staying in a hotel where often there is little space to spread out. The air conditioning is a bonus when it was hot outside. The location is perfect for exploring the city on foot and is close to the subte (metro) for those who chose to use it.

We stayed for a little over a month at the happy house and it was a fantastic experience.



The neighborhood is great. We became regulars at Faricci, La Payuca, Bella Italia, (all in walking distance), Local in Palermo Hollywood (short ride on the D line) and bblue in Palermo soho. There is also a large grocery store (disco) within 2 minutes walking. There is even a big mall a couple blocks away that's called Alto Palermo with many anchoring restaurants and fun shops. It's also a block to the D line (subway). We got a sube card there, which allows you to get on buses as well as the subway.



The apartment is really cute and cozy, decorated with lots of loving details. It was also clean and comfy. There are many interesting books, DVDs and music CDs for you to enjoy too. All the appliances and amenities (washing machine, hot water, AC, high speed wifi, DVD player, TV, etc) worked perfectly. There's plenty of closet space. The small balcony and cute pink courtyard are filled wi...

We stayed at the Happy House for 5 nights and it was an excelent experience. It's the perfect appartment for a couple! There's a very big room and another one with a small bed, both of them were confortable. The location is great and the apartment is super cozy and spacious. We had everything we need and both Manuel and Mercedes are very friendly and kind. Thanks! We'll repeat for sure if we come back to BA!
O apartamento é ótimo, como está nas fotos, bem localizado, limpo. A Egle foi atenciosa e ofereceu dicas bem interessantes. Eu voltaria, com certeza!!!

The flat is like described, oir expectations fully fullfilled, nice authentic neighbourhood. A Park would habe been nice, but many bars and shops and Restaurants and gold connection with public transport

O apartamento de Egle foi uma grande surpresa para nós. De belíssima decoração (com lindas pinturas da própria Egle), de muito conforto e de muita praticidade!
Fomos atendidos por Oscar, que nos tratou com muito cuidado e extrema gentileza. Super recomendado!
El departamento estaba dentro de los descripto y el barrio era muy bueno. Muy satisfecho.

Nous avons passe un sejour des plus agreables danscun studio tres clair, propre, personnalise et des plus calmes un vrai havre de paix dans la trepidante Buenos Aires au sein d'un quartier chaleureux ou tout est a portee. Service impeccable, immeuble tres propre et un gardien tres sympathique et a l'ecoute.

This is the fourth time I've stayed at Egle's apartment and as always, it has been a very pleasant experience. The pictures show the place exactly as it is. Modern, clean and functional,  with good wifi speed, comfortable bed, and a good shower. Although it is not central, it's very easy  to get anywhere in town using the underground (Linea E), local buses and there's always plenty of taxis available.

Como siempre (ya hemos estado aquí el año pasado) el lugar se encontraba en perfecto estado.
Egle tubo la amabilidad de permitirnos ingresar ese mismo día más temprano y eso nos facilitó el poder descansar luego de un largo viaje.

El departamento es muy bonito, luminoso, muy bien cuidado y hermosamente decorado.
La cama muy cómoda y el baño con buena cantidad de agua caliente.

Muy buena ubicación, con todo lo necesario cerca. Esto permite estar lejos del centro y a su vez con la posibilidad de acercarse rápidamente con subterráneo.

Volveremos al lugar el año que viene. Gracias.

Il n'y a pas de surprise, l'appartement est très agréable comme il est décrit et comme le montrent les photos.
Il est situé à deux pas du metro et d'un grand supermarché, c'est bien pratique!
Egle nous a donné de bons conseils de visites et nous aurions aimé rester plus.
Bref, je le recommande !

The apartment is really beautiful, perfectly located and exactly as you can see in the photos.
The neighborhood is very attractive, full of historical cafeterias, Restaurants for all kind of budgets, tango-related places, shops with all you may need for a long or short term stay but, above all, I felt very safe during the time I stayed there
.
The apartment itself is prepared for a short or long term stay. Full kitchen, a very comfortable bed, a nice balcony, a super fast internet and, last but no least, a host that answers all your doubts within minutes. If you have a problem or you need something, you can ask Egle and she will find a solution right away. For an experienced or frequent traveller person like me, I can say that this is not so common and I value it a lot.

Apartment looked like described. Very convenient location with plenty of shops and public transport.

Very quiet apartment, I could not hear much noise from the street in comparison to other places I have stayed before.
Egle always responded to my messages and resolved any issues as soon as possible.
Excelente departamento, ubicación perfecta, y departamento moderno y acogedor, un lugar sin dudas para volver y recomendar. Gracias
A neat an fine apparment. Good neighbourhood. Location is close to some milongas. Many bus connections.

Tal cual se ve en la fotos! Luminoso, muy buena ubicación, seguro, cómodo, zona con muchos bares restaurantes. Si bien egle no está en el edificio, el conserje oscar estuvo disponible todo el tiempo para solucionar cualquier inconveniente.. sin dudas volvería de ser necesario!

El apartamento es exactamente cómo se ve en las fotos. Muy bien ubicado para moverse por el centro. El espacio es amplio, luminoso y equipado con lo necesario para un tiempo corto. Siempre Egle está atenta a cualquier duda, la comunicación es muy rapida
Muy bien ubicado, cómodo, iría otra vez sin dudas!
El departamento es muy lindo,comodo y seguro,tiene todo lo necesario para pasarlo bien!!!
The flat is realy nice and clean, just as described . You will find everthing you need for a short stay. The owner is very nice and attentive

First time staying in this area. A real barrio with great transport links. Buses and metro to Palermo, Retiro and downtown. There is good local shops for all your groceries.
The apartment is clean, quiet and very bright. There was plenty of hot water, fast WiFi and air conditioner worked well. The mattress is good and firm.
Todo fantastico! Muy recomendable!
El departamento es moderno y muy cómodo!

Cute little studio in Boedo! I stayed here for a month, and loved the location and proximity to the Subte and buses. The balcony was great too! Would absolutely recommend for anyone wanting a more authentic stay in Buenos Aires, or someone who already knows the city and neighborhoods.

El apartamento está en un barrio muy lindo y clásico de la ciudad dónde la gran mayoría son hinchas de San Lorenzo de Almagro, a 3 cuadras del subte Boedo, y cercano a bares y cafés por donde desfilaron Adolfo Bellocq y Roberto Arlt, entre muchos personajes que irán descubriendo cuando visiten la ciudad. La calle boedo es tranquila y bien iluminada, por lo que se puede caminar de noche además de tener fácil acceso de colectivos (microbuses) uber, taxis, etc.
Sobre el departamento, Egle ha cuidado cada detalle, es cómodo, muy lindo decorado, es perfecto para 1 o 2 personas, con una cocina equipada que nos ayudó mucho a reducir costos, y todo muy limpio y ordenado además tiene un pequeño balcón muy agradable. en fin, un departamento muy recomendado para pasar unas semanas o quien sabe, un mes, en Buenos Aires.

I had a nice stay here.  It's a nice clean space, fairly quiet despite being located on a busy avenue.  There is a mini market right next door that makes getting groceries very convenient.  There are plenty of cafes and bars and some restaurants in the area, and the avenue is well trafficked day and night so I felt very safe here.  The only cons are that the area is a bit far from the more touristy parts of the city, although they are more or less within reach thanks to the accessible transit options nearby.  The wifi was also a bit unreliable during my stay (your luck may vary), it would occasionally disconnect and would occasionally slow down quite a bit, but by and large worked ok with a speed of 10 mbps.  For most it won't be an issue unless (like me) you came here to work.
El departamento esta bien hubicado, lo recomiendo ampliamente...

Como siempre, la agradable decoración, la predisposición de la dueña y la buena atención de Oscar (dispuesto para cada necesidad) hacen que la estadía sea muy agradable.
La ubicación es muy buena para quien no quiera estar en el caos del centro y a su vez esta en una zona llena de comercios y restaurantes en un Barrio típico de tango.

Excelente recepción a la llegada. El departamento es cómodo y acogedor. El edificio se halla en muy buenas condiciones y es tranquilo. Egle se ha mantenido en contacto permanente y me ha asistido en cualquier necesidad respondiendo con prontitud. He pasado una estancia muy confortable. Lo recomiendo!! Gracias Egle

Lovely space! Egle was also very very quick with responses. It is a little distance from the city center and neighbourhoods like Palermo or Recoleta where alot of attractions are but it is very accessible via uber. Great place nonetheless it was very quiet too!
Egle is quick to communicate and help with whatever you need
Hospitalidad
Nice and clean apartment in a very good and safe area (Boedo). Egle gave us fantastic recommendations for restaurants, tango shows, shopping, etc. We can definitely recommend this apartment.
todo muy bien
Optimo apartamento. Num bairro calmo e tranquilo. Recomendo.
Excelente alojamiento. Egle responde rapido a tus consultas. super recomendado.
Exelente, bien ubicado con respecto à los transportes en comun, recomiendo por la higiene y la descubierta de Buenos Aires
No pudimos concretar estadía por problemas personales pero Egle siempre estuvo bien predispuesta a los cambios.

Die Lage ist super! Viele Cafes und Restaurants sowie kleine Obst/Gemüseläden. Wir haben es geliebt nicht mitten in der Touriviertel zu wohnen und das authentische Leben in BA geniessen zu können!
Es gibt so viele Busse und Subte in der Nähe. Perfekt angebunden.
Appartment schick und praktisch eingerichtet. Küche ist gut ausgestattet. Alles ist super sauber und das Bett ist sehr bequem.
Wir haben Egle leider nicht persönlich kennengelernt weil sie im Urlaub war. Aber die Kommunikation war sehr schnell, einfach und problemlos. Check in mit dem Doorman hat auch super geklappt.
Egle hat uns super viele coole Tipps und Infos gegeben.
Wir können dies Appartment sehr empfehlen!
great apartment. wifi was a bit iffy at times but egle fixed quickly

Sumamente recomendado este lugar, es exactamente igual a como se ve en las fotos, muy limpio, tiene todo lo necesario para que pases bien en las vacaciones. Pasan 2 buses muy cerca, y ademas la estacion Boedo del metro esta a un par de cuadras para caminar, tiene muchas tiendas cerca, asi que puedes comprar verduras facilmente, entre otras cosas. Tiene muchos restaurantes cerca y cafes, en definitiva es un buen lugar para estar, el barrio no es turistico, asi que se disfrta mas ver como el argentino vive en esas partes. En fin, en definitiva recomiendo mucho este lugar. No se arrepentiran. Algo que fue un PLUS total, Egle compartio por mensaje una lista de cosas por hacer y cosas que quizas necesitaria saber, fue muy util. Gracias Egle, fue una estadia muy buena.
Recomendable, muy simple el ingreso. Buena ubicación y todo lo que se necesita al rededor.
Bom
Excelente departamento. Ubicacion, comunicacion, atencion. Gracias Egle y Oscar!!

Departamento un ambiente para dos personas a unas cuadras del metro, en barrio tranquilo.  El departamento es espacioso y limpio y el único detalle, encontré muy pequeña la ducha.  Una persona más grande no cabe ahí.  Se agradece la confianza y la dedicación en los detalles

Muy buen lugar, lindo y limpio!!
Egle súper atenta y pendiente que todo esté Perfecto !
Recomendado :)
Departamento muy bonito y acogedor, cuenta con todo lo necesario y una gran ubicación con comercio, cafeterías, restaurantes y subte a pocas cuadras
Excelente atención....muy buen alojamiento
Recomendable al 100
Muy buen lugar asi como muy buena atencion . Siempre limpio , todo en orden . Un lugar muy comodo y una excelente experiencia .lo recomiendo

Had a great stay at Egle’s place! Nice and clean apartment in a good location walking distance to the metro train, supermarket, deli, and tango bars! Egle was super helpful with anything we needed and even were able to leave our bags with her for a few days! Would definitely recommend!
Lugar bem localizado, de fácil acesso e com comprometimento em te atender da maneira mais rápida.
una buena esrancia.
Lindo y acojedor lugar!
Muy recomendable el espacio de Egle. Centrico, seguro y comodo.
El lugar es cerca a todo, es tal cuál como las fotos, nos recibieron con anticipación y fue de gran ayuda, la ducha es un poco pequeña, el lugar estaba impecable

Anfitriona muy hospitalaria. Tuvimos una situación al llegar porque la plataforma no nos permitió cambio de fecha a ninguno de los dos y recibimos muy buena disposición de solucionar el problema incluso cuando era responsabilidad de la plataforma. Muy buena ubicación, recomendado.
Ambiente acogedor con facilidades de transporte, supermercados cercanos al igual que restaurantes.
Es muy buen lugar se encuentra en una zona céntrica donde se puede encontrar todo, y los encargados muy amables
A estadia foi muito boa, o apartamento é ótimo para duas pessoas e bastante organizado. O encarregado do edifício estava sempre pronto a ajudar com o que precisasse e a localização é excelente!

Nos gustó mucho el depto de Egle. Localización excelente, bien iluminado, ten todo lo que necesita para pasar tranquilo algunos días. La comunicación con Egle también fue rápida y cordial. Recomendamos y certamente volveremos a quedarnos allí.
Excelente ubicacion. Muy comodo departamento. Egle muy atenta y siempre dispuesta a ayudar y solucionar todo.

3 friends and I spent 10 days at Happy House as we were studying Spanish at a school in buenos aires.
The house is in immaculate condition and close to shops, restaurants, cafes and public transport.
We had a great time and experience in this house and the owners went out of there way to make us feel welcome and settle in.
All in all a great 10 days was had by all and I firmly recommended this accommodation.

Manuel's place is extraordinary. It's cosy and stylish and very well located. Apart from that he's just the best host you could imagine, extremely helpful, friendly and funny. We just felt like we had a friend at the very moment we arrived in Buenos Aires.

Happy House was excellent. I was in BA for a conference and the apartment was perfect to set up base, close to the conference centre and close to all the nightlife of Palermo. The apartment was as described and Manuel went the extra mile to make me feel welcome. All the guidebooks and maps at the apartment were incredibly useful! At the time of being there there was an issue with the gas supply in the entire apartment block. However, I was fully aware of this beforehand and it didn't deter me from booking. An electric shower was installed before I arrived and Manuel dropped in an electric kettle the day after I arrived.

When I come back, I'd love to stay again.

We received a warm welcome from Manuel and his wife. After a late arrival, they took the time to help us get settled over some Argentinian parrilla at a nearby restaurant. Happy House was clean, bright and nicely presented. We found it a tranquil escape from the bustling grind of BA. Happy House is situated in a safe neighborhood with a supermarket, shopping complex and subway within a short walk. We recommend it.

Manuel est un hôte tres sympathique et agréable, il a tout fait pour que nous nous sentions chez nous .
L appartement est très bien situé dans un quartier vivant et commerçant, le métro est tout proche.
Une base parfaite pour découvrir buenos aires
Merci manuel

It was pleasant to stay at The happy house. Location was perfect and the appartment very nice. The only thing which we didn't like was that there was no gas in The appartment. Fortunately there was an electric shower but still...
Very nice apartment in a great neighborhood. We really enjoyed our 2 weeks stay in the Happy House. We warmly recommend it!

Mercedes was very welcoming and helpful. Her directions to the apartment were accurate, and everything went quite smoothly. The only criticism would be that there was a problem with the hot water. The shower was not that hot, and there was no hot water in either the kitchen or bathroom sink. Not a major problem, but slightly inconvenient.

The happy house was perfect for our 4 day visit in Buenos Aires. Manuel was an amazing host and helped tremendously when we had some travel changes arise. He was super responsive and helpful with things to do, getting taxis, etc. The place itself is great... good location to get to a lot of places and we were comfortable. The energy in the house is positive and it made our stay enjoyable. Highly recommend.

Nous avons apprécié l'accueil de Manuel,son sourire et son attention pour nous rendre service.L'appartement était très propre et agréable. A proximité de Santa Fé où on trouve tout et dans un quartier très calme le soir. Nous recommandons cette Happy House qui porte bien son nom.

Manuel is a great host and totally trustable. The apt has a perfect location to explore BA. Absolutely recomendable place. The apt is furnished with great style and taste. Everything was very clean and Manuel always available in case you need him.

Happy House was OK. The best part was Manuel, who welcomed us, always smiling and ready to help. We had a nice conversation. Now, regarding the condo, is well decorated creating a cozy ambient, a lot of book to read and information for the traveler. The area is great! The bad part is that is an old building that smell a little. The hot water in the shower and vanity was connected in the oposite side and took me the first time 3 trips to the kitchen to check if the Water heater was turning on since is On Demand. Also the TV isn't connected to cable or antena and since the router for the WiFi is in the bedroom, the signal was poor in the living room. The kitchen need to be upgrade with new pan & pots and the dish-ware. Most of the cups and plates are cracked. Still, I had a good time in Happy House but it can be much better. Luigi

Manuel and his wife are wonderful people and made me feel extremely welcome. Everything went flawless from check in to check out. They could not have been more helpful and available. The apartment feels very safe and comfortable. For me it was the perfect spot to wind down and enjoy Buenos Aires - a city I love. The location is very convenient to explore all central parts of the city. I will try and book again for sure...if it is available ;). I can highly recommend staying in Happy House.

Manuel and his sister made us feel very welcome, and they were very accommodating concerning picking up the keys and the leaving time at the end of our stay. The apartment is in a great location, one block from Santa Fe and the Alto Palermo shopping mall. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos and is well equipped. Moreover, Manuel was always easy to contact and helpful. We enjoyed our stay in the lovely 'Happy House' and recommend the apartment if you are planning on visiting Buenos Aires.

Very good apartment. Great location with easy access to supermarket and malls nearby. The apartment has 1 master bedroom with bath and the living room is decorated nicely with couple of sofas. The 2nd room is very small with a twin bed and has no door as per the description. Kitchen is furnished with basic utensils. When we arrived (late night), Manuel was ready to welcome us and showed us the apartment. He was kind enough to answer any questions over whatsapp. Very nice host and easy to work with. Highly recommend it to anyone with a group of 2 or 3.

Nous venons de passer 2 semaines superbes dans cette Happy House si bien nommée.
On a l'impression d'être chez reçu chez des amis. L'appartement est cosy, super bien situé dans BA ce qui est extrêmement important compte tenu de la taille de la ville.Proche du métro, très bien desservi par les bus et les taxis sont très nombreux et très abordables.
Nous avons été reçus par Manuel qui est vraiment charmant .
Bref, c'est le coeur serré que nous avons quitté L'appartement et Buenos Aires!

The happy home is so happy!!  I loved waking up daily to my sunny balcony.  The hosts were great, any questions I had were answered quickly.  The neighborhood is good, save, & convenient.  I plan to stay there again if they'll have me!
Buenísimo todo
Buena ubicación
Egle fue una anfitriona increíble, el apartamento muy bien ubicado, muy bonito y limpieza perfecta
muy lindo y como el dpto. el edificio impecable. excelente ubicacion. gracias!

Todo como lo esperamos. Un departamento cómodo para dos personas. Bien iluminado y ventilado. Tranquilo, varias tiendas y restaurantes cercanos. Tambièn bien comunicado, varios buses y el metro. Oscar muy atento y colaborador.

Local próximo do metrô. Bem tranquilo.
Aos fins de semana a rua é fechada para lazer, então fica um ambiente muito bom.
Opções de restaurantes e casas de cambio. De metrô, fica há uns 20 min dos principais pontos turísticos(Casa Rosada, Porto Madero...).

La pasé super bien en el departamento de Egle. Tiene todo lo necesario para
estar cómodo y la ubicación es perfecta para una estancia tanguera en Buenos Aires.
Personalemente siempre me importa tener una cocina para poder prepararme algo para comer. La cocina está muy bien equipada.
La comunicación con Egle fue espontánea, a tiempo y siempre directo. Me organizó el check-in temprano por la mañana y me dejo quedarme hasta tarde el día de mi viaje de vuelta, como mi vuelo salió a la noche.
Me encantaría volver! Muchas gracias por todo.

El departamento se encuentra en plena Avenida Boedo. Cerca de todos los medios transportes. Además hay variedad de restaurantes y cafés. El departamento en si es tal cual aparece en las fotos. Impecable. Seguro que volveré.

Квартира приятная! Мы провели там 10 дней. Окна выходят на две стороны, их можно открывать и проветривать, спать хорошо, кондиционер тоже отлично работает - в жаркую погоду это было важно. В квартире есть все необходимое, чтобы готовить еду, рядом есть магазины и лавки, закусочные. Место людное, безопасное. Что понравилось: это удобное расположение (можно сесть на автобусы в любое направление города) и самостоятельный заезд-выезд.
Из того, что было не очень удобно: детский сад под окном, и крики детей слышны в будние в первой половине дня, но если вы планируете уходить гулять, это не помеха.
И стоит учесть при выборе: маленькое пространство в душе, если человек крупный, будет трудно зайти или тесно.
Спасибо большое за гостеприимство, будем рады остановиться еще раз!
Appartement was zoals de foto's, comunicatie was goed en snel en de locatie was prima

Muy buena la ubicacion, sobre avenida con variedd de negocios y lugares para comer, muchos medios de transportes para movilizarse,.
El apartamenro muy comodo.

Egle was an excellent host.   Her patience and flexibility eased our stress when we learned our flight was delayed a couple of days.   She was also very accommodating when we decided to extend our stay one more month.  The apartments are as they appear in the pictures:  clean, comfortable and equipped with everything you need to make your visit to Buenos Aires as comfortable as being at home.  The location is also ideal since it is close to the Subway and bus stations, supermarket and restaurants.  Two thumbs up!

Communication with Egle was great. She always responded to emails very quickly and had great information. The apartment was wonderful, very clean and a fantastic location. I liked it so much I extended my stay!

The apartment was great and Egle was always very easy to get in touch with. She had great recommendations about where to eat too. It was an easy walk to the subte, a block from the grocery store, and in a very pleasant neighborhood (not too loud or busy). I liked it so much i stayed twice!

O apartamento é exatamente o que observei na internet. Muito bem localizado, próximo ao metro. O bairro é muito charmoso, possui desde padaria e supermercado a restaurantes ótimos. Além disso, ainda tem a Esquina Homero Manzi com show de tango e um excelente bife de chorizo.... A receptividade de Egle foi excelente, ela é uma pessoa extremamente atenciosa, uma ótima anfitriã.

Muy buena atencion y muy buen departamento. Egle fue muy amable y el departamento era confortable, prolijo  y muy limpio. Las fotos no son traicioneras. Fue muy facil de comunicarse con Egle y ella fue siempre muy amable. Gracias a ella por su departamento, por sus prontas respuestas... la pasamos muy bien!

This Studio was perfect for us. it was spotlessly clean, convenient and a nice retreat from a long day out in Buenos Aires. Egle was super helpful with directions and recommendations. There are many buses and a metro station close by making it a convenient connection to all the main attractions. Buedo is a lovely and safe suburb. i highly recommend this place.

Stayed here for 1 month. The apartment is spacious for a studio unit and beautifully decorated. Looks almost new.

It's located in a nice area in the Boedo district, right by Avenida Independencia. There are cafes, stores, and restaurants nearby. It's around 3 blocks from the E subte line and 1 block from the main supermarket, making it a very convenient location.

Egle was also very helpful and responded quickly to all my questions.

Highly recommended!

We really enjoyed our stay at this apartement. It's nice and clean and Oscar, the doorman, is very helpfull. Egle is a great host. She gave us usefull information about the neighbourhood and buenos aires and she always responded very quickly to our answers.

This apartment was PERFECT for my stay in Argentina! Everything was extremely clean and brand new. It looks better in person than on Airbnb. Nice little balcony for sipping maté while watching the sunrise. While not quite the center of the city, a cab ride was inexpensive and easy to go anywhere you would want - there is also a subway stop just about three blocks down the road. The apartment is on a well-lit main avenue with anything you could need in the neighborhood, grocery store, laundry, specialty butcher or wine and cheese shop, yummy restaurants, ATM next door, cafes. Good wireless internet. Weekly maid service. The doorman was incredibly nice and helpful even with my awful Spanish. Egle was a phenomenal host and while I didn't get to meet her, she was very easy to communicate with and very flexible. She also gave me a long list of recommendations for my stay in Buenos Aires! I hope I can stay here again =D

The host was great and accommodating with respect to key pickup / drop-off and apartment cleaning times. Egle was helpful by sending out an email with the neighborhood information such as things to do, restaurants, etc.

Note: Although this place technically falls under Almagro, it is closer to
many of the attractions of Boedo.

Egle was a wonderful host and was extremely helpful, warm, generous and very responsive.

The neighborhood is also great, definitely outside of the tourist circuit but with easy access to san telmo via subway and to palermo via taxi. Boedo also has a lot of independent theaters and is walking distance to almagro and abasto which are the center of the contemporary art scene in Buenos Aires. Egle's recommendations for restaurants (Pan y Arte) and theatres (Timbre 4) were also wonderful and spot on.

The apartment itself unfortunately is rather sterile and the layout is not at all cozy. It feels very much like a hotel room instead of a home. I think some of this could be remedied with more decorations, like some rugs and some softer lighting. It should also be noted that the apartment is essentially a small studio (hotel room sized) with a kitchenette attached.

The apartment was awesome, really good location near the Metro(Subte) and buses. It's very quiet and good for rest after a long day of walk , tour and shopping.  The Kitchen is very well equiped, all very clean the shower is hot . The neigborhood is nice there are some restaurants avaliable with good foods and very fair prices with awesome quality. I got a really good experience in this place and will come back on future trips to Buenos Aires. Loved it!

It is just like in the pictures. The location is good but it may not be the best one if you are not taking taxis all the time or if you don't like dealing with buses. If you are a walker or would rather bike around the city, you better stay in San Telmo or Recoleta.

The loft is a comfortable place and it has pretty much everything you may need. I think a few things could be better if you are staying for more than 4 days, like I did. There's no place to hang clothes to dry if you wash them, like underwear or socks. And there's only one towel for each person. For 9 days you may feel like you need new ones. Same thing for the kitchen towel. And I felt in need to clean the house a bit but there were no cleaning products.

I only talked to Egle by email but she was nice and gave us important recommendations.

At first I have to say that it was the cleanest and tidiest apartment that I have seen in South America. From the beginning I felt really comfortable. Also the location is very good. A big supermarket and the subway are close to the apartment.
Sadly, we couldn't met Egle. But she answered to every question we had and gave us a lot of tips for Buenos Aires.
I wouldn't hesitate to stay there a few more days!

O apartamento é exatamente como vemos nas fotos. É silencioso e bem localizado. Egle parece muito experiente no ramo e qualquer pequeno problema que aparecia ela o resolvia prontamente. Eu ficaria novamente no apartamento se voltasse à Argentina. A única coisa para a qual chamaria atenção são os equipamentos de cozinha: eles são limitados - não havia, por exemplo, abridor de vinho nem escorredor de macarrão, duas coisas muito básicas e que qualquer turista necessita. No mais, eu o recomendo.
PS: o apartamentos se localiza no bairro Boedo, não em Almagro.
My stay in the apartment was very nice. The place is very comfortable. It is located in a very centra part of the city easy to get .
Tivemos uma agradável estadia no apartamento. É de fácil acesso ao metrô e aos principais pontos turísticos. Nas imediações há mercados, padarias, lonas etc.

Lo pasamos muy bien en el departamento de Egle, es un departamento moderno, con suficiente espacio. Además tiene todo lo necesario para dos personas. Está muy bien ubicado con verdulerias, lavanderias, supermercados, restaurantes, etc., muy cercanos. Hay dos pinturas muy bonitas, (asumimos que pintadas por Egle) a la luz de las cuales y en compañia de un par de copas, pasamos con los amigos analizando su significado, en lo personal mi favorita es la del perro persiguiendo la llave. Definitivamente volvería a quedarme ahi.
Un excelente lugar para hospedarse.

Bueno, estuve por bastantes meses, solo puedo decir que el apartamento fue increible, desde los encargados del edificio que me ayudaron bastante y que tambien colaboran con la limpieza del aparta ( son de suma confianza) valio la pena
Bien equipado y súper bien comunicado. Un apartamento agradable y acogedor
Great apartment. Plenty of light, as promissed, and located on a very nice and safe area of the city. Egle was always helpfull, ready to solve any problem. Strongly recomend this place.
Confortável e com ótima localização, ônibus e metro bem pertos .
Muy buena anfitriona! Zona segura....muy recomendable!!!
fue un alojamiento,  cómodo, agradable , con todos los servicios de primera  y muy buena ubicación
El depar está ubicado en un muy buen sector: está cerca de fruterías, supermercados, restaurantes, etc. Además está muy cerca de lo distintos medios de transporte público.

100% recomendado, ubicado en lugar estratégico, tienes todo a pocos pasos, completamente independiente, limpieza total y muy confortable. Respuesta inmediate del anfitrión, Pues definitivamente lo recomiendo.

O Apartamento é ótimo e a localização também! Tudo  aconteceu conforme o previsto e mesmo não tendo conhecido a Egle pessoalmente,  ela nos forneceu dicas incríveis de como tudo funciona, e os melhores pontos de interesse.  Toda a Estadia foi Perfeita.
Muy lindo departamento, bastante nuevo. Cómodo y bien ubicado
Un lugar increíble, con todo lo necesario para sentirte como en tu casa

Logement très propre et agréable, nous y avons passé 4 jours. Egle était absente mais c'est Oscar qui nous a très gentiment accueilli. Egle est très réactive par messages et nous a donné pleins de conseils pour visiter la ville, prendre les bus, voir du tango,... L'emplacement est très bien, avec toutes les commodités nécessaires dans la rue.
Un lugar lindo, con espacio amplio. Fácil acceso. Muy cómodo. El edificio es silencioso, y por la disposición no se escuchan los ruidos de la calle. Ascender y descender es muy rápido. Recomendado!

El departamento es muy acogedor y agradable, posee buena ubicación y conectividad con metro y buses, además es bastante seguro, inlcuso de noche. Existe mucho comercio alrededor como restaurantes, bares y farmacias. Lo único malo es la ducha, la cuál es demasiado pequeña. Todo lo demás es excelente! A pesar de ese detalle nos volveríamos a quedar en el departamento de Egle!

Our host, Manuel, was very thoughtful, responsive & kind. If we had any issues- such as not knowing how to turn on the heating, or how to use the video- he would explain via whatsapp or come around as soon as possible to show us. He always responded immediately to any questions or problems. He also suggested places to eat & things to do. His English was very good.
The apartment was very cozy, & decorated beautifully. It had a small outdoor courtyard & balcony off the bedroom, which we loved as you could have plenty of fresh air.
The washing machine was great to have, as staying for around 7 weeks, we used it frequently.
The location was incredibly convenient, 2 minute walk to Alto Palermo Shopping Centre( very modern), 2 minute walk to Bulnes subway train station, very close to Avenue Santa Fe for buses. Palermo Soho was only a 20 minute walk away & the Botanical Gardens a 10 minute walk. Fruit & vegies shops & mercados(supermarkets) less than 1 minute away.
Although the apartment was ...

Manuel war ein sehr netter Gastgeber! Er gab uns eine Menge nützlicher Tipps und antwortete auf unsere Emails immer sofort. Das Apartment war sehr sauber und mit viel Liebe und stilsicher eingerichtet. Wir fühlten uns dort sehr wohl. Es war direkt im Herzen von Palermo gelegen und sehr zentral.
Manuel was a very nice host! He gave us a lot of usefull Information and answers our questions immediately. The Apartment was very clean and furnished with much style and love. It was amazing! It was located directly in the heart of Palermo and very central.

Manuel is a exceptional host. He provided helpful information like places to visit and restaurants before our arrival. Happy House is a cute old classic Buenos Aires home. We are so thankful for the resources provided. We used the maps, made mate, and enjoyed the open space.

We had a wonderful holiday in Happy House. Manuel is a perfect host, very communicative, always helpful and has lots of local's tips. Happy House is a really cozy decorated and well equipped apartment in a great location.
Thank you Manuel for hosting our family.

Eclectic and clean apartment with a lovely feel. Great air con, plenty of towels and bedding. Tiny but good kitchen! Safe and friendly area, super close to supermarkets and Alto Palermo mall. Subte (underground)  a couple of minutes away. Plenty of taxis around and we used Uber easily too. Stay there you'll feel at home straight away!

This was a perfect place for us.  I more private street so not  so much city noise (though we always travel with a sound machine and have it on at night when in cities).  The apartment is spacious and very comfortable.  Good bed and pillows.  Large plants at the windows give a protected feeling and nice filtered light.  If we ever travel to BA again, we will definitely ask to stay again.

Me encantó poder hospedarme en happy house, sentí que estaba en casa. El departamento es hermoso, amplio, muy limpio, al entrar se sienten las buenas energías, la ubicación esta excelente. Manuel siempre estuvo pendiente de cualquier detalle, es muy atento y muy amable.
Very nice apartment in Palermo,with personal touch,and practical location for discovering the city.We stayded there almost a month and felt at home....we made the perfect choice!

Manuel is a great host, very helpful and accommodating, made our stay easy from start to finish. The apartment is charming and well located. You have everything you need for your stay.
There was a general strike across the city and he let us stay all day there after our checkout so we didn't have to stay on the streets with out luggage for hours, top host!
Totally recommend!

Pasamos muy lindo en Happy House!
Todo fue tal cual como la descripción. Manuel estuvo atento a todo en toda la estadía.
Fuimos con Antonio que tiene 5 años y pasó muy bien, tenía su dormitorio y una casa linda para llegar después de los paseos.
La recomendamos y volveremos!

Maravillosa Happy House!! Nos quedamos para semana santa con mi familia: mi marido una bebé y una pequeña de 6 años, el departamento está amorosamente decorado con agradables espacios libres y muy bien equipada, en una calle bastante céntrica y nosotros que amamos caminar encontramos que todos los lugares turísticos estaban bastante cerca, como por ejemplo el jardín japonés, planetario, malva, museo de Bellas artes, plaza francia, centro cultural, millones de cosas por hacer y visitar.
Manuel es un excelente y preocupado anfitrión, se enfermó una de mis peques y hasta dato de clínica por si necesitaba me envio.
Muchas gracias por tu hospitalidad Manuel, te volveremos a visitar muy pronto!!! Hasta luego!

This apartment was great.  The location is perfect; centrally located in Palermo, close to the subway and the main city avenue (Avenida Santa Fe), restaurants, bars, grocery stores.  The apartment itself is clean, well-equipped with all necessities, and perfect for both shorter and longer vacations.  The host was extremely friendly and always responded in a timely manner.  Highly recommend!
I stayed at Happy House for two months and it was a wonderful experience. The owners were very responsive and even left us a bottle of wine and some sweets. Great for a short or long term stay!

Me ha gustado la ubicación, pese a estar muy céntrico no se escuchan ruidos molestos. Para ir en pleno invierno deberían equiparlo mucho más según mis necesidades, el resto es muy recomendable, María y Manuel son discretos y muy agradables, hacen que te sientas en casa! muy agradecida
Appartement recommandé

Amazing flat in a great location!
The communication for check in and check out was very good and helpful. I would definitely stay there again.

We stayed at the Happy House for over a week. We were recieved  by the lovely Maria, who is the most amazing host. She was friendly and easy to reach when needed, always trying to help. We had a great time! The apartment is spacious. The internet works well. There are basic things in the kitchen to cook. There is an ac both in the living room and bedroom which was good because we had some hot days. The location is excellent. There is everything within 2 blocks range- groceries, atm, cinema, metro line, pharmacy etc. The happy house is a good place to stay in Buenos Aires.
Ape super bacana, região agradável, proximo a varias lojas, mercado, shopping (mt perto). Tranquilo os combinados com Maria, que foi sempre atenciosa.

A Maria, que foi quem nos recebeu, foi muito atenciosa em todos os momentos e estava no apartamento exatamente no horário combinado. Quando precisamos falar com ela, respondeu as mensagens em seguida. O apartamento é lindo, muito bem decorado, as acomodações muito aconchegantes e limpo. A localização do apartamento é ótima! Fica próxima a shopping, mercado e estações de metrô. Super recomendo a estadia no apartamento Happy House!

Magnifique appartement dans Palermo, à un bloc du métro Buelnes. La deco de l’appartement est vraiment tres sympa, dans un logement bien fonctionnel. Le quartier est tranquille avec un grand super marcado a 200m, restaurant de grillade au pied de l’immeuble.

Really well located apartment, with subway and supermarket on the same block. Also three parks close by with playgrounds, which was important for us while travelling with a kid. Maria was very responsive and easy to contact for the duration of our one month stay.

This clean, bright, warm and safe apartment was a wonderful home for two traveling artist/friends. I stayed in the small room which is quite cozy but plenty big for one small or average sized person. If you are bothered by not having a door or need more storage space, this might not work for you, but I slept great.  The main room is huge with plenty of closet space.  Everything we needed was provided, and we loved our time here. Within walking distance to great sights (see the rose garden nearby) and many trains and busses.  If I can return to BA, I would be thrilled to stay here again.
Atención perfecta, muy buena ubicación, decoración y limpieza muy buena lo recomiendo altamente!

Happy House is truly a home away from home! It's well provisioned for a couple friends and/or a family, designed to be comfortable and cozy, has TONS of storage space in the master bedroom, and at a prime location to the train/metro for easy city access. María was our main contact and was absolutely delightful -- thank you for helping make our stay so positive and comfortable.
Apartamento é bem localizado, mas barulhento e indico apenas para casais, pois o segundo quarto  não é confortável ...
très beau séjour. Merci !

Muy lindo departamento, ubicado en pleno palermo, en una zona muy tranquila, el lugar esta muy bien ambientado y te hace sentir como en casa de amigos. El único detalle que tengo para decir, es que la segunda habitación es muy chica, no tiene placard, y no tiene puerta.
Awesome! Thanks for the stay!

It was our first Airbnb experience and it was very positive. The apartment is situated in a bit less trafficked street but still If you like to walk then both Palermo Soho or Hollywood are within walking distance and so is Ricoleta. We enjoyed our stay and Maria was helpful both with check-in (our flight was several hours delayed) and check out.

Piso bien situado, cerca del metro, a unos 20 min a pie de los parques de Palermo. Supermercado al lado de casa. Zona muy segura y poco ruidosa, muy buen lugar para vivir en Buenos Aires. Del piso las únicas salvedades, una habitación no tiene puerta y es muy pequeña y la cocina también es pequeña, no hay una mesa comedor al uso. La decoración es muy bonita y tiene el resto de servicios que se pueden esperar: lavadora, microondas, tostadora, aire acondicionado. En definitiva, estuve muy bien.

I had a wonderful experience at Happy House. The apartment is full of good energy - the building is older, and not sterile like many apartments are nowadays - it has soul and personality. It was clean, very comfortable, and well equipped with everything I needed in the kitchen (including a blender and espresso maker!), extra blankets and towels, washing machine.. everything. I loved the mornings with the sun streaming through the crystal in the patio, and the afternoons with the light coming through the trees on the bedroom balcony. Since I was there for work, I also appreciated the desk and the proximity of the large supermarket. María was wonderful and met me in person to deliver the keys at a time that was very convenient for me. Overall, fantastic value! I hope to return!

The apartment was as communicated and the stay was fine.
The disappointment was that a message had been sent asking when we were arriving. I was traveling and missed this message and also didn’t get a notification from Airbnb.
This miss resulted in us not being able to check in until 6pm after arriving at 1pm.
The expectation of the host that the result of missing one message caused this inconvenience.
I’d have hoped that the info on the Airbnb page stating that check in in from 11 would mean that a key is available from 11.
No attempt was made to communicate the impact of missing one message or to try to check if we had received the initial message... and this resulted in a poor experience.
Nice place!
The location is superbly convenient and safe!  We enjoy the daily walk around the neighborhood.  Good restaurants are nearby.  All in all, the stay is satisfactory!
Muy buena ubicación del depto para hacer base y dirigirse a muchos lugares de interés. El depto no cuenta con canales de aire ni de cable para ver en la televisión.

This is a really cosy gem of a place in Palermo. We had a wonderful 3-week stay there. The flat is like home from home and is very well equipped with everything you might need. It has very effective heating for the cooler winter days. It is very well located in the city. The neighbourhood has everything. It is also convenient for travelling to other neighbourhoods in the city. Check in and out were very smooth and flexible to fit our flight times. We wouldn't hesitate to recommend this as a wonderful and comfortable place to stay in Buenos Aires and would definitely stay there again. A big thank you!
Wonderful stay! Thank you so much for the hospitality!!
Hermoso departamento, muy cómodo y en una excelente ubicación.

O apartamento é agradável e a localização muito boa. O apartamento é bem silencioso e tem ar condicionado no quarto (o da sala não segura o calor). Na parte de baixo do prédio tem um restaurante (churrascaria) e o exaustor da quase que na janela de dentro do apartamento, assim, o apartamento fica no horário de almoço e de jantar com cheiro de churrasco. Não me incomodou, mas fiquei pensando em como isso seria para um vegano. O apartamento não tem nenhum luxo, não tem nem taças de vinho e também não tem elevador (ele é no segundo andar). Mas é bem aconchegante, com cara de casinha e ao lado do metro. A Maria foi atenciosa mas atrasou na nossa entrada, um acidente ao qual se desculpou. Ela até nos deixou ficar a mais do que o horário de check out. Muito real ao que apresenta nas fotos.

El departamento es perfecto. Muy bien ubicado, más amplio de lo que parece en las fotos.  Excelente ubicación y la atención de María y los chicos fue fantástica, siempre atentos a que todo estuviera bien. Volveremos !!!

I enjoyed my 5-day stay at “Happy House”.
I appreciated that the host accommodated my late check-in (my international flight arrived after 9PM).
The owner left the apartment with many details that makes it eclectic and cozy, and gives this AirBnB a unique personality.
The place was comfortable and well equipped. The kitchen had enough utensils for a short stay. There is a small table for eating (the only place in the apartment) and also a washing machine. The living room area was nicely decorated exactly as the pictures show, and the large sofa was comfortable for reading or working with a laptop. There’s a desk that I also used for when I needed to do some work. The apartment receives most of the light in the morning, and it gets dark in the afternoon.
The AC in the living room area worked fine (I was lucky that my stay was during cooler days) and just opening the window to the small internal patio was enough for me. The issue with doing that is that the apartment is located next to La P...

Happy House was the perfect spot for my stay in BA. Maria is a great host. She is quick to respond and solved any problem I had within that day if possible. One of the AC units broke while I was there and it was during one of the worst heat waves in BA history. She had someone come quickly and fix it. The apartment is very comfortable and roomy. I was alone but 2 or 3 people could easily stay here. The location is fantastic as its close to everything. There are markets and grocery stores within a block or two. If you like asado, then there is a parrilla right outside the front door. In fact, I could smell the cooking steaks sometimes. The restaurant also has a playground upstairs which is great if you have kids. However you can also hear the kids playing and screaming so that was a bit noisy. Not terrible, occasional.  The shower was hot with great water pressure. The bed was firm but not hard. Perfect for me. The kitchen is small but has everything you need. Even a washing machine to do your own laundry. ...
The pictures tell the story. A lovely place for one or two.Tree line streets, three food shops within two blocks and a steak restaurant next door. I liked it so much I extended my stay for week.

Es un departamento muy cómodo y acogedor, uno se siente como en casa. Muy bien iluminado y ventilado. El rincón del escritorio es muy agradable para trabajar por la luz natural que tiene.
La ubicación es excelente. La anfitriona fue muy amable y flexible para colaboranos en lo que pudo. Volvería sin dudarlo.
Everything good. As shown in the pictures. Location is great. The apartment is old but has all the basics. There’s a tv but no cable provider so you’d need to plug your laptop. Wifi worked well!
Maria, excelente!!! responde a la brevedad los mensajes. El lugar está muy bien ubicado y es muy acogedor
The location is perfect and the apartment is real perfect when you are working or traveling.
The place was great and Maria very responsive, would recommend for sure

Muy lindo departamento, amplio y con una ubicación perfecta. Ideal para estadías largas como la mia de dos semanas. Tiene absolutamente de todo. Sentí como si estuviera en el departamento de una amiga. María es super amable, responde cualquier necesidad rapidamente. Creo que también funciona muy bien para una pareja con un niño, ya que tiene un segundo cuarto muy pequeño agradable. Algo que no molesta, pero es para considerar es segundo piso por escalera. No hay ascensor. En sintesis, muy recomendable. Sin dudas, volveré

Great location. Coffee shop and restaurant literally downstairs. Sade area. Close to good supermarket, shopping mall, subway and transport. The host is very nice and helpful. It is close to the street so bring ear plugs if you are a light sleeper.
excelente lugar para pasar unos días en BA

This flat is absolutely perfect!
I felt at home the moment I walked in. The location cannot be better, there's a nice restaurant right next door and lots of great places to visit only a few blocks away, If you are a runner like me, you'll appreciate the big parks nearby.
It's a lot more spacious than it looks in the pictures, and both the balcony and the small private yard let in beautiful light and fresh air during the entire day.
Wi-fi signal was good all over the flat, the bedroom is big and comfortable and the kitchen has everything you might need, and more!
Next time I'm in Buenos Aires, I hope to stay there again.
As a frequent Airbnb user, it's hard to find a place like this. I highly recommend it.
Todo perfecto!
Spacious and cozy! Great location.
Incroyable appartement, proche de toutes commodités et extrêmement bien équipé ! Rien à redire, communication parfaite et très très bon rapport qualité-prix. Je recommande vivement.

Es la segunda vez que me quedo en este departamento. Lo volví a elegir por la buena onda de María, la ubicación y la calidez del lugar.
El departamento es súper cómodo y lleno de detalles que te hacen sentir en casa.
Lo súper recomiendo!

Possibly my favourite Airbnb that I’ve ever stayed in. Located in a beautiful, happening neighbourhood that offers lots to do within walking distance but is quiet enough at night. The apartment is very large, bright and stylish. The bedroom and bed are super comfortable, the living room is elegantly laid out, the kitchen is fully stocked with cooking supplies, and there’s a washing machine that you can use. Perfect home to come back to after a day of exploring Buenos Aires.
El departamento está exactamente como se ve publicado, buena zona fácil de acceder a todos lados, y Maria responde rapido y bien ante cualquier duda.

Increadible appartement. Beautiful and full of details that made our stay emjoyble. Amazing house, near to the botanical garden, supermarket and Alto Palermo shopping centre. Very cute neighborhood. The bed is large and comfortable, kitchen is full of utensilse, nice couch. A lot of attention is payed to details. 10/10 recommend and would 100% stay here again.
Excellent neighborhood and large, very amenable apartment. Maria was easy to work with and she even met me earlier than check-in due to an early flight arrival!
In spite of some minor issues here and there, normal for an extended stay, Maria was wonderful at all times. I really appreciate her attentiveness!!! ¡Gracias, María!
a great apartment with a lovely host!
The hosts were incredibly accommodating with last minute needs and switches to the reservation. They were incredibly helpful start to finish!

I stayed here for almost 4 weeks
The good: Nice area in Palermo, close to shopping, public transportation, restaurants. Nice street, nice trees, close to the botanical gardens (very nice). The apartment has old world charm, hard wood floors, seems like it has thick walls, (could not hear neighbors). Nice bathroom with good lighting, no problem with hot water. Good bed, slept well.
The not so great: If you have mobility issues (I don't) and have heavy luggage, you may need help - there is no elevator to the second floor. The biggest concern is the noise emanating from the restaurant next door. From 8:30am to 1:30am, there is a very loud continuous fan sound. I had to use noice canceling headphones during the entire time I was in the apartment to find peace. I'm surprised the other tenants tolerate this. Not recommended for people with sensitive hearing

I have to split the feedback into two parts.
Maria as my contact was very kind and always helpful, even supported me with some contacts to Notaries. More than expected.
Unfortunately the flat itself has past its good times. The house is very old, so is the flat. In quite a few parts of the flat, you see that the cleaning was not done for ages, the little room has a water damage with clear first signs of mould. The furniture in the living room is unfortunately very much torn down and sitting on them not a pleasure. The antique chairs for the desk, I did not dare to sit on them longer than a couple of minutes, did not want to break them...
The street next to the sleeping room is quite noisy, better bring earplugs for a good sleep. A dog of the neighbours is roaming the stairs frequently and goes every time he sees you literally into attack mode.
This is the best Airbnb experience that I have had, right in the best neighborhood of Buenos Aires.

Todo genial. Es una vivienda bastante antigua que ha sufrido algunas modificaciones respecto a las fotos pero eso no evitó que nos sintiéramos como en casa. Lo que más nos gustó fue el ventanal del dormitorio y la amabilidad de María.
Muchísimas gracias, María y Mercedes.  Me gusta mucho tu hogar.
Muchas Gracias Maria. Un placer todo.
Nos recibió María, es una crack, súper anfitriona, increíble el lugar. ❤️

I had the best time at Maria’s apartment, the surroundings were amazing and the size of the apartment was perfect for all those days I’ve been there.
She’s friendly and she took care of any issue I had.
I hope I can comeback to this apartment soon since I’ve felt like home.
Thanks so much dear Maria! You’re great!! 😊

Мы провели замечательный месяц в Буэнос-Айресе. Квартира удобно расположена в отличном районе. Рядом множество ресторанов, кафе и парков. Очень близко от метро. Не смотря на то, что улица днем достаточно оживленная, в квартире тихо. В квартире есть все необходимое даже для достаточно длительного проживания. Нам все очень понравилось, никаких нареканий.
Мария - замечательный хозяин, рекомендую!
Единственный нюанс в том, что в доме нет лифта, детскую коляску приходилось носить на руках. Для нас это не проблема, но для кого-то другого может быть важно.
Muy hermoso apartamento y súper bien ubicado!! María fue increíble en todo momento !! Súper recomendado

I just got back from Buenos Aires - and Mariano's delightful apartments were a highlight. Not only is San Telmo the epitome of what we were hoping to find in BA, the lofts themselves are light, airy and beautifully kept.

Mariano is always helpful, always smiling, and always someone we'd happily recommend!

We hired 3 rooms from Mariano and we had a very good experience in San Telmo. It was nice and tidy and felt safe.
I can really recommend Mariano for other travellers to Buenos Aires.

Joakim S - Stockholm / Sweden

We loved staying at Mariano's apartments on Calle Mexico. The location is fabulous. Great restaurants, bakeries nearby and easy to walk anywhere.

The bed was really comfortable. The unit was really quiet and so cozy. We had all the kitchen equipment that we needed and there was a grocery store nearby for coffee and food.

The only thing to be aware of is that the air conditioning is either all on or all off for all the apartments on one floor at the same time.

We would highly recommend staying here. Mariano is a great guy with a great attitude and his apartments are really a quiet and wonderful refuge in fabulous Buenos Aires!

The neighborhood made us a little nervous at night, but we gradually got used to it. It was great to be near the San Telmo fair on Sundays. The space itself was nice, although a little older and darker than expected. Overall our stay was good.

Had a fine time in BA!  Did not get to meet Mariano (he was working & out of town), but the loft was comfy and conveniently located for walking & public transport.  The San Telmo district is probably  best for younger folks, with it's broken sidewalks and doggy droppings all around, but it is a very interesting area with great tango, good food & fun people watching.  I would  definitely consider returning!

Muy conveniente, muy cómodo. A pesar que había algunas cositas que merecen la atención (luces que no andan, el piso del dormitorio tenía baldosas rotas presentando riesgo de cortarse los pies si andabas descalzo), yo creo que se arreglan eso, el lugar es bárbaro. Nos trajeron toallas por demás, y es muy lindo el patio que se comparte con otros huéspedes. No obstante esto, las fotos son mejores que en persona.
Me inquietó un poco que si bien el precio cuando lo contraté estaba en dólares, el aviso de la reserva vino en EUROS, espero no tener problemas cuando vea mi resumen de la tarjeta.... creo que eso es un problema de AirBnB y no de Mariano.

The apartment is really nice. The patio and the roof terrace make it a very special place.
Many thanks
Stefan

PS: Excellent Peruvian / Japanese fusion restaurant nearby: http://www.mbuenosaires.com.ar/

El piso es muy lindo y muy practico, la cama es comoda, esta muy bien equipado y limpio. lo unico punto defavorable es la falta de luz de dia.
Ademas esta muy bien ubicuado para los que quieren disfrutar del barrio e san Telmo, para nosotros el mas encantador de Buenos Aires. Es un lugar que aconsejaria a quien viene a pasar un tiempito en bs As!

The communication with Mariano was great. He was helpful with everything that i asked and he always replied within a few minutes or hours. The place is a great option for a couple or 3 people. It is located in San Telmo, blocks away from great restaurants and clubs (Gran Parilla Del Plata on Peru and Club One on Adolfo Alsina are my top choices). The subway (Subte) is just around the corner.

Fue una muy buena experiencia para nosotros la estadía en ese departamento. Se notó mucha preocupación por hacemos sentir bien y todo lo prometido se cumplió. Lo pasamos increíble. Gracias por todo. Fue una agradable y placentera estadía. Lo recomiendo de todas maneras.

Really well situated apartment in Monserrat (i.e. just north of San Telmo) close to the subtle and only a short walk from all of San Telmo, Plaza de Mayo and Calle Florida. The shared areas are fantastic, giving you extra space beyond the loft apartment and providing the place with a real sense of tranquility, while Elbio is a very enthusiastic and obliging host. It's worth pointing out that the apartment is a part of complex rented out to travellers - which meant someone came in and cleaned the room one day (which was great!) but we didn't know about it beforehand and left a whole bunch of stuff out (not so great). And while the kitchen is functional, it is really small, which might be difficult if you are keen to eat in, but there's so many good cheap restaurants nearby that you really wouldn't need (i.e. want) to!

The apartment is good for few days, but it's more like a hotel than just an apartment.
The whole building is dedicate for rental with tourist. That's not a problem as there is enough space (you'll not see your neighbor a lot), but if you prefer a stay in a flat surrounding by Argentinian, prefer an other place in other parts of the city.

The area is quite safe and you'll be able to find many restaurants and bars. Plus you'll be in the heart of the administrative commercial and financial city and close to the subway.

The building has a great "jardin d'hiver" and a superb terrace.
The apartment is good with no special charm.

Perfect place to be in downtown Buenos Aires, and yet, enjoy the tranquility needed. The host is very helpful and friendly, and the loft is very spacious. I will definitely will go back again! PS: Check the roof.. ;^)

El duplex no. 6 es tal cual como la descripción, y una muy cómoda y buena base para una estadía en BA. Aunque no lo conocí personalmente, Elbio fue muy atento a todas mis inquietudes, respondió rápido a los mensajes y ante un cambio de planes imprevisto que tuve yo, fue flexible con las respuestas. Muy recomendable.
Nice little loft, everything was clean and the common out door space was very good as well. Enjoyed my stay there.

I didn't stay at this listing, but booked it for a photographer that works for my company - Elbio was very easy to communicate with and Manuel (our photographer) had no trouble with checking into the apartment. He said everything was clean and convenient. The only issue he had was that the heat in the apartment wasn't working, although Elbio provided him with a space heater.

Very nice and good location~
I make a good memories in buenos aires!

Mariano war sehr freundlich und alles verlief unkompliziert. Die Wohnung ist super und gemütlich. Die Lage ist auch prima... Also rundum alles perfekt. Außerdem gibt es noch eine Dachterasse, die in der Beschreibung der Unterkunft nicht ausreichend erwähnt wird. Nur zu empfehlen!!!
Nice place, location and  terrace:) Enjoy

Zuni es muy amable. Nunca hablé con Mariano en persona pero tampoco hubo necesidad. Todo salió muy bien. El lugar es muy lindo y la zona es ideal para conocer lugares del centro histórico. Todo queda al toque y es muy fácil conseguir cualquier cosa cerca del apartamento.

I was able to stay in Mario's place for a month while I volunteered for a local charity. The location was perfect and central to everywhere you could want to be. It was close to bus lines, subways, restaurants, shops and so forth.  My family I and enjoyed exploring in the neighborhood. The rental itself is not plush like other apartments in the area. When we first arrived the apartment was very dusty and the shower curtain had mold. We had to ask for it to be re cleaned, in which Mario was happy to comply, but it took a day or 2 just with conflicts in schedules.   There were minor issues such as plumbing, electrical, and the ceiling upstairs leaked once or twice. The issues were fixed, however for a vacation rental, I believe it could of been a bit nicer. Lastly, the sofa had a huge rip in it with a cover that did not fit well. Would I stay at Mario's again? Maybe for a couple of days, but for a longer trip I would play a little extra for nicer amenities.

Apartamento bom, fica no coração de San Telmo, tudo realmente muito perto, da para fazer quase tudo a pé, é um bairro um pouco caro, mas aonde fica a parte histórica e turística  da cidade, fica a 2 quadras da feira de San Telmo no domingo. O apartamento é bem cuidado, e Mariano e Zuni foram bem atenciosos, auxiliando no que for preciso. Se for pegar motorista para transitar do aeroporto ao apartamento, leve o dinheiro já em pesos já. O apartamento fica no andar térreo e a área comum é muito boa e tranquilo. Se for ficar em San Telmo, recomendo o apartamento.
