Un buen sitio para llegar de paso con zonas principales y claves muy cerca. Muy buena atención y receptividad. Falta cubrir un poco los detalles en cuanto al piso, paredes y el olor de la ropa de cama. De resto excelente!!!

Elbio was very friendly and helpful during our stay. He offered to help with a taxi, was responsive with turning on the AC, and was able to make some last-minute changes with our arrival and departure times.

Un lugar muy tranquilo, agradable y silencioso.
El departamento estaba muy limpio, lo cual vale destacar. La cocina y baño tenian todos los elementos necesarios.
El espacio es bastante amplio y cómodo.
La casa es tal como está en las fotos y tiene un hermoso patio interno ! Me encanto
Ambiente familiar, excelente ubicación, cuenta con todo lo necesario es  una buena opción de hospedaje
O espaço é ótimo e próximo de tudo! As acomodacoes sao bacanas, tudo funcionando perfeitamente! Adorei o jardim :)
Elbio ,  un excelente anfitrión.
Un duplex espacioso y cómodo! Ubicado cerca de muy buenos restaurantes y bares. La pasamos genial!!!
El alojamiento es tal cual las fotos! Muy recomendable, en una zona muy linda. siempre estuvieron a disposición para sacarnos cualquier duda. Definitivamente volveríamos.

Very nice and stylish duplex apartment in the heart of San Telmo - my favorite area in Buenos Aires. Close to shops, restaurants and a lot of beautiful places to see within a walking distance from the apartment. Checking-in and out was swift and easy.
It’s a little haven in the middle of the concrete jungle! It offers peace and tranquility and it really is quite comfortable!
Muy buena opción para estar en un buen y cómodo departamento, Y una ubicación inmejorable para quién visita a Buenos Aires.
Bonito loft cerca de los ligares mas turisiticos y una respuesta rapida.

Muy confortable
Recomendable 100%

Un lugar excepcional en todo sentido, todo tal cual como lo publican, muy amables en todos los servicios, la ubicación estratégica ayudó a movernos y poder pasear por los mejores lugares de Buenos Aires. Recomendado 100x100. Ojalá podamos volver pronto, ni dudaría en contactarlos de nuevo.
Muy buena comunicacion con el anfitrion. Limpio y comodo. En una zona clasica de Buenos Aires.
Gran ubicación es tal cual las fotos el duplex

This is a convenient loft space in the heart of the San Telmo neighborhood.  My group of three came straight from the airport with multiple bags.  Elbio Mariano and Zuni were easy to reach and made check-in a breeze for us, and then we were off to explore.  Wifi was strong, bathroom and kitchen were clean, and we slept like stones.  The next day we checked out of the room at 10 a.m. but had access to the lobby area (with charming and eclectic decorations) to keep our bags until we left later in the afternoon.  We appreciate the hospitality!
Es un lugar muy agradable, muy bien ubicado, recomiendo pedir un depto que no de a la calle ya que está ubicado a la vuelta de un boliche y  el ruido de la calle es insoportable
Excelente ubicación
Muy atentos, muy cómodo lugar.

El lugar esta muy bien ubicado, para lo que lo necesitábamos cumplio su funcion al 100%,  era pasar una noche en capital por un evento, el lugar es espacioso, comodo, tuvimos un inconveniente con la mochila del baño y fue resuelto rapidamente,  eso muy valorable, mejoraria la limpieza general del inmuble pero sobre todo la del baño, y como sugerencia al dueño dejaria algunos articulos minimos necesarios en el baño (sobre todo cuando uno llega) como jabon para manos y mas papel higienico, el patio compartido muy lindo,  en general bien, la atencion de Elbio fue muy buena, respondio y estuvo atento.

Sergio was very helpful and friendly, the apartment was very nice and I enjoyed the area. There are lots of great cafes and restaurants close by. Olsen on Gorilitti is amazing. I've moved to Recoletta now which is much busier, I think it's nice to experience both areas

We had a wonderful trip to Buenos Aires. The apartment was beautiful and the location was perfect. Sergio was very accommodating and could not do enough for us. I would highly recommend this location!!!!

Tuvimos una experiencia maravillosa en Buenos Aires. El departamento supero nuestras expectativas. To do nos fue súper bien. Sergio era muy cortes y atento con nosotros y el portero también hizo todo lo que pudo para ayudarnos. En fin lo recomiendo 100%

I rented one of Sergio's 2 bedroom apartments for 4 people and we had a fabulous time. The apartment had all the modern amenities and it was clean, affordable and in the best location. Palermo is a beautiful neighborhood and we had cute cafes and restaurants within blocks of the apartment. Sergio was responsive to all my questions and very accommodating. He let me know in advance that the original apartment we had booked would be unavailable, so he put us up in the same apartment on another floor of the building and gave us a free nights stay. Worked out perfectly. I would stay here in a heartbeat the next time I visit Buenos Aires.

This was a beautiful apartment in a beautiful neighborhood in an amazing city!! I have used Airbnb several times before, but this is by far, the best place I have ever stayed. The apartment is gorgeous with an amazing view of BA. It is also in the perfect neighborhood, walking distance to some great restaurants, bars and shopping. The apartment is the perfect size for 2-4 people, is well decorated and the beds extremely comfortable.

Sergio was extremely nice and great to work with. He even helped us call a car service for our trip to the airport and worked around our travel schedule. When I make it back to BA, this is where I am staying.

Sergio is a great host, helping you out with any questions you might have in BA.

As for the apartment, is absolutely top shelf in Buenos Aires. I am definitely staying in this apartment next time Im in town.
Beautiful appartment, confortable, well situated with amazing view. Sergio and Mariano did everything to make our stay the best possible. Thanks guys! We ll be back!

We stayed in Sergio's "Penthouse/Terrace & pool/City views" for 12 nights and had an amazing experience. Sergio was extremely accommodating and the apartment was clean and perfect - exactly as described in the listing.

The apartment is great with two bedrooms and a large bathroom on one floor and a kitchen + living room on the floor below. Both floors have magnificent balconies with a great view of the city.

On the roof is a pool with a hangout area and laundry facilities.

On the street level of the building is a FANTASTIC bakery + cafe - Asturias - where we spent nearly every morning drinking cafe con leche and eating pastries.

Nearby in the neighborhood are several small grocery stores, a great hip vegetarian restaurant, and countless other cafes and restaurants. Not far away is a very trendy shopping district. Also not far away are two subway lines.

Sergio helped us with a 'Pack 'n Play' for our little one to sleep in. He also helped accomodate our ...

Sergio's apartment is *amazing*.  It is very clean, modern, comfortable, and has these breathtaking city views that can be seen from both terraces (or where the pool is as well).  Sergio was very patient with me during my 1st time booking through AirBnB and even while I wasn't sure if it would be one or two guests.  He also accommodated a very early morning check-out (3:30 a.m.) and Mariano, who also helped with check-in, helped to arrange a reliable taxi. Sergio's apartment has a nice binder with all the information in it a visitor could need or want which was excellent.  It is close to many restaurants, bars, and cafes.  It also happened to be about a 10 minute walk to where I was taking Tango lessons with Tango Piola which was wonderful and convenient.  I hope that when I come back to Buenos Aires I can stay in this beautiful apartment again!

Both Sergio and the apartment were great.
Sergio was helpful, great with communications, and an all around cool guy.
The apartment is just as you see in the photos, it's awesome. But perhaps the real gem is the location. It's perfect. On a quiet tree-lined street next to everything. Parks, metro, restaurants, bars, you name it.
Would have a hard time staying anywhere else on my next trip to Buenos Aires.
Thanks Sergio!

Had a wonder time in Sergio's Penthouse. Everything was just as described and in the pictures. Location is fantastic and very close walking distance to all the wonderful restaurants, clubs, bars.  Very short taxi ride to all the other burrows.
This apartment was all that it was said to be. Sergio was a great host and had all ready for us on our arrival. I would stay at this apartment when I return to BA.

Sergio was a fantastic host, and proved to be super flexible and accomodating to my changing schedule. This flat is thoughtfully designed and I would highly recommend it to anyone. Really made a tremendous difference to have such a nice place to stay in BA.

Très grand duplex neuf et modern dans un bon quartier. Aucun vis a vis, vue exceptionnelle, parfait pour 4. Tout est a proximité, superette, bars & restos, boulangerie au pied de l'immeuble. Metro a 800m, mais en fait il vaut mieux faire signe aux taxis dans la rue (prix très bas). Le seul bémol est la piscine un peu petite. Excellent rapport qualité / prix. Vous pouvez le louer les yeux fermés. Pour dire vrai c est le genre d'appartement que l on aimerait avoir en France. Sergio, gracias por todos!
Bueno lugar, agradable, buena localización

Acogedor apartamento, muy bien ubicado y cerca de muchos restaurantes y tiendas. Facil de tomar medios de transporte. La cocina muy completa, incluyendo utensilios. El edificio en general callado, tranquilo y agradable.
Muy buena decoración y con todo lo necesario para 2 personas.

Excelente todo! 10/10
todo excelente. saludos
todo tal cual la descripción, excelente lugar
Buena ubicación!!!el encargado Oscar fue muy amable y me explicó todas las dudas!,
Muy buena ubicación, departamento cómodo, anfitrión muy amable y encargado del edificio también.

El departamento  100% recomendado, ubicado en lugar estratégico, tienes todo a pocos pasos, completamente independiente, limpieza total y muy confortable. Respuesta inmediate del anfitrión, Pues definitivamente lo recomiendo.
Siempre atento y amable!
Todo ok!

Mi estancia fue fantástica, el departamento es lindo,  cómodo, luminoso, está en una zona que cuenta con todo lo que se necesita y más. Gracias Egle por todo.!!
Mi estancia fue fantástica, estoy muy contenta.

excelente lugar y ubicación, se llega fácilmente a los principales lugares de la ciudad. Cómodo y completo para cualquier estancia larga o corta

La ubicación es bastante buena, el barrio tiene numerosos servicios: cafetería, pizzería, supermercados, heladería, estación de subte a 4 cuadras, paraderos de locomoción pública a sólo metros.
Si quieres viajar de madrugada, no existe la facilidad para hacer el check-in a cualquier hora, sin embargo Egle nos facilitó adelantarnos el check-in en 2 horas.
Al lado del apartamento hay una guardería de niños/niñas, cerca de las 10 am se escucha el ruido de los niños jugando (solo de lunes a viernes). Para mi no fue un problema, pude descansar igualmente.
El wifi funciona bien, aunque algunas veces se cayó, sin embargo existen otras redes públicas a las cuales uno se puede conectar.
Lo recomiendo.

всём рекомендую эту квартиру! хороший район, рядом несколько супермаркетов и магазинов, много ресторанов и кафе, общественный транспорт под рукой - метро, автобусы! я жил один три недели, жильём доволен! чистый подъезд, чистый лифт, чистые коридоры, чистая квартира! отличный wifi, горячая вода, газовая плита, телевизор, удобный стол со стульями! невероятно удобные кровати! всём рекомендую эту квартиру как прекрасный вариант для туриста и для рабочей поездки!
Excelente disposición y comunicación. Todo en orden tal cual se muestra en las fotos, recomiendo el lugar para su estadía.

Agradecemos muito a incrível hospitalidade ofertada pela Mirta e por seu filho Mauro.
O apartamento é incrivelmente bonito e limpo e fica localizado em uma das áreas mais agradáveis de Buenos Aires, estando a poucos metros da Praça Las Heras, do famoso cemitério da Recoleta e de diversos outros pontos turísticos.
Além disso a anfitriã foi super atenciosa conosco tanto no check-in como no check-out e sempre foi solicita a todas as nossas solicitações.
Ficamos 15 dias no apartamento e tivemos uma estadia incrível e com certeza retornaremos.
Anfitriona de altisima calidad, amable, atenta y cuidando la mayor cantidad de detalles posibles. Altamente recomendada.
The apartment was good and the location is very convenient if you need to be near downtown. The host was very nice and the breakfast is included. Clean and comfortable.

Local super agradavel. Boa localização. E uma gentil recepção por parte da Sra. Veronica. Estou satisfeito.

rogerio

Our experience at Tucuman 2430 was great. Veronica and Luciano were great hosts and helped us in every way to make things easier for our fist visit to BA. The B&B is a cozy place only a few blocks from the subway D line.

Es un sitio cómodo para alojarse. excelentes anfitriones!!!
Resuelven todas las inquietudes. Maravillosos guïas turísticos y culturales. Los recomendamos!!!!

lo recomendamos. Cómodo, limpio, ordenado. Excelentes personas y guías turísticos y culturales.

El apartamento es como está presentado en el anuncio. Es cerca de varias líneas de metro y de buses. Luciano es sumamente amable y atento. Es una muy buena opción

El apto de Luciano es muy cómodo y muy limpio. Allí me atendieron sus inquilinos, porque Luciano estaba en Italia y fueron muy buena onda y tenían todo limpio. No tuve ningún tipo de problemas.

Pero repito, si necesitas estar cerca del centro, esta es una muy buena opción, imagino que de las mejores en la zona.
Hermoso departamento, amplio, luminoso y muy cálido.

Le logement de Luciano est magnifique et parfaitement propre. Ce fut un plaisir de rester là-bas dans cet environnement aussi sain. En plus Luciano est un super host toujours prêt à aider. I RECOMMEND

Es ist eine sehr schöne Wohnung, nahe am touristischen Zentrum von Buenos Aires. Sie ist sehr gut angebunden an die U-Bahn, es gibt sogar 2 U-Bahn Stationen in nächster Nähe. Die Wohnung ist sehr schön und super ausgestattet. Für ein paar Tage ist die Unterkunft zu empfehlen. Auf längere Sicht stimmt das Preis-Leistungsverhältnis nicht ganz.
Excelente. Nos sentimos como en nuestro hogar.
Muy buen alojamiento. Romina es muy buena onda. El lugar limpio y cómodo!

Eu adorei a minha estadia. A anfitriã fez tudo para garantir que eu aproveitasse plenamente a cidade de Buenos Aires. A limpeza é impecável e o quarto é arejado e confortável.
excelente anfitriona, ambientes frescos y aromatizados, privacidad
Lugar cómodo, grato ambiente, Romina muy dispuesta a responder cualquier duda, mucha disposición a ayudar. El barrio con buena locomoción. 100% recomendable

Mi mejor experiencia en Airbnb hasta la fecha. Romina es una verdadera superhost. Al regeresar de la calle siempre sentía que llegaba a casa. Cualquier cosa que yo necesitará Romina era mas que capaz para solucionarlo de manera rápida y amable. Mi cuarto era silencioso, fresco, con buena luz de la ventana y un escritorio para trabajar. El baño siempre estaba limpio y disponible. Usé mucho la estación de Ecobici que estaba a menos de dos cuadras. No tuve ninguna problema en el mes que estuve.
had a great time there thx alot!

Cristina é uma excelente anfitriã!! Ela me tratou muito bem, deu dicas sobre Buenos Aires, sobre lugares para ir e como me locomover pela cidade!! A localização do apartamento é excelente! Perto de tudo, podendo fazer muitos passeios a pé, indo a museus, praças e bares! O Apartamento é excelente, possui um banheiro privado pequeno e um quarto bem grande!! Recomendo muito!! Excelente localização, muito silencioso!! Há um parque muito perto que caso queira ficar à vontade sem precisar andar muito fica a 1 minutos a pé!

O apartamento foi ótimo para nossa estadia de 5 pessoas.
A localização é ótima. realmente muito perto das principais atrações da recoleta (dá para ir andando tranquilamente). Também fica bem próximo a uma avenida bem movimentada (Av. Santa Fé) na qual tem muitas lojas, lanchonetes e ônibus para todos os lados. Fica bem próximo do centro também, mas já é uma caminhada um pouco maior, eu preferi ir de ônibus, mas em um instante se chega. Também de ônibus chega-se rápido a região de palermo e a porto madero.
Quanto ao apartamento os dois quartos principais são ótimos, já o terceiro com a cama de solteiro é bem pequeno, assim como o banheiro que fica nesse quarto é um pouco desconfortável para tomar banho por causa do tamanho pequeno. O outro banheiro, que é comum, já tem um tamanho melhor. Todos os ambientes são limpos e arrumados.
Apesar de ter anunciado que tem aquecedor, não tinha. Porém, apesar de o clima lá fora estar frio o ambiento interno estava com uma temperatura ótima, o apartamen...

Very nice appartment. The service is really good, with 2 housekeeping days per week. The location is perfect and secure, close to all important places in town.
I definitely recommend it
The check-in was easy and very welcoming.
Apartamento aconchegante e muito bem localizado. Não conhecemos o Enzo, mas fomos muito bem atendidos pela Laura. Recomendo!

Nice apt and conveniently located.

Responsive and accommodating hosts.
Zona excelente, sobre todo con niños tiene una plaza cerca muy linda. Seguridad 24 Hs y cerca de av Santa Fe y dentro de uno de los mejores barrios.
It was great experience to stay here, location was perfect, and we feel secure in this neighborhood. Since we travel to Buenos Aires every year, hope I can stay here next year. Thanks Enzo!

El barrio es encantador, muy bien ubicado y en una linda calle. Laura siempre muy atenta y preocupada. Lamentablemente el wifi no funcionó 1 día y medio aprox. La limpieza del departamento es el punto más deficiente.
Excelente apartamento. Enzo realmente impecable. Laura fue quien nos recibió nos trato espléndido. Super recomendable
El dept esta muy bien ubicada y limpia. Hemos disfrutado mucho nuestra estadia. Volvemos seguro!

O apartamento é muito bem localizado, com tudo perto e portaria 24h. Muito seguro, com elevador e sacada. Muy lindo, grande y acogedor. Ubicado en un barrio relativamente cercano al centro que puedes ir fácilmente caminando. Great!
Excelente ubicación, todo lo necesario para una estadía super comoda.
La ubicación está bárbara y la coordinación  para llegada y salida del alojamiento fue perfecta.

Muy bien ubicado y acogedor.  La atención de Laura excelente, profesional y oportuna. Limpieza impecable, cuenta con todo lo que indican.  Solo un mínimo detalle. Todo bien, comunicación rápida, buen lugar, buena ubicación, barrio tranquilo. Sin duda volvería. Gracias Laura por todo!

sergio is a very kind and reliable guy. not only the apartment was absolutely perfect and beautiful - just like on the pictures - but also sergio gave us good advice for our stay in buones aires. the apartment is located in a great and safe area (many cute restaurants, bars, design stores etc.) and even during the hottest summer since 35 years the air conditioning worked well :)
best regards from switzerland

Sergio mostrou-se um ótimo anfitrião, inclusive disponibilizando uma pasta com dicas de passeios e restaurantes de Buenos Aires. O apartamento é perfeito, muito confortável e com todos os utensílios para a estadia. Recomendo sem restrições.

Le condo de Sergio est absolument fantastique et est situé dans un quartier intéressant. La vue de notre condo est à couper le souffle. Que de bons mots. Le condo est comme sur les photos et très propre. Sergio est un hote gentil, avenant, aux services de ses invités. J'ai perdu mes valises lors des transfères et il était présent pour que je puisse les récupérer. Vous pouvez aisément lui faire confiance. Je le recommande fortement et si je retourne à buenos aires je vais relouer ce condo.

Minha estadia foi excelente. Tivemos problemas com o voo e chegamos de madrugada e o Sérgio providenciou tudo para nos receber. O apartamento é lindo e confortável. tudo perfeito. Quando voltar a Buenos Aires quero me hospedar novamente neste apartamento.
Obrigada, Sérgio.
Sergios home is great fresh  and has a beautiful of the city.The porter was very kind and helpful.

What a fantastic place to stay in BA.  Sergio was incredibly accommodating and helpful.  My husband and I had never been to BA before; Sergio had many recommendations and travel tips.  I would highly recommend the host and the home for another stay.  If we ever return we will be sure to book again with Sergio.

This place was great.  Too cold to use the rooftop pool in the winter, which was on the  smaller side but would have been GREAT to cool off in during the warmer months.  Sergio took great care with his place, even had a binder full of useful info and recommendations ready for us.  The location was real convenient. No problems or hangups with this experience at all.

Sergio's place was fantastic, top of the line amenities and views of the city like no other! My only disappointment was that we stayed there in the winter time and not the summer, to be able to enjoy the rooftop pool. Communication was great between Sergio and his friend who let us into the apartment. I would highly recommend staying here and would love to come back in the summer time!

We spent 7 nights at Sergio's apartment and we couldn't of asked for a better place or location. The apartment is perfect size (there were 4 of us - 2 couples) with decent sized bedrooms and bathroom (great hot water) with a great living area downstairs with a more than adequate modern kitchen.  We stayed in winter and the heating was great. Extra blankets and pillows available for the comfy beds if needed. It is close to a very generous selection of restaurants,  cafes and bars in trendy Hollywood and a 5 minute walk to those in Soho. On the doorstep is a lovely bakery, an organic cafe and a boutique beer bar. They provided alot of information about tours and bars, and a folder in the apartment had everything you need to know in it. Great wifi too. Close to the train line and  Taxis are everywhere for an adventure to Central or San Telmo and it's an easy walk to Recoleta. Would definite use Sergio's place again in BA.

Alquile este piso con mis tres hijas y fueron los  mejores días que tenia en Buenos Aires. La vista es increíble desde el living y te permite quedar por la noche a dentro del piso con la impresión dominar a la ciudad; Todo esta muy bien equipado y super lindo; Es la impresión de un hotel de lujo pero con la mitad del precio. Ademas Sergio fue muy amable permitiéndonos ser mas flexible con los horarios y todo así que lo recomendó a tope para cualquier persona que quiere aprovechar del mejor piso relación calidad-precio de este barrio !! Maria

Sergio made our trip absolutely enjoyable by being very attentive throughout the entire process. Sergio is a great guy and everything that is published on his AirBNB advertisement is fulfilled to perfection.
We loved this apartment - great location, well-presented and Sergio responded quickly to my emails. Fantastic experience!
Loved Sergios Penthouse. great location, well described and the phots are accurate. Very clean and comfortable. Loved my stay in BA and this was def in part to this airbnb. Thanks Sergio!

Hemos pasado 3 días estupendos en Buenos Aires. El piso de Sergio, además de ser muy agradable, se encuentra en una de las mejores zonas de BA; zona tranquila pero a la vez con mucha vida (restaurantes de diseño y de variedad culinaria, bares de diversos tipos, tiendas y boutiques...). Cómodamente se puede llegar a los principales puntos de interés de la ciudad. Por otro lado, el piso es muy bonito y limpio con una vista increíble sobre BA. Por otro lado, la atención y ayuda de Sergio antes de nuestra llagada así como su rápida respuesta a cuestiones varias, ha sido de gran ayuda.

we spent 5 weeks in this amazing flat ! location is just perfect. Sergio and friends help you for everything. the building is safe, doorman is cool... for my next journey in BA, i will go there for sure !
thank you sergio ;)

We had a wonderful time in Sergio's delightful apartment.  The location was excellent with plenty of restaurants and bars near by and a fantastic panaderia next door.  The apartment was extremely clean, equipped with everything we could have needed, and a perfect base for the four of us to spend a few days in Buenos Aires.  We would recommend it highly and could not fault it.  Thank you Sergio.

This was our first time using Airbnb, and it was fantastic.  The apartment was exactly as described, and very clean and comfortable.  We were met by Sergio's wife when we arrived from the airport, and we were provided with a huge binder of information on what to see and do.  We didn't need much from Sergio, but the two times I contacted him, we heard back from him quickly. It was plenty of space for my husband and two children, and I don't think you could beat the view for the fireworks displays all over the city on New Year's Eve.  We were here for a wedding, and my dad and aunts and uncles were able to rent two other apartments in the building, which was very helpful.  The neighborhood is very safe and comfortable-- a little bit away from the hot, noisy downtown area, but very reachable to things by taxi or subway.  Great restaurants and cafes all over the neighborhood, too!
Friendly couple, who hosted us. The apartment ist great located, new cool designed, clean, safe and has a fantastic view over Palermo. Sundowner is amazing! Would always recommend it.

This is an excellent location right in the heart of trendy Palermo Hollywood. The apartment is clean, modern and nicely furnished. It's a professional operation so everything is taken care of with efficiency and ease. Highly recommend.
Recomiendo este alojamiento

Apartamento muito bem localizado pois já conhecia a região, apartamento antigo mas muito bem conservado! A Laura foi super atenciosa conosco, check-in e check-out feitos com extrema eficiência! Pelas fotos parece maior mas atendeu 4 adultos e 2 crianças bem! Recomendo e voltaria sem duvida!

El depto es súper cómodo, con todos los servicios necesarios para una excelente estadía, vigilancia 24 hs con personal super amable, la ubicación es inmejorable! Y la atención de Laura espectacular, super amable y puntual, muy flexible con la hora del check out.
Super recomendable!! Volveremos al mismo alojamiento, como hace años que lo hacemos cada vez que visitamos Bs As.
Ein nettes Apartment und toller Lage. Luxus nach deutschen Maßstäben nicht, aber mit Wohlfühlcharakter.

EXCELENTE!
Depto super cómodo y limpio, respuesta rápida de los host al momento de la reserva. Laura nos recibió de la mejor manera. Ubicación excelente.
Todo muy bien recomendable
O apartamento é muito bom, local tranquilo. A localização é excelente, próximo à restaurantes, ao metrô e também se consegue andar a pé por Recoleta.
Excelente ubicación, amplio departamento. Algo ruidosa la calle, pero relación precio calidad excelente!

Great location, if somewhat noisy. But the apartment is in need of renovation and photos don't really accurately reflect the current state of the space. Kitchen sink seems to flood. No laundry facilities. Basic amenities missing. Could be so much better. Was disappointed by the state of towels, bedding and pillows. Disappointing.
Es un departamento muy cómodo, bonito y en una ubicación excelente.

Lo mejor la ubicación, la recepción de portería. Todo lo demás nos ha dejado muy disconformes. Desde camas, colchones, hasta la limpieza. espero y les pido que cambien lo máximo que puedan el diseño y la calidad el departamento ya que la publicidad que tiene es Style design and luxury o pongan fotos veraces de lo que ofrecen porque no es de agrado pagar por adelantado algo que luego no se corresponde ni en precio ni en espectativa.

This is a great place to stay. It is located in a wonderful neighborhood with many restaurants near by. Very easy to get to other parts of the City. It is very clean & the host is very responsive.I would highly recommend it.
Tutto ok - siamo stati da Michele per un mese. Posizione ottima e casa comoda

O apartamento de Michele é muito bem localizado. Amamos esta região da cidade. É muito proximo da av. Santa Fé e da 9 de julho, tem restaurantes, mercados e comércio próximos, acesso a transporte público e é muito perto da Recoleta.
O apartamento é claro, amplo dentro de sua proposta, e acomoda bem 5 pessoas. Um dos banheiros é ligado ao quarto de solteiro, mas não foi impedimento para nós. O apartamento foi entregue limpo e com alguns mimos, como água e frutas. Ele tem uma cafeteira Nespresso (não consta no anúncio, ou pelo menos nao vi, então acho legal mencionar). A internet funciona muito bem. Os chuveiros aquecem bem. Roupa de cama e de banho bons. O prédio tem portaria 24h, é muito seguro.
Viajamos 2 casais e uma criança, nos acomodamos muito bem por uma semana e nos hospedaríamos novamente. Check in e check out descomplicados. Não precisamos usar ar condicionado, então não posso avaliar. Agradeço pela hospitalidade.

El departamento es precioso! Impecable! Y la ubicación es la mejor!
El barrio es muy lindo y seguro

Pasamos muy lindos días en el departamento de Michele. Nos encontramos con un lugar muy cuidado y limpio, con las comodidades necesarias para una familia de 5 personas. La ubicación es excelente como para salir a caminar y recorrer lugares icónicos de la ciudad de Bs As. Sin dudas lo recomiendo.
Muy buena ubicacion!! Limpieza 10, unicacion perfecto cerca de todo! Lo recomiendo

Excelente apto y el barrio genial!!
Muchas gracias a Sabrina muy amable su atención! Esperemos volver pronto!
Excelente ubicación, recomendado!
Local muito bem localizado, porteiro 24 horas e vizinhança bem segura. Espaço do apartamento muito bom, acomodou muito bem os 5 hóspedes.
Nos sentimos cómodos en el departamentos
bueno

A localização é excelente, dá para fazer muita coisa a pé e tem muitas lojas, cafés e restaurantes próximo. O prédio é seguro e, apesar de antigo, é bem conservado. A anfitriã respondia rapidamente e estava disposta a ajudar quando foi preciso.

El dpto no está bien mantenido.  No ponen ni jabón en el baño.  Solo 1 rollo de p.h. Para 4 personas x 6 noches.  Las toallas de muy mala calidad manchadas y percudidas.  Se veían sucias.  Las sábanas de yute y las fundas de almohada de algodón corriente que raspaban.  Las sillas del comedor rotas.  Los muebles de la sala en mal estado con cojines de adorno que parecían trapos. El puf con tapiz viejo todo rasgado.  Es una pena que un dpto bien ubicado y cómodo esté en tan mal estado de mantenimiento.
Very nice and relliable host! Would recommend any time.

We really enjoyed our stay at Ceferina's!

The apartment is in the Buenos Aires district, a few blocks from the Obelisk, the subway, Buenos Aires' best pizza and much, much more. Cooking in the kitchen was easy, and we passed many happy hours on our holiday. The apartment is lovely and quite cosy, and I happily recommend it to others.

A cozy apartment and good location. Very close to the metro, and many bus routes around. Supermarket and some restaurants nearby. Speedy and stable wifi. Well equipped kitchen.
Ceferina is very nice and even she was not in town and still reply our requests immediately. Her sister also helped us and ensured everything was okay. With Ceferina and her sister help that we spent a wonderful time in BsAs.

Caferina nos recebeu no apartamento no horário combinado e nos mostrou tudo como funciona. Foi bastante atenciosa e deixou seu telefone para contactá-la caso precisássemos de qualquer coisa.
O apartamento estava limpo e arrumado e tinha tudo o que precisamos (louça, toalhas, roupas de cama). Tem TV a cabo, a internet é boa e havia adaptadores nas tomadas. Tivemos uma ótima estada. Por fim, combinamos o horário do checkout com Caferina que foi até o apartamento para pegar as chaves no horário combinado e nos perguntou se tudo transcorreu bem e se detectamos algum problema no apartamento.

Ceferina was a lovely host! She met us at the apartment, like she said she would. She recommended some great places to eat within walking distance (less than 5 mins walk). I would suggest emailing her about places to check out: i.e. where to watch Tango (she will recommend a great place). Also, if you are arriving into BA by air (please ask her for Dante's contact). He took us to the airport. But had we had know, Ceferina has such a great contact, we would have wanted him to pick us up!

I recommend this place because its clean, super convenient location to catch buses (as most buses and subways) intersect in the downtown area, close to the Obliesk. If you like taxis, they are easy to catch in her area as well.There is also a close by supermarket. We took the opportunity to cook two meals at the apartment since we ate out far too much!

Safety-wise, the area is great. We had no problems being in downtown and her area is well lit with street lights.
