We had the best time at Ceferina's apartment! It has a great location (in the heart of the city) and it´s accommodations are very confortable for a couple. It was very nice to have (cook and eat) our christmas dinner at the apartment. The kitchen is fully equiped and putting the table at the balcony for our dinner was really a plus.
Beyond the apt, Ceferina was a great hostess always caring about us.
She's such a friendly person.
It was really a pleasure to meet her and if we come back to Buenos Aires we would surely want to stay at her's again.
We strongly recommend to everyone
Great place to stay!! Perfect location!! Ceferina is a great host she take really good care of my mom and sister during her stay. Thanks again Ceferina for all the assistance.

Excelente anfitriã. Nos recebeu na data e hora marcada, o apartamento estava em perfeitas condições e tudo correu como o esperado. Foi atenciosa em ligar e mandar e-mail para saber se precisávamos de ajuda e nos deu dicas de pontos turísticos. Fala inglês, espanhol e um pouco de português. Recomendo!

Our first airbnb experience was with Ceferinas place and it was just great! She met us at the apartment, showed us everything we needed to know and helped us on the spot fixing internet, as we noticed it didn't work! (After that it worked perfectly) We appreciated the balcony for a Quilmes and the really central location! You will reach any places of interest by tube or walking! The apartment is lovely and has everything you need! Ceferina was a really nice host and made us feel very welcome and comfortable! Thanks Ceferina!

Good location.
Ceferina helped me with everything that I needed.
Recommend

Ceferina me recebeu muito bem. Me ajudou com alguns imprevistos que tive com minha trip(muchas gracias :)) O apartamento é super confortável e bem localizado... tem tudo que necessita pelas redondezas (mercados, farmácias, restaurantes, bares, boates) e  apesar de ser central achei a vizinhança bem tranquila para quem busca tranquilidade. Super recomendo!!! ;)
The location is great. The pictures show the furniture in multiple locations, which make the apartment seem larger than it really is. Overall the stay was nice and Ceferina was a good host.

Caferina é a melhor anfitriã que pode existir. Nos sentimos em casa no seu apartamento que é lindo e bastante aconchegante. As roupas de cama e banho são limpas e perfumadas, a TV tem imagem ótima e vários canais cabo. Também é possível preparar refeições e tomar um bom mate, pois a cozinha tem utensílios práticos. A localização é outro diferencial. Fica perto de várias comodidades como: restaurantes, supermercados, farmácias, metrô... Dá para ir a pé até obelisco e outros pontos turístico, como o prédio do congresso. Nas redondezas também tem uma bela praça para lazer ou exercícios. A nossa estadia foi ótima! Seja a negócios ou turismo, o apartamento de Caferina é uma excelente opção e com certeza ficaríamos novamente!

Estuve 2 meses y me voy muy conforme con la estadía. Barrio muy bien comunicado para ir y venir por todo Buenos Aires.  El departamento tiene todo lo que se necesita, Además es muy silencioso, aunque está en pleno centro, Y es  luminoso. Ceferina muy atenta.
Muy buena ubicación, el apartamento tiene todo lo necesario! gracias Ceferina y Teresa!

El lugar es fantastico. Tiene todos los muebles y los recursos que una persona podría querer. Tambien los colores, la madera, y la decoración crean un ambiente calida, asi que se siente como si estuviera en una casa, y no en uno de esos airbnbs impersonales y genéricos. Recibe mucha luz en el departamento, y en la terraza se puede bañar bastante bien en la luz del sol. La presión del agua es muy fuerte, y hay mucho agua caliente, asi que se puede disfrutar bien la ducha. El lugar estaba muy limpio. Y la anfitriona es muy atenta y gentil. Me dió mucha información sobre el barrio, y me ayudó mucho en el checkout cuando tuve problemas encontrando una taxista. El barrio es encantador. Hay la arquitectura y los torres beaux arts por todos lados, y el parque del congreso, donde caminaba cada día. El barrio es un barrio muy de buenos aires, mas que otros barrios que intentan replicar estilos modernos de otros paises. Es el barrio mas interesante en mi opinion.

This is an old apartment located very well for foreign visitors. Everything works as it should with a washer and balcony, Avenida Corrientes is two blocks away withe the theater district and all restaurants. Western union is three blocks away in Congress Square and supermercado Coto is two blocks away. Ceferina is easy to communicate with and is attentive. Fair value for the money.
La atención como el lugar de estadía son de lo mejor...
Laura was a great host. She shared the best of her knowledge of the city, all her recommendations were spot on. Definitely recommend staying with her!

Las fotos son reales, la atención de Laura impecable al igual que la Sra. encargada del edificio. Nos sentimos seguros y super cómodos. Altamente recomendable. Para destacar: los pequeños detalles (café y té a disposición) son los que hacen la diferencia de un buen servicio.
La localización es excelente. Para 4 personas es apenas justo pero es manejable. Deseable algunos detalles menores que mejoraran el comfort.
Todo estuvo bien
Excelente estadia!
Clean, has what you need, and is a great location.
Muy buena ubicación con todos los servicios a mano, por la resolución rápida de las situaciones planteadas, el alojamiento resulta placentero para ubicarse en el corazón de Buenos Aires.
Um apartamento muito bem localizado a quem quer conhecer Buenos Aires. Apartamento limpo e silencioso Laura foi uma ótima anfitriã. Certamente voltarei...
Yes, the neighborhood was great and the apartment pictures were very accurate.

Vi kunne ikke ha vært mer fornøyd med leiligheten vår og med oppfølging fra Sergio. Bilder og tekst fra nettsiden lyver ikke, utsikten var enda flottere en bildene viser. Vi var to voksne og et barn på 9 år som storkoste oss i tre uker. Vi benyttet bassenget på taket mye, og hadde bassenget nesten alltid for oss selv. Hyggelig folk som jobbet i huset og hyggelige naboer. Etter besøk mer sentralt i Buenos Aires var det alltid like deilig å komme hjem til det rolige og fredlige Pallermo Hollywood. Vil anbefale leiligheten på det varmeste og vil veldig gjerne leie den igjen.

Couldn't have been better.  Pictures can't even do this apartment justice - the view of Buenos Aires is incredible, we had a great time hanging out on the upper and lower patios, opening up the sliding door to the kitchen and living area, and watching the sunset from the pool on the roof.  Check in was easy, and Sergio and his wife were happy to help in any way.  Perfect location, surrounded by Palermo's shops, bars and restaurants (check out the bakery right downstairs for bread and pastries in the morning).  I'd recommend this to any of my friends and would absolutely stay again next time I'm in BA.

Great apartment with a wonderful view in a very good location, with restaurants, cafes and shops nearby. Sergio was very helpful - we even could leave our luggage before check in and after check out with the doorman.

Excellent experience throughout.  Sergio was a great host and made our stay very comfortable.  Great walking neighborhood, ample dining options a few minutes away.  Subte (subway) options 10-15 minutes away.  The flat is just as described... excellent views and very nice architectural details.  Will definitely look forward to staying again next time I'm in B.A.
The apartment is perfectly located and has a incredible view. Everything was clean and ready when we arrived. Sergio was very kind to us. Would definitely stay here again. Perfect.

The place is amazing: great view, great neighborhood, and very comfortable.
Sergio is very solicit and the neighbors too!
I will definitely get back some time.

Sergio's place was perfect and exactly as advertised!!  Sergio and his English-speaking friend met us upon checkin and were very helpful and informative.   The place had an amazing view and was very clean...the location was perfect as there are so many restaurants and bars nearby to explore.   Sergio was very friendly and responsive to any questions we had.   Thank you so much Sergio!

El departamento es MUY lindo, funcional y por sobre todo cómodo. La ubicación es excelente, muchos bares y restaurantes buenos cerca. La panadería que esta al lado es altamente recomendable!! . Sergio fue un anfitrión genial, nos dio toda la información que necesitábamos y estuvo a disposición. Recomiendo el departamento sin dudar, y lo elegiría para mi próxima estadía en Buenos Aires!

Muy buenas recepcion y explicacion del uso y servicio disponible.
Muy recomendable, lugar muy bonito y acogedor.

Sergio a été d'une disponibilité incomparable. IL a été très serviable et réactif.
Le logement est spacieux, très propre et très bien situé. Parfait pour une famille ou deux couples. Il est situé dans un quartier très sur, entouré de nombreux bars et restaurants.
Great apartment and location - highly recommended!
This was a great place and it looks exactly as the photos. Wonderful location. I would absolutely stay here again!
Great apartment! Exactly like the photos. We stayed for a week and would definitely recommend Sergio's place

Very Accommodating host. Apartment is beautiful with amazing views and located in an excellent neighborhood. Plenty of restaurants/bars located within walking distance.
Great Bakery and bar located on the first level. This unit is on the 4th floor (top level)

My mother, her friend and I all stayed at his beautiful condo. The place was in a great location, we felt extremely safe and nearby great bars and food!
Sergio was by far an excellent and experienced host, from detailed information on restaurant recommendations, to taxis to money exchanges -he was accommodating, very helpful and friendly. We all enjoyed the condo and would definitely stay here again and recommend him to anyone coming to Buenos Aires. Gracias por todo!
O apartamento é exatamente como nas fotos. A vista é maravilhosa. O chuveiro funciona bem. Tudo perfeito. O Sergio e a esposa são super atenciosos. Com certeza recomendo.
La estadía fue impecable, el departamento supero las expectativas, es más fácil cuando se trata con gente seria y confiable como Sergio. La ubicación es inmejorable y el departamento espectacular
Great place. Great help from Sergio. Highly recommended.

Localização perfeita, excelentes condições de habitação com tecnologia e bom Wi-Fi.
Uma excelente Padaria no r/C e uma série de bons e excelentes restaurantes, bares e galerias.
Um excelente Anfitrião porque ausente, mas presente, sempre...
Absolutamente a repetir .

I had such a great time staying at Sergio's place in Palermo. It's the perfect location for an American tourist to live in while visiting BA. The apartment was great, clean, and has spectacular views.

We stayed for three nights in August. The apartment is very nice and Sergio was very accommodating of our late check in and early check out. There is also a binder full of restaurant/bar suggestions for Buenos Aires and a number of guide books scattered around the apartment which were helpful. We would definitely recommend staying here.

The apartment was fantastic! Beautiful views, an amazing location and neighborhood. Located on top of a great beer bar and an awesome cafe & bakery. We had a great time in Sergio's beautiful apartment.
When we arrived Mariano gave us a great tour and explained the area to us in great detail. (Very Helpful!)
Had a great time in Palermo thanks in part to this amazing apartment.
Cheers!

Sergio was great! The place was beautiful and he was super helpful whenever we needed help with something. He helped us exchange our US dollars into pesos and made our stay very welcoming. The photos are very accurate as to the look of the apartment. I definitely recommend the apartment and Sergio!
Excelente ubicación. Espacio amplio, cómodo e independiente. Laura responde oportuna y cordialmente todas las dudas y consultas que se le hacen.
Excelente todo!
Localização do espaço boa, mas o espaço não estava bem cuidado e falto um pouco de zelo para 4 hóspedes que ficariam 10 dias.
Excelente ubicación, precio accesible, muy buena atención
Todo excelente, la ubicacion, el lugar, todo por ahi algunos detalles menores, pero lo recomiendo sin dudas
Todo en orden. Recomendable. Muy buena ubicación. Confortable. Todo lo necesario.
Muy bien ubicado, recomiendo
Excelente ubicación. Anfitriona disponible. Departamento cuenta con todo lo que publica, Iluminado y ventilado. Lo recomiendo.
Excelente ubicación

Evaluó muy mal tanto el departamento de Laura como la actitud de ella, le  pedimos  el favor de guardar maletas por unas horas y dijo que era imposible, le comentamos  que el vuelo estaba retrasado y dijo que no podíamos entrar hasta el día siguiente, eso incurrirá dormir en el aeropuerto, le duplique y me dejó las llaves con la administradora por 20 dólares de más.... Y esas camas son para niños, eramos 2 personas y las camas eras de 90 centímetros de anchas y sonaban horrible... Hay muchos apartamentos al mismo valor pero de calidad humana y con anfitriones cálidos y generosos... Nos saco a las 10 a.m y no entendió que el vuela 6 pm... 8 horas con maletas en la calle.... Por favor turista.... No recomiendo ni el sitio, ni el apartamento ni la actitud de la anfitriona.

Lugar inmejorable en cuanto a ubicación. Con todo lo descrito perfectamente, no faltó de nada. Todo genial en cuanto a indicaciones y normas del apartamento.
Muy recomendable
Ubicación excelente, apartamento muy cómodo, limpio, igual que en las fotos. Dormitorio con dos camas individuales y dos sofá camas individuales en el living.
Excelente ubicación, muy confortable el dpto,  y muy agradable Laura!!!
Buena ubicación y Laura muy amable

El trato fue excelente y oportuno. El apartamento, acogedor y muy limpio, con todo lo necesario para la ocasión. Y la ubicación excelente: teatros, gastronomía, subte, a pasos de la Av. 9 de Julio. Muy recomendable. Esperamos volver.

Mi vuelo se demoró de forma excesiva por tormentas eléctricas en Buenos Aires. Se terminó retrasando más de 3 horas. De toda esto informé a Laura desde que llegué al aeropuerto, desde las 5 de la tarde. Varias veces me dijo que me esperaría en el departamento, sin mostrar inconvenientes.
Pude obtener mis maletas después de medianoche. Informé a Laura que había pedido un taxi y que, por la larga espera, demoraría 40 minutos. Me llamó y me dijo que no podía esperar tanto, que tomara un auto de la calle, me fuera al departamento y, luego, regresara por mi familia. Le dije que le pagaría el transporte para que se regresara a su casa. Me dijo que "el problema no era el dinero, sino la hora"...
Al llegar, después de mostrarme el departamento, me hizo un cobro de 20 USD, por "Late check in"...esto aparte de que no se lee en ningún lado de su anuncio (sobre el cobro), jamás me lo comentó por teléfono. Además, está prohibido hacer cobros fuera de la plataforma. Ya presenté mi queja a AirBNB.
Laura fue una persona muy amable en todo momento se preocupó por que no sintamos cómodos y nos hizo muy fácil el checking y el check out

Great small apartment within the cool Faena Hotel. Good, practical layout with complete Kitchen.
You are basically renting a hotel junior suite that is owned by an individual at a discount to the hotel pricing. Includes full use of hotel amenities - when I was there they offered free yoga classes etc.
Only drawback is that hotel cleaning service is not included and the hotel overcharges the residents for this service.
The host canceled my reservation 10 days before arrival.

Brigitte was amazing, she was very interactive and made sure everything was taken care of, she was kind enough to send follow up emails during our stay and made sure that the Management company took great care of us and they did :)

I will definitely rent from her again :)

This place was absolutely perfect. Brigitte was so helpful and responded to our every need. She was an amazing host. The place was extremely clean with beautiful furnishings and set in the fantastic Faena Hotel. The service and amenities were a dream. I would most definitely stay there again. It couldn't have been a better vacation. Thanks again!

Brigitte was super helpful in assisting me before my travel to Buenos Aires - she gave me advice on how to get to the apartment, which taxi to take, etc. The apartment was very clean and very well equipped. It's very well designed and in a lovely hotel complex, with access to the hotel gym and sauna, free of charge.
She checked in with me regularly to ensure that my stay was going well and was the ideal hostess. I would definitely recommend staying at this apartment in a great area of Buenos Aires.

The room Daza provided was being incredible. Bedding, couches, decor, bathroom.... super confortable modern and WITH A VIEW of the water in Puerto Madero. Private concierge, incredible pool and bar downstairs. Incredible value. I was blown away.
------------
La pieza q Daza me aquilo era increible. La cama, las sofas, el decor y el bano espaectacular .... re comodo moderno y con vista de la agua de Puerto Madero. Tenia concierge privado, pileta increible y un bar de lujo abajo. Re barato por lo q recibi.

Brigitte was an exceptional host. She was available the entire trip not only for questions regarding the room, but questions about the city, neighborhood restaurants, nightlife, exchanging money etc.

On top of this, the apartment was stunning and extremely well kept with all the amenities you could need (including Netflix!). our favorite part was the pool and restaurants within the hotel. Would without a doubt stay here again. thanks Brigitte!

Bridgette was a concerned and helpful host - always available to help us with everything! Her home is absolutely perfect. It is placed in a great area of the city and easy to walk around. We had our baby with us and she was able to swim in the pool and play on the grass and swing set placed at the hotel. The staff at the Faena also helped make our stay really easy making great reservations. Best way to enjoy this awesome hotel!

Brigette was the most kind and gracious host we've come across. Very responsive and easily accessible and the front desk team was always willing to help. It's a super seamless hotel and private residence experience we've had in this type of property. The room was large and very luxurious and met all our expectations. Every time we're back in Buenos Aires we will always stay at Brigette's place.

Vielen Dank, Brigitte - wir hatten einen fantastischen Aufenthalt in Deiner Suite!

Brigitte hat uns super auf den Aufenthalt vorbereitet (Wechsel von USD zum attraktiven Dolar Blue in Pesos, Maid Service, etc.). Aber auch der Aufenthalt selbst hat unsere Erwartungen übertroffen: grosse, sehr geschmacksvoll und im Philippe Starck-Style dekorierte Wohnung - es hat an wirklich nichts gefehlt! Alles hat wunderbar funktioniert und wir kommen gerne wieder.

HIGHLY recommended!

One of the best places I've ever stayed. And this condo is in the Faena, one of the best hotels in Buenos Aires, if not all of Latin America. I would stay here again and again. Brigette made us feel welcomed and her place is - fabulous! Thanks!

La suite de Brigitte es absolutamente excepcional!! incluso destaca entre las opciones que el hotel puede ofrecer. Bella, espaciosa, cómoda, con una decoración muy cuidada y que invita a la relajación, y con todo lo necesario para una estadía inolvidable, tanto de corto como de largo plazo.
Brigitte es una excelente anfitriona, pendiente de todos los detalles, y manteniendo una fluida comunicacion en caso de necesidad. El barrio es muy tranquilo y seguro.
Definitivamente recomendable.

This was my first AirBNB experience, and Brigitte made it amazing!  Her home was incredible, and the staff/concierge were extremely helpful.  The residence is everything you expect it to be, and thoughtful touches / amenities everywhere.  Brigitte herself was extremely prompt, helpful, and nice- I would probably only stay here on a return trip.  Everything was perfect, and went off without a single hitch.

We had such a wonderful experience at Brigitte's place . Faena is one of the best hotels in BA (if not the best) and the residence shows that in every detail: from the wall to wall marble in the bathroom to the way the staffs pampers you. Brigitte arranged thoughtfully all the details in advance about our stay and was available for any doubts at all moments. The quality/price ratio is definitely unbeatable . Oh, and Puerto Madero neighborhood is just the HOT SPOT now in Buenos Aires. Definitely we'll be booking again Brigitte's whenever visiting Buenos Aires.
Great place to stay would go back here if ever in BA clean comfortable and use of the hotel highly recommend it

This is the third time I have stayed here the apt is perfect I used all the facility's in hotel but with the benefits of having a nice big clean comfortable space brigitte was so helpfull and easy to communicate with I highly recommend staying here will be back next year

Brigitte is simply the best. Her suite is immaculate and her ability to host is uncanny. She made us feel very welcome and set us up with everything we needed. I can honestly say this was the best vacation my girlfriend and I have ever taken.

Her suite is located in the best neighborhood of Buenos Aires (Puerto Madero), which is safe a beautiful. It was easy to get around and see the rest of the city.

Buenos Aires is amazing, as is Brigitte's suite. We will definitely be back again.

What a amazing experience Brigitte left me, on my holiday to Buenos Aires. This was only my second time using Airbnb. My first experience was not so memorable, everything that could go wrong did. So when I decided to try again on my trip. I was more careful in my demands. Being a airbnb host myself. I expect the best. I feel Brigitte home exceeded all my expectations. Not only was I staying in one of the Top hotels in Buenos Aires. I had full access to all of the Faena Hotel. I was able to order room service 24hrs. After a late night in the city this was an amazing luxury. I also enjoyed the huge gym , pool and all the Restaurants. I even went to see the famous Red Tango show. Located in the hotel. During check in I was asked to leave my credit card info. All was charged at the end of my stay. The concierge sits with you and goes through the bill. All was perfect. Food, spa treatments, drinks and tango show is your responsibility. I love the fact residents concierge was just a phone call away for all my ne...

Faena was a great escape from busy downtown. Dazza was a wonderful hostess. Her suite was absolutely gorgeous with a breathtaking view of the water. Max at concierge was outstanding in accommodating us in everything we needed from where to dine, nightlife and shopping. He made great recommendations. Dazza was easy to reach. She was extremely prompt in answering all our questions. Thank you for making our experience in buenos aires unforgettable.
She was not physically there, but it felt as if she was. She was attentive to all details.
Great service!!  Excellent apartment. All work perfect!!  Thanks again
Excelente suite!!! Muy amable el personal del hotel.  Estadía maravillosa. Hermosa vista
Todo perfecto impecable. Brigitte se porto de 10. El lugar increíble. La atención fue espectacular. También lo recomendare en tripadvisor. Muchas gracias y volveré pronto
Brigitte is a great host! Beautiful suite at the famous Faen. Big savings compared to their regular room rates. Fully equipped, nothing was missing. Highly recommended! Will stay again!
todo perfecto como siempre, sin duda volveré!!!
Thank you very much for the great hospitality, we had such an amazing time and i'm in love with your apartment !!  thanks again 5 *

Brigitte's place is better than any 5 star hotels in the US! It feels like a suit in a traditional high-end hotel in Europe. And you get to enjoy all the facilities such as the steam room and the swimming pool from the hotel.  The concierge is really helpful and nice too! Speaking about Brigitte, she is the most helpful and nice host ever in airbnb! She give you the most detailed directions and prepared you with wine and chocolate at the apartment. Easy to reach as well! Strongly recommend!!

Brigitte was the perfect host. Really clear instructions before arrival and great communication throughout.
The apartment at the Faena Hotel was a home from home. There was real attention to detail in order to make us feel welcome and you could tell it was a home that was loved. It was wonderful to have access to all the hotel facilities like the pool and room service while having the flexibility of an apartment. The staff were friendly yet professional. The pictures match the reality and we would love to return again. That's the best recommendation.

Exceptional apartment that elevated my experience of B.A. It was very clean, comfortable and well equipt. The only bad thing about it was my friend and I had to leave it each day to go exploring the city :)

Sergio was very professional ensuring no delays for key handover meaning a seamless arrival with minimal disruption after long travel. Lots of local info provided, and always in contact if needed/reliable.

The positioning of the apartment is second to none- very very close to 3 top recommended bars in town, lots of cafes and restaurants meaning it was a great base to explore but also feel part of the area for local experience.

The best place I could ever pick the location is blocks away from plaza Serrano on your way to it you have a lot of very cute restaurants also clubs are around the corner too and next door is a bakery also a beer pub !! Can't go wrong Sergio was very nice and helpful too he recommended a couple of places and in his apartment he have a folder with all the things that you may need including 24 hours pharmacy hospitals Togo restaurants we love the place we definitely going back !!!!!

reviewer_name: Hugo M. Pesa Y Cia S.R.L.
comments: La experiencia fue excelente . Muy buen dpto y muy buena la atención . Totalmente recomendable . Gracias

We loved this apartment and the Palermo area it is in. The apartment is modern with all of the mod-cons. Beautifully appointed with a full kitchen and beautiful bath, living area, and balconies (incl hot tub) overlooking the city.
Palermo is full of cool cafes and shops - you'd have to spend weeks or months just to try them all. Beyond Palermo we tended to walk everywhere, though we did catch Subte some days (beware that Subte stops at 11pm which is weird for a city where people don't eat dinner till 10 or 11 pm). Sergio was super helpful - emailing beforehand and answering all emails promptly. Although he wasn't in BA when we stayed, he arranged for a friend (Mariano) to meet us - he too was super helpful. They helped with exchanging USD both when we arrived as well as later in our stay. The apartment also has a laundry (if you don't want to use a service in the neighbourhood) - which was also great.. there is a mini-market a block away for necessities.

We can't recommend this apart...

Sergio's penthouse was amazing! From the views to the neighborhood. I couldn't of chosen a better property. Everything you need to know about the area and building is written down for you. Sergio was out of town but his friend Mariano checked me in and showed me everything I needed to know. Everything went very smooth and communication with Sergio couldn't of been better. I hope to return. Friendly doorman too!

I had a terrific stay at Sergio's place. It's great apartment in a perfect location. Sergio was a fantastic host who made sure that everything went smooth with our stay. Thanks again! I can definitely recommend this place for your stay in Buenos Aires.

Sergio made my group feel very welcome. We had an easy and smooth check-in process once we arrived in Buenos Aires. The apartment has fantastic views of the city from its terrace. The inside was spacious and comfortable for our group of 4!

I would highly recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Buenos Aires.

This was the first time I have booked accommodation through Airbnb and to be honest I was a little nervous. However dealing with Sergio and being welcomed to his amazing Penthouse put all my concerns to rest.
The apartment if possible was even better than it looked in the pictures, everything was spotless and very well set up for everything we needed for our stay.
The location was outstanding and walking distance to numerous bars and restaurants. The boutique beer bar downstairs was a hit with my husband and we became big fans of pastries from the corner cafe.
Sergio made us feel very welcome and was on hand when needed to help us with any questions we had.
Don't hesitate to book if you are looking for a stunning place to stay with breathtaking views of the city. You won't be disappointed.
Rebecca - Sydney

Sergio's picture reflects his personality exactly: friendly and fun, but serious about providing excellent accommodation. He spent a good deal of time with us right from the start, orienting us to the unit and the neighbourhood.  We stayed for two months and would be hard-pressed to find a more comfortable unit, a better view, or a better Buenos Airean neighbourhood.  Everything fell into place for us.  Even the porter/building manager Julio is the kindest guy around.  Any issue we had, he dealt with asap.  The best panaderia in town is next door.

We loved the apartment and neighborhood. Sergio was a great host. Even though we did not meet him in person , he responded graciously to our questions and was always available and prompt. I would recommend this apartment to anyone wanting to be in the Palermo district.

Beautifully-furnished apartment with absolutely stunning views across Buenos Aires.  Although Sergio couldn't receive us personally, we were received by the lovely Silvia who was waiting in the apartment when we arrived.  Excellent boutique cafés and restaurants below the apartment and plenty others within a couple of blocks.  We will definitely be in touch again next time we visit the city!

We loved this beautiful apartment! You can find everything what is needed to make your stay comfortable. The area around the apartment is fantastic. A lot of restaurants, bars and shops. It is the best place to stay in Buenos Aires. The apartment has wonderful views around the city. It was hot (close to 40 degrees) during our stay in BA but the air condition makes it feels good and relaxed. The doorman from the apartment building was very friendly. The kitchen is very well equipt, the balconies are amazing. You can enjoy the souround views over the city while your are lying in bed. We defenitly would book this apartment again! Thank you, Sergio :-)

It was a great privilege to stay at Sergio's amazing apartment. The reception was perfect, the city view and stylish environment exceptional. We loved the neighbourhood and will miss Buenos Aires.  If we ever return we would love to stay there again.

We loved to stay at Sergio's place, we had an amazig time.
The appartment wes extremely clean, nice and looked like in the pictures.
We will stay again at his place in a week from now and can only recommend it.
Sergio was welcoming. Everything on the description was accurate. My friends and I loved Sergio's apartment. The neighborhood was quiet and friendly. Everything was within walking distance.

My wife and I have just returned from our trip to Argentina and we already miss BA and this wonderful duplex apartment. The space is exactly as pictured in Sergio's AirBnB listing. The main floor has the living space, a terrace which overlooks a view of Palermo Hollywood, a half bath, and a small but workable kitchen. The bedrooms are on the upper floor. The master bedroom shares the same view as the main floor. It opens out onto a terrace with an outdoor shower. The second bedroom is smaller and doesn't have a view or a terrace. Since it was just the 2 of us, we used the second bedroom to store our luggage and cold weather gear for a brief trip to Patagonia. The space suited us perfectly. Throughout our month-long stay, we continually talked about how lucky we were to have rented the apartment.

We love the neighborhood. The building's location is in the heart of Palermo Hollywood, and it's a short walk to Palermo Soho. There is a wonderful bakery/coffee bar downstairs, and no short...
Gostamos muito. Lugar extremamente agradável, bairro muito gostoso com vários restaurantes perto e o atendimento do Sérgio impecável
Outstanding location and amazing place

Very nice condo in a great part of town with everything very easy to access! would definitely stay again. One bedroom is clearly superior to the other however with views, patio, etc. Something to consider if staying with friends but does not mean the place isn't very nice anyways!
Sergio nos recebeu muito bem e nos deu dicas muito legais! Foi muito atencioso. O bairro é um dos melhores que tem em Buenos Aires. Com muitos restaurantes e bares.
Excelente!
Very clean apartment, just a short taxi ride away from tourist spots! Two gluten free restaurants within walking distance. Lovely place to stay!
Nice apartment with great location, clean and modern design. The restaurant Sergio recommended is fantastic!

Nossa estadia no apartamento foi incrível. Ele é simplesmente idêntico ao a foto, ou seja, lindo, extremamente bem decorado, dono de uma vista incrível, com todos os itens de cozinha/cama/banho necessários. Acredito que seja o melhor bairro de Buenos Aires, com muitos restaurantes e bares.  Além disso, o Sergio e sua esposa são gentis e prepararam uma pasta com muitas referências de cada bairro, dicas de locais e passeios. Foi excelente! Recomendo

Stunning apartment in a great neighborhood. Loved the views from all rooms and you must check out the rooftop as well. Super clean and with all the amenities you need. Sergio was excellent in his communication too and assisted us with any questions we had. Definitely would stay there again.

El apartamento esta muy bien ubicado,muchos restaurantes alrededor, un supermercado,cerca de la estacion del subte, este te ayudara a acercarte a los lugares turisticos para conocer buenos aires.
El apartamento cumplio mi expectativa, un lugar muy comodo,agradable,es muy limpio y seguro. Cuando vuelva a buenos aires no dudare en contactar a sergio. El apto y la ciudad de buenos aires la recomiendo 100%.
Great house in awesome location with panoramic views of the city from pretty much every room. This is where you want to stay when in Buenos Aires. Thank you Sergio for being a great host!

Sergio was a great host and made himself available whenever we needed him. The place was great and located in one of the best and most hip areas of Buenos Aires (Palermo Hollywood). Most bars and clubs worth going out to are in this area, just a couple of blocks away from the apartment. Greatly recommend!
Excellent apartment in a great location. Sergio was extremely responsive and welcoming. The apartment was gorgeous. Highly recommended!

A great apartment in a good location. It is very clean & modern, everything you need for a comfortable stay away from home. More bath towels would have been nice, we had 4 towels between 3 adults for 6 days. Be careful with the washing machine too, it doesn't dissolve the washing powder.
Thanks for accommodating us Sergio, next time we are in your area we will definitely be staying here again.
Perfect place, host and location. Everything ran like clockwork. Such a professional operation and enjoyable place to stay. Gracias!!
EXCELLENT localization and apartament!
Sergio was a great host! My stay was comfortable and pleasant. I would highly recommend.

Sergio was an excellent host, he communicated very well and even had someone at the apartment to show us everything at check in.  He even allowed us a late check out given our flight was later in the day.  I would absolutely stay here again.
Sergio's Penthouse is an amazing apartment in a fantastic location. Sergio was great to deal with and I would highly recommend staying here

Foi Excelente a estadia! Uma localização privilegiada dentro do Palermo! O apartamento em si até supera as expectativas quando se comparado as fotos e descrição!!! Recomendo a todos!!!Tudo exatamente como combinado! Obrigado Sergio!

Easy to book. Sergio was very accommodating and responsive to questions. The apartment is in a great location with loads of bars a restaurants and a great bakery downstairs. The layout of the apartment is ideal and it has good views. I would recommend if staying in the city.

Sergio helped us organise a driver from the airport and the doorman was there to greet us and show is around.
The apartment is in a great area with heaps of bars and restaurants. It has a nice balcony to hang out in and is very nice.
Sergio leaves a folder with recommendations and services around the area.
Lovely place and great host. Recommended!

We loved this apartment!!!!
The area is beautiful and safe. Restaurants are at walking distance and the view from the deck is beautiful. The host, sergio, thought of everything and had everything available for us when we got there. I can't wait to go back!!! Argentina is beautiful!!
Was a comfortable stay located in a great location. Sergio's assistant was there for our arrival and walked us through explaining the features...very helpful. Good value in Palermo Hollywood.
Ce duplex est très agréable et situé dans un quartier vivant et à la mode, Palermo Hollywood. Il est parfait pour 4 personnes, et Sergio est très disponible pour conseiller.
Sergio was a fantastic host and the condo/apt is absolutely wonderful in all aspects such as location, security, cleanliness, views, etc. I would highly recommend staying here.

We had a great time in Palermo staying at Sergio's place. The panaderia and the cafe across the street were both excellent as was the brewery. Really appreciated the air conditioning and blackout curtains because the sun was quite hot blasting in the morning. Took a lovely bath in the tub on the balcony after walking around all day while the family went for a dip in the small rooftop pool.
Nice quiet safe neighbourhood

Sergio's place is in a great location. The view from the balcony is unbelievable. Everything as described. The only thing we missed was a better equipped kitchen, it was difficult to cook dinner as only basics were available and we had to buy all spices etc. However, we left some of it there, so maybe the next renters can use it :)
Very nice. Located near lots of bars and restaurants.  Just like the pictures.  Was clean and great for the price. Would recommend place to anyone!

Sergio's flat was wonderful. Clean, comfortable and well equipped. Sergio left a lot of details to aid our stay. We met him on our arrival and he very kindly treated us to breakfast in the lovely cafe next door!  A great few days to finish our S.American experience.

Tive minha primeira experiência no airbnb com o apartamento do Sergio. Gostei muito da estadia, amei o apartamento e a localização, com ótimos restaurantes e padarias próximos. A internet funcionou super bem e o ar-condicionado foi fundamental para o calorão que encontramos em Buenos Aires. Valeu super à pena!

The apartment is in a very nice modern building in a great part of the city. The subway is about 7 minute walk. Many wonderful bars and restaurants within a short walking distance. For those like us that enjoy working out even while on vacation there is a great modern gym nearby within a couple of blocks.
Sergios place is great. Very nice views and lots of restaraunts nearby.

Ideal location in a great neighborhood.
The bakery downstairs one door over is stellar. Highly recommend the empanadas for breakfast.
Can't imagine a better place to stay. Unbelievable duplex with great views and easy check in, check out.

Dear Mr. Sergio,                                                   I greatly appreciate your kindness and everything you have done to help my trip more comfortable and more interesting.I really like your apartment that close to restaurant, bakery shop, grocery store,... and the most important thing is the safety. I greatly appreciate the guy who you sent to your apartment to show us how to operate everything in your place. Once again I want to to say thank you very much for your help.                                                              Loan Nguyen.
Great place to stay! Me and my 2 girlfriends thoroughly enjoyed our stay at Sergio's place in BA. The neighborhood is hip and fun with many restaurants and bars. Would highly recommend staying here!

The apartment was very comfortable and seemed even bigger since it is two stories. It is well stocked and nicely decorated. The view from the balconies is great. Sergio was very easy to work with and check in and check out were a snap. The neighborhood is full of great restaurants and bars. It is an easy 10 or 15 minute walk to the subway station or hop on hop off bus.

Sergio's apartment was really beautiful. We were two young girls travelling round South America alone so safety was a key issue for us and of course some luxury after we had just come from the Amazon in Peru! In terms of location and comfort, you really won't get any better than this and there are so many shops and bars around to keep you occupied at any time of day.
We had a slight issue with taxi money on the way from the airport as all of the case machines were empty and we couldn't pay the driver (we understand that Argentinians withdraw cash on Fridays and the ATMs run out so with our arrival on a Sunday we were pretty stuck) but fortunately Sergio's friend Mariano came to the rescue and very kindly paid our taxi on arrival. This was of course not expected or required but was a kind gesture, for which we were so grateful. If you are coming to BA, you must stay here. The check in and check out process was also very straightforward and the views from the balcony....well there were absolutely incre...
What an awesome stay, central, clean with great views of the city. Trying sleeping with the curtains open in the main bedroom.
Excellent stay. Attentive host. Incredible place.
Very comfortable condo with amazing views. Worth the $$, would stay again.
El apartamento es realmente hermoso. Muy cómodo y el entorno es ideal. Excelente en todo sentido lo recomiendo al 100 por 100.
Great location, beautiful apartment, and accommodating host. Highly recommend.

Sergio was great and really easy to deal with. The apartment is in a good area. It was handy to have the bakery and bar just downstairs. The master bedroom has awesome views although second bedroom is quite small and dark. The water pressure in the shower is very low and the toilets didn't flush well. Otherwise we really enjoyed our stay.

Un posto bellissimo nel quartiere modaiolo di Palermo, con tanta vita sia di giorno che di notte. L'appartamento su due piani, arredato modernamente e con due camere al piano superiore, offre una vista incantevole su Buenos Aires senza essere rumoroso. Al piano superiore anche una piccola piscina, sicuramente piacevolissima d'estate. Tutto intorno all'edifico c'é tutto quello che puó servire in vacanza, dal panificio, al supermercato, al fruttivendolo ed alla birreria appena sotto casa, fino a locali e negozi di tutti i generi nelle immediate vicinanze. A pochi minuti ci sono Plaza Italia e i favolosi giardini di Buenos Aires, con il metro o con il taxi si raggiunge velocemente il centro.
Consigliatissimo!
Vale la pena 100%

Sergio's place is the nicest Airbnb apartment I have stayed in. Phenomenal view of the city. Walking distance from a bunch of good restaurants and cafes. Communication with Sergio was easy before hand. Would definitely recommend.
Very nice place to stay, in a safe location in Buenos Aires.
Nice place, good location.
Really good host.
Lovely place.   Will stay again.
Sergio's place is great.  It was spacious, clean and well appointed.  The location is great and makes a perfect base to explore the city.
Very nice place.

Our stay was very enjoyable, we loved the views out over the city especially at night time.
Sergio was very pleasant and easy to deal with.
We loved that there were plenty of restaurants nearby that offered a good choice of different cuisines.
The property itself was perfect for our requirements, very secure with a police presence in the area.
I would be more than happy to return in the future.

Sergio was fantastic.   I had flight cancellations arriving and departing, and he was extremely flexible and patient with my constantly changing travel plans.  On top of that, the apartment was beautiful, super clean, and in a great neighbourhood for walking to restaurants, bars, and shops.  I'd highly recommend staying here and with Sergio as your host.

Apartamento fantástico como anunciado. Camas confortáveis, limpo e vista espetacular. Localização perfeita, restaurantes deliciosos, padarias na mesma rua. Comunicação com o Sérgio foi muito boa e tranquila. Adoramos. Obrigada por tudo Sérgio!
Very good location, great apartment, excellent host.
Fantastic location and fabulous apartment. Perfect for 2 couples or a family.
Great place in an amazing location. I felt very safe in Sergio's place and we were very close to a bunch of great restaurants.

Schönes Appartment in schönem und sicheren Stadtteil von BA. Perfekt geeignet um von dort aus ein paar Tage die Stadt zu genießen. Super Ausblick auf die Stadt, sogar direkt vom Bett aus. Absolut sicher durch Hauswart. Gepäckaufbewahrung am Abflugtag hat problemlos geklappt. Sehr zu empfehlen.
100% recomendable para 2 parejas
As the pictures...great neighborhood...recommend this place to others for sure

I would come back to this apartment on a future visit to BA in a heartbeat. The location was great: just stroll down Goritti street for a huge number of bars/restaurants/cool stores, etc. There is also a great bakery right next door—and a gelato store across the street.
The apartment itself was absolutely wonderful. The view is great. There is a second shower and tub on the balcony (and still private, as there are no nearby buildings tall enough to see in) which is a nice touch.
Internet is reliable, but at 3MBPS down, 0.3 up, it will be slow if you need to upload any non-text based content.
The building is very safe and in a calm residential neighborhood. There is also a grocery store half a block away.
Serge was great and stayed in touch for the duration of the visit. We fell in love with BA, and will be back—and this is where we will stay again.
Located in Palermo Hollywood, it has great views of the city as well as nice vibe! The apartment is modern, spacious and well lit!

Sergio's place was really great, clean and in a fantastic part of town. He met me exactly when I arrived, was very communicative and helpful. There is more around here than you can probably check out in a few days, but it really is a fun neighborhood. Only good things to say!
El apartamento está excelentemente ubicado tiene mucho estilo y comodidad!
Un departamento muy recomendable.

Sergio's residence is in a really wonderful location, and it is both stylish and comfortable.  We loved the balconies for a glass of wine at night and the pool on the roof to cool down on a hot day.    Sergio was wonderful at communicating with us and ensuring everything was perfect.   Would definitely recommend!

Great host and great place. Very nice neighborhood. We walked for hours discovering new restaurants stores and buildings. Fashionable people and great architecture. Found our favorite coffee place nearby and they had amazing pastries. Would love to stay again.....also, the house is beautiful and clean. Very modern. Nice design touch. Great view of the neighborhood. A treat.
If you like nice design and a clean stylish apartment then this place is for you.

A great place to stay. An easy walk to Plaza Serrano and the underground tube is 7 minutes walk down the sane street. You can get anywhere in the city so easily!
Sergio is an incredible host. Attentive and organised and everything went absolutely smoothly. Not a glitch with any aspect. The place is great. We used the pool on rooftop and used the balcony bath daily. Loved Buenos Aires. One of the highlights was contacting Delta Unplugged ( check out their Facebook page or website or through TripAdvisor) who offer Parana Delta private tours on their boat. We got a private Taxi from the apartment all the way to Tigre and then had an amazing day in the delta. Other highlights was Plaza De Mayo on Thursday when the mothers of The Disappeared meet and march. Get out to San Telmo market too. All in all we had a fantastic time at this apartment and gave it and Sergio a full 5 stars. Thank you Sergio!

The condo is beautiful , amazing view. Great space, it is in the middle of dozens of bars, great restaurants and close to major attractions. We found 3 great restaurants so for those looking for steak houses, we found Las cabreras, Don Julio and Las Cabras, all within walking distance...about 10-15 mins. Sergio responded quickly to our whatsapp messages withour any issues. I highly recommend this place !
Melhor lugar para se estar em Buenos Aires: próximo dos melhores restaurantes e bares! O charme do apartamento do Sérgio faz juz ao de Palermo. Super recomendado!

Sergio's appartement is prima. Het ligt centraal in Palermo, op loopafstand van metro en bussen. Veel raturants etc in de buurt.
Appartement ligt op de 7e verdieping, met prachtig uitzicht. Is redelijk goed uitgerust.
Amazing flat with brilliant views of the city.  Very smartly decorated, lovely pool on the roof, 2 big bedrooms and the host was very nice and easy to communicate with.  Highly recommended

I would trade my apartment in NYC for Sergio's anytime. The rooms were very comfortable, airy and sunny.  It has a great unobstructed views from the living room and bedroom balconies of downtown Bs Ar. The building was very safe, lobby and individual floors very clean. Sergios apartment was in a wonderful location.  Great restaurants and bars within walking distance of the apartment.
